title_cn: SEAD：工具调用智能体攻防的基于状态视角
abstract_cn: 语言模型智能体日益使用工具作用于外部系统。先前的动作可能改变文件、权限、数据库记录或其他状态，使后续看似例行的动作变得有害。而可见交互可能不包含评估该动作所需的底层状态。我们把攻击与防御形式化为 SEAD 中部分可观测的状态控制，从共享执行过程推导二者设计要求。由于攻击者提供指令而目标选择具体动作，DART 把有害目标分解为局部合理的步骤，并利用真实工具执行的反馈引导轨迹搜索。防御者必须在执行前以不完整状态证据决策，SAGE 因此在放行或阻断每个动作（包括被阻断后重新提出的动作）前通过只读查询调查相关状态。我们构建一个环境可验证的数据集，整合受控初始状态、可重放工具环境与任务特定的可执行检查。跨四个目标模型，DART 的语义攻击成功比竞争基线高 18.8–35.9 个百分点，在可执行验证下增益一致。在记录轨迹上，SAGE 保留 95.79% 的良性轨迹，并在危害使能边界前拦截 92.73% 的有害路径。在线攻防评估中，SAGE 把 DART 的可执行攻击成功从 48.0% 降到 4.0%，且跨四种攻击方法有效、可泛化到域外环境。代码与数据见 https://github.com/EverywhereSafety/SEAD。
summary_cn: 把智能体攻防形式化为部分可观测状态控制：攻击 DART 语义成功率 +18.8–35.9 点；防御 SAGE 拦截 92.73% 有害路径、保留 95.79% 良性，在线对抗把攻击成功 48.0%→4.0%。
objective_summary: 提出以部分可观测状态控制统一刻画智能体攻防的框架，构建环境可验证数据集并在线评估 DART 攻击与 SAGE 防御。
evidence_note: 四目标模型、可执行验证数据集、记录轨迹+在线攻防双评估、域外泛化检查；代码数据公开。
novelty_note: 把攻防统一到状态控制视角并配对设计攻击/防御为新的形式化框架；执行反馈攻击与执行前状态调查为实质新机制。
scope: 结论适用于可只读查询状态的工具环境；对状态不可查询或查询即副作用的系统不适用。
limitations: 数据集为构造环境，真实生产系统状态复杂性未覆盖；SAGE 的只读查询开销未量化；状态建模依赖人工规范。

title: How to Tame a Multi-Headed Hydra? Adaptive Multi-Category Safety Steering for Large Language Models
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly widespread, preventing unsafe responses to harmful prompts is essential for their safe deployment. Activation steering offers an approach to improving LLM safety by modifying internal activations during inference without updating model parameters. However, a single prompt can involve multiple harm categories, and steering toward safety in one category may leave harmful content from another unaddressed. Despite advances in adaptive steering, existing methods do not explicitly coordinate steering direction and strength when multiple harm categories co-occur within a single prompt. To address this problem, we propose CAM-Steer, a Category-Adaptive Multi-category Safety Steering framework. Specifically, it estimates the risk associated with each harm category by comparing the current hidden state with safe and unsafe prototypes. The estimated risks are then used to combine the safety directions for different harm categories into a single steering direction and to determine the strength of the intervention. Finally, it rotates the hidden state along the composed steering direction, with the rotation angle determined by the estimated risks, while preserving the hidden-state norm. Experiments across three LLM backbones and seven harm categories show that CAM-Steer outperforms the evaluated baselines in average defense success rate, including when categories co-occur. Further analyses support its component designs and informative risk scores, with negligible inference overhead.
title_cn: 如何驯服多头九头蛇？面向 LLM 的类别自适应多类别安全转向
abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型日益普及，防止对有害提示的不安全响应是其安全部署的关键。激活转向通过在推理期修改内部激活（不更新参数）提升 LLM 安全性。然而单个提示可能涉及多个危害类别，朝一个类别转向安全可能使另一类别的有害内容未被处理。尽管自适应转向已有进展，既有方法在多类别共存于同一提示时并未显式协调转向方向与强度。为此我们提出 CAM-Steer，一个类别自适应的多类别安全转向框架：通过把当前隐藏态与安全/不安全原型比较来估计每个危害类别的风险；用估计风险把不同类别的安全方向组合为单一转向方向并确定干预强度；最后沿组合方向旋转隐藏态——旋转角由估计风险决定，同时保持隐藏态范数。跨三个 LLM 骨干与七个危害类别的实验显示，CAM-Steer 在平均防御成功率上优于被评估基线，包括多类别共存的情形。进一步分析支持其组件设计与风险评分的信息量，且推理开销可忽略。
summary_cn: 类别自适应多类别激活转向 CAM-Steer：按原型风险组合各危害类别的转向方向与强度、保范数旋转，三骨干×七类别上平均防御成功率超基线且开销可忽略。
objective_summary: 提出按类别风险组合转向方向与强度的多类别激活转向框架，在三个骨干与七个危害类别上与基线比较防御成功率。
evidence_note: 三骨干×七类别（含共存情形）的系统对比与组件消融；摘要未给出具体成功率数字，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把单类别激活转向扩展为按风险显式协调多类别方向与强度，属已有机制上的实质改进而非新范式。
scope: 结论适用于激活可访问的开源 LLM 与所测七个危害类别；对闭源 API 模型不适用。
limitations: 依赖安全/不安全原型的质量；类别集合固定，新危害需扩充原型；对自适应绕过转向的攻击未评估。

title: CoDeL: Co-Evolutionary Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM-based Agents
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly rely on external tools and content, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI). This threat has motivated a wide range of defenses, among which training-based defenses are often regarded as most reliable. However, existing training-based defenses are typically optimized on a static distribution of explicit injections. They learn surface-form cues rather than the boundary between serving the user and obeying an injected objective, and therefore fail when malicious intent is folded into a plausible workflow and deferred for several turns. We present CoDeL, a defense that hardens agent against an attack distribution it reshapes as it trains. The defender is updated each round via LoRA-based GDPO under a decoupled reward over safety, task progress, and format compliance, so refusing injections and completing the user's task jointly define fitness. To keep supplying it with the failures worth learning from, a co-evolving prober searches over injection rounds, attack methods, and payloads for injections that still penetrate the current defender, guided jointly by attack success and attack latency so that it preferentially mines breaches the defender notices too late. Each defender update invalidates part of the attack population and forces the next round onto a new frontier, turning the defender's own failures into a moving curriculum. Extensive experiments on three IPI benchmarks, nine baselines, and two base models show that CoDeL reduces attack success rate (ASR) by 88.5% and outperforms other baselines largely (+38.0%). Codes are available.
title_cn: CoDeL：LLM 智能体中间接提示注入的协同进化防御
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的智能体日益依赖外部工具与内容，暴露于间接提示注入（IPI）威胁。这催生了大量防御，其中训练式防御常被认为最可靠。然而既有训练式防御通常在显式注入的静态分布上优化，学到表层线索而非「服务用户」与「服从注入目标」之间的边界，因此当恶意意图折入合理工作流、延迟数轮执行时即告失效。我们提出 CoDeL，一个在训练中重塑攻击分布、据此强化智能体的防御。防御者每轮经基于 LoRA 的 GDPO 更新，采用安全、任务进度与格式合规解耦的奖励——拒绝注入与完成用户任务共同定义适应度。为持续供给值得学习的失败，协同进化的探针在注入轮次、攻击方法与载荷上搜索仍能穿透当前防御者的注入，以攻击成功与攻击时延联合引导，优先挖掘防御者察觉过晚的突破。每次防御者更新都使部分攻击种群失效，迫使下一轮进入新前沿，把防御者自身的失败变成移动课程。在三个 IPI 基准、九个基线与两个基座模型上的大量实验显示，CoDeL 把攻击成功率降低 88.5%，并大幅领先其他基线（+38.0%）。代码已开源。
summary_cn: 防御者与探针协同进化的 IPI 防御 CoDeL：LoRA GDPO 解耦奖励+自适应探针挖掘迟察觉突破，三基准九基线两基座上 ASR 降 88.5%（超基线 38.0 个点）。
objective_summary: 提出防御者与探针共同进化的 IPI 训练防御，以解耦奖励与移动课程持续暴露防御失败，并在三个基准上量化。
evidence_note: 三个 IPI 基准、九基线、两基座模型的对比与 88.5% ASR 削减；基准内评估、无统计检验，代码开源。
novelty_note: 把防御训练与攻击分布重塑耦合为协同进化闭环，针对「延迟/折叠式注入」的失败模式为新机制。
scope: 结论适用于可反复训练的智能体 IPI 防御；对无法重训的闭源部署与推理时防御未覆盖。
limitations: 探针搜索空间限于所设攻击族；训练成本随轮次增长；对人类红队的新奇注入泛化未验证。

title: Breaking Windows Malware Detection: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Problem-Space Adversarial Robustness
abstract: Problem-space evasion attacks have exposed critical weaknesses in machine learning-based malware detectors; yet, their evaluation remains fragmented across models, datasets, and attack methodologies, often neglecting domain-specific requirements such as executability and functionality preservation. We address this gap with a unified, large-scale evaluation of nine state-of-the-art evasion attacks against eight Windows malware detectors, including seven open-source models and one commercial detector, under executability-preserving conditions. Our study analyzes attack effectiveness, complementarity, transferability, and adversarial hardening to evaluate robustness along complementary dimensions. We show that detector vulnerability depends strongly on both model representation and attack type: raw-byte detectors are particularly susceptible to several classes of problem-space manipulation, but no detector family is uniformly robust across all attacks. Importantly, effectiveness is not explained by transformation-space size alone: the strongest attacks can achieve substantially higher success while using fewer distinct transformations and concentrating on a small set of high-impact manipulations. We further show that two complementary attacks are sufficient to cover approximately 99% of the adversarial examples produced by the remaining evaluated attacks. Transferability exhibits a different pattern from direct attack success: attacks with low direct success can produce highly transferable evasions. Finally, adversarial hardening is highly attack- and model-dependent: robustness gains often fail to transfer across attacks and can even increase susceptibility to unseen attacks. These findings highlight limitations in current malware robustness evaluations, establish a comprehensive empirical baseline, and clarify relationships between effectiveness, transferability, and defense robustness.
title_cn: 攻破 Windows 恶意软件检测：问题空间对抗鲁棒性的综合评估
abstract_cn: 问题空间规避攻击暴露了基于机器学习的恶意软件检测器的关键弱点，但其评估分散在不同模型、数据集与攻击方法之间，常忽视可执行性、功能保持等领域特定要求。我们以统一的大规模评估填补该缺口：在保持可执行性的条件下，评估九种最先进规避攻击对八个 Windows 恶意软件检测器（七个开源模型与一个商业检测器）的效果。研究沿互补维度分析攻击有效性、互补性、可迁移性与对抗硬化，以评估鲁棒性。我们表明检测器脆弱性强烈依赖模型表示与攻击类型：原始字节检测器对多类问题空间操纵尤其易感，但没有任何检测器家族对所有攻击一致鲁棒。重要的是，有效性不能仅由变换空间大小解释：最强攻击能用更少的不同变换、聚焦于一小组高影响操纵，取得显著更高的成功率。我们进一步表明两种互补攻击足以覆盖其余被评估攻击产生的约 99% 的对抗样本。可迁移性呈现与直接攻击成功不同的模式：直接成功率低的攻击可产生高度可迁移的规避。最后，对抗硬化高度依赖攻击与模型：鲁棒性增益常不跨攻击迁移，甚至可能增加对未见攻击的易感性。这些发现凸显当前恶意软件鲁棒性评估的局限、建立综合经验基线，并厘清有效性、可迁移性与防御鲁棒性之间的关系。
summary_cn: 九种问题空间攻击×八个 Windows 恶意软件检测器（含商业）的统一评估：原始字节检测器最易感，两种攻击覆盖其余约 99% 对抗样本，硬化增益常不跨攻击迁移。
objective_summary: 在可执行性保持条件下统一评估九种规避攻击对八个检测器的效果，并量化互补性、可迁移性与硬化行为。
evidence_note: 九攻击×八检测器（含商业系统）的大规模统一评估、可执行性与功能保持约束、互补性与迁移性的系统量化；无统计检验但覆盖面广。
novelty_note: 对已知攻击与检测器的首个同约束大规模统一评估，「两攻击覆盖 99%」「硬化不迁移」为有诊断价值的新量化结论。
scope: 结论适用于 Windows PE 恶意软件检测器与所测九类问题空间攻击；对移动平台与非 PE 格式未覆盖。
limitations: 商业检测器为黑盒；硬化实验的模型重训成本限制了配置数；功能保持的判定依赖静态与动态检查的组合。

title: ReproBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Reproducing Vulnerability From Scratch
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly evaluated on cybersecurity tasks such as vulnerability reproduction, exploitation, and patching. However, existing cybersecurity benchmarks predominantly operate under a post-environment evaluation paradigm, i.e., handing the agent source code, a container, or an executable binary. This setup bypasses the critical environment reconstruction step, leaving a fundamental question for real-world vulnerability analysis: can an agent autonomously reconstruct the required execution environment and reproduce a vulnerability entirely from scratch? To address this gap, we present ReproBench, an evidence-grounded benchmark designed to evaluate agent capabilities in end-to-end vulnerability reproduction starting from solely a CVE identifier. ReproBench decomposes the full reproduction workflow into six distinct phases, and assesses performance on each phase independently using verifiable experimental artifacts: downloaded firmware images, unpacked binaries, granular analysis logs, and validated crash samples, among others. We instantiate ReproBench with 30 real-world IoT firmware vulnerabilities, which serve as ideal test cases for our from-scratch evaluation setting. Our evaluation demonstrates that 45.3% of test runs resort to vulnerability simulation - a prevalent remediation workaround adopted across all evaluated LLM agents - while only 5.3% of CVE-model pairs achieve successful reproduction of real-world vulnerabilities. Despite the low overall success rate, these non-trivial successful cases confirm that state-of-the-art LLM agents already possess the capacity for fully autonomous end-to-end vulnerability reproduction. Concurrently, our in-depth analysis of failed cases identifies core bottlenecks impeding LLM agents throughout the reproduction pipeline, offering actionable insights for subsequent research.
comment: 15 pages (9 pages main text + 6 pages appendix), 5 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to AAAI 2027
title_cn: ReproBench：评测 LLM 智能体从零复现漏洞的基准
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益被用于漏洞复现、利用与修补等网络安全任务，但既有基准主要在「环境已备」的评估范式下运行——直接交给智能体源码、容器或可执行二进制。该设置绕过关键的环境重建步骤，留给真实漏洞分析一个根本问题：智能体能否完全从零自主重建所需执行环境并复现漏洞？为此我们提出 ReproBench，一个证据接地的基准，评估智能体仅凭 CVE 标识符进行端到端漏洞复现的能力。ReproBench 把完整复现工作流分解为六个阶段，并用可验证实验工件（下载的固件镜像、解包的二进制、细粒度分析日志、经校验的崩溃样本等）独立评估各阶段性能。我们用 30 个真实 IoT 固件漏洞实例化 ReproBench——它们是从零评估设定的理想测试用例。评估表明 45.3% 的测试运行诉诸漏洞仿真——所有被评估 LLM 智能体普遍采用的变通手法——而仅 5.3% 的 CVE-模型对实现对真实漏洞的成功复现。尽管总体成功率低，这些非平凡的成功案例证实最先进 LLM 智能体已具备完全自主端到端漏洞复现的能力。同时，我们对失败案例的深入分析识别出阻碍 LLM 智能体贯穿复现管线的核心瓶颈，为后续研究提供可操作洞见。15 页（正文 9+附录 6）、5 图、11 表，投稿 AAAI 2027。
summary_cn: 首个从零（仅 CVE 编号起步）复现漏洞的智能体基准 ReproBench：30 个 IoT 固件漏洞、六阶段证据评估，仅 5.3% 的 CVE-模型对真实复现成功，45.3% 运行诉诸仿真变通。
objective_summary: 构建从 CVE 标识符出发、含环境重建的六阶段漏洞复现基准，用可验证工件评估 30 个 IoT 漏洞上智能体的真实复现能力与瓶颈。
evidence_note: 30 个真实固件漏洞、六阶段独立工件评估、失败案例瓶颈分析；样本量偏小，评估脚手架影响未完全隔离。
novelty_note: 首个把环境重建纳入评估的从零漏洞复现基准，揭示「仿真变通」这一普遍现象，设定新颖。
scope: 结论适用于 Linux/IoT 固件类 CVE 的从零复现；对 Windows、云服务等其他环境的迁移未验证。
limitations: 仅 30 个 CVE；复现成功判定依赖崩溃校验协议；阶段划分由作者设定，其他分解方式可能不同。

title: Quantum Security of XOR of Permutations via Fourier Analysis
abstract: The XOR of two or more independent random permutations (XoP) is the prototypical pseudorandom function built from permutations achieving security beyond the birthday bound. The classical security of the XoP construction is well established, but its security against quantum attacks that query XoP in superposition has remained widely open. We prove that the XOR of $r\ge 2$ random permutations over $\{0,1\}^n$ is indistinguishable from a random function by any $q$-query quantum algorithm with advantage \[O\left(\min\left\{\frac{q^3}{2^{rn}},\frac{q^{1.5}}{2^{(r-0.5)n}},\frac{1}{2^{(r-1.5)n}}\right\}\right)\] for all $q\ll 2^n$. In particular, XoP remains secure throughout the entire query range, far beyond the $2^{n/3}$ bound due to quantum collision finding attacks. This is the first construction from permutations that achieves the quantum version of the beyond birthday bound security. We also present several heuristic attacks suggesting the tightness of our bounds in ranges $q\le 2^{n/2}$ and $\approx 2^n$. We use a Fourier-analytic variant of the polynomial method: the advantage of any $q$-query quantum algorithm is controlled by the Fourier components of degree at most $2q$, or by $2q$ input-output data of the construction. The norms of most components are bounded well, proving the bound $2^{-(r-3/2)n}$. The norm of low-degree components turn out to be too large for the bounds $q^3/2^{rn}$ and $q^{1.5}/2^{(r-0.5)n}$. We reinterpret these low-degree components as (sums of) advantages of the other problems. For example, the degree-2 and degree-4 terms are interpreted as the advantages against random functions with and without \emph{planted collisions}, which in turn are bounded using Zhandry's small-range distributions. Along the way, we prove a new bound for the small-range indistinguishability for (ironically) large ranges, which is of independent interest.
title_cn: 经傅里叶分析证明置换异或的量子安全性
abstract_cn: 两个或更多独立随机置换的异或（XoP）是由置换构建、达到超生日界安全性的原型伪随机函数。其经典安全性已充分确立，但面对以叠加方式查询 XoP 的量子攻击的安全性长期悬而未决。我们证明：对 {0,1}^n 上 r≥2 个随机置换的异或，任何 q 次查询的量子算法的区分优势为 O(min{q³/2^{rn}, q^{1.5}/2^{(r-0.5)n}, 1/2^{(r-1.5)n}})（q≪2^n）。特别地，XoP 在整个查询范围内保持安全，远超量子碰撞查找攻击造成的 2^{n/3} 界。这是首个由置换构造、达到量子版超生日界安全性的构造。我们还给出若干启发式攻击，提示我们的界在 q≤2^{n/2} 与约 2^n 范围内的紧性。我们使用多项式方法的傅里叶变体：任何 q 次查询量子算法的优势由次数至多 2q 的傅里叶分量（或构造的 2q 个输入-输出数据）控制。多数分量的范数有良好界，给出 2^{-(r-3/2)n}；低次分量范数对 q³/2^{rn} 与 q^{1.5}/2^{(r-0.5)n} 两界而言过大，我们把它们重新解释为其他问题的优势之和——例如次数 2 与 4 的项解释为对有无植入碰撞随机函数的优势，进而用 Zhandry 的小范围分布界定。过程中我们还证明对（颇具讽刺意味的）大范围的小范围不可区分性新界，具独立价值。
summary_cn: 证明置换异或（XoP）的全范围量子安全性：优势 O(min{q³/2^{rn}, q^{1.5}/2^{(r-0.5)n}, 1/2^{(r-1.5)n}})，远超 2^{n/3} 碰撞界，为首个达量子超生日界的置换构造。
objective_summary: 用傅里叶化的多项式方法证明置换异或在全部查询范围内抗量子区分，给出紧性启发式攻击与独立有价值的小范围界。
evidence_note: 理论论文：完整证明链（傅里叶分量界+小范围分布归约）、显式三支优势界、紧性的启发式攻击佐证、附新小范围界。
novelty_note: 解决长期开放的 XoP 量子安全性问题，首个置换基量子超生日界构造，傅里叶-低次分量重解释技术具普适价值。
scope: 结论适用于独立均匀随机置换的异或与叠加查询模型；对具体分组密码实例化的安全性需另证。
limitations: 界的紧性部分依赖启发式攻击论证；常数因子未优化；对相关/泄露置换的推广未覆盖。

title: Coherence Rather Than Error Rate Governs Privacy in Multi-Tenant Quantum Computing
abstract: Multi-tenant computing enables providers of commercial cloud quantum processors to rent disjoint sectors of a device to independent users. Average gate error, which cloud quantum computing providers report, does not determine how much one tenant learns about another. We propose an information-theoretic notion of information leakage across co-tenancy boundaries stemming from quantum state distinguishability. We measure this leakage on commercially-available 156-qubit (IBM Kingston) and 20-qubit (IQM Garnet) devices. Boundaries with identical benchmarked error can offer significantly different amount of information leakage because standard reported measures of error are blind to coherent-versus-stochastic nature of the error while the proposed notion of information leakage is not. A uniform Pauli randomisation implemented over the victim's whole register is used as a defence mechanism to reduce the information leakage to zero. The defence theoretically does not incur a fidelity cost, but the experiments show a non-trivial degradation caused by accumulation of errors. We provide a specific call-for-action to the providers of quantum cloud computing to report information leakage in addition to standard error rates in their device datasheet to enable users to compute privacy and security risks prior to engagement with the device.
title_cn: 在多租户量子计算中治理隐私的是相干性而非错误率
abstract_cn: 多租户计算使商用量子云处理器的提供商能把设备的互不相交扇区租给独立用户。云量子计算提供商报告的平均门错误率并不决定一个租户能了解到另一租户的多少信息。我们提出源于量子态可区分性的跨共租边界信息泄漏概念。我们在商用 156 量子比特（IBM Kingston）与 20 量子比特（IQM Garnet）设备上测量该泄漏。基准错误相同的边界可能提供差异显著的信息泄漏量，因为标准错误度量对错误的相干性与随机性之别视而不见，而所提信息泄漏概念则不然。以覆盖受害者整个寄存器的均匀 Pauli 随机化作为防御机制，可把信息泄漏降到零。该防御理论上不产生保真度代价，但实验显示错误累积造成非平凡退化。我们向量子云计算提供商发出具体行动呼吁：在设备数据表中除标准错误率外报告信息泄漏，让用户在接入设备前能计算隐私与安全风险。
summary_cn: 提出跨租户量子信息泄漏度量并在 IBM/IQM 商用设备实测：错误率相同的隔离边界泄漏可差异显著；全寄存器 Pauli 随机化可清零泄漏但有非平凡保真度代价。
objective_summary: 定义量子共租边界的信息泄漏概念，在两台商用量子设备上实测其与报告错误率的脱节，并评估 Pauli 随机化防御。
evidence_note: 两台真实商用设备（IBM Kingston 156Q、IQM Garnet 20Q）实测、泄漏与错误率脱节的对照演示、防御的保真度代价量化。
novelty_note: 首次指出平均门错误率不决定共租隐私并给出可测的相干性敏感泄漏度量，为量子多租户安全确立新问题维度。
scope: 结论适用于共租量子处理器的态可区分性泄漏；对跨芯片、网络化量子系统的泄漏未覆盖。
limitations: 测量限于两台设备；防御的随机化深度带来误差累积退化；泄漏到密码威胁的传导未完全建模。

title: Before Agents Act: Assurance-Aware Semantic Scheduling for Evidence Acquisition in Distributed Systems
abstract: Tool-using agents can initiate consequential infrastructure changes, yet evidence required for admission may expire while other checks run or depend on a shared fault domain. We formulate evidence acquisition as joint witness selection and scheduling under quorum, diversity, freshness, deadline, and resource constraints. Assurance-Aware Semantic Scheduling (AAS) combines integer-program selection, dispatch-aware temporal scheduling, bounded diagnostic expansion, and receipt-aware repair. Formal results state the assumptions needed for dispatch-time freshness and finite diagnostic expansion. In three generated infrastructure workloads, AAS produces 1,075/1,200 valid candidates versus 647/1,200 for constraint-aware forward scheduling; stale candidates fall from 440 to 12. Paired sensitivity studies reuse the same instances and operation latency draws across parameter settings. A corrected timeout intervention finds 18/20 admissions with repair or full resynthesis versus 0/20 for a static plan, with lower committed cost when receipts are reused. On 20 constructed cases requiring a certified decomposition cut, refinement recovers an oracle-matching feasible plan every time. These are controlled simulation results; the bounded oracle shares a temporal search component, and transfer to deployed systems remains untested.
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Extended manuscript with formal proofs and operation catalogue
title_cn: 在智能体行动之前：分布式系统中面向证据获取的保保证语义调度
abstract_cn: 工具调用智能体可能启动有后果的基础设施变更，而准入所需的证据可能在其他检查运行期间过期，或依赖共享故障域。我们把证据获取形式化为在法定人数、多样性、新鲜度、期限与资源约束下的联合见证选择与调度。保保证语义调度（AAS）结合整数规划选择、感知分派的时间调度、有界诊断扩展与感知回执的修复。形式化结果陈述分派时新鲜度与有界诊断扩展所需的假设。在三个生成的基础设施工作负载上，AAS 产出 1,075/1,200 个有效候选，而感知约束的前向调度为 647/1,200；过期候选从 440 降至 12。配对敏感性研究在参数设置间复用同一实例与操作时延抽样。修正超时干预下，AAS 以修复或完全重合成找到 18/20 个准入，静态计划为 0/20，且回执复用时承诺成本更低。在 20 个需要认证分解切割的构造案例上，精化每次都恢复与神谕匹配的可行计划。这些是受控仿真结果；有界神谕共享一个时间搜索组件，向部署系统的迁移尚未检验。30 页、5 图、3 表，附形式化证明与操作目录。
summary_cn: 把智能体准入证据获取形式化为带法定人数/新鲜度/期限约束的见证选择+调度：生成负载上有效候选 1,075/1,200 vs 647/1,200，过期候选 440→12，超时干预 18/20 vs 0/20。
objective_summary: 形式化智能体变更准入的证据获取问题并给出整数规划+时间调度的 AAS 方案，在生成工作负载与构造案例上量化有效性。
evidence_note: 形式化假设明确、三个生成负载+配对敏感性+构造案例的多层评估；作者明示为受控仿真、神谕共享搜索组件、未在部署系统验证。
novelty_note: 把证据获取作为带新鲜度/法定人数约束的联合选择-调度问题是新的问题形式化；求解组件多为既有技术。
scope: 结论限于生成工作负载与构造案例的受控仿真；操作目录覆盖的动作类型有限。
limitations: 未在真实部署系统检验；有界神谕与评估共享时间搜索组件，存在循环性风险；成本模型参数为构造。

title: RADNPO: Reference-free Adaptive Negative Preference Optimization for LLM Unlearning
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize sensitive, private, or copyrighted content during pre-training, making machine unlearning necessary for removing targeted knowledge. Recent preference optimization (PO)-based unlearning methods improve stability over gradient ascent (GA)-based methods by introducing alignment-style objectives, which effectively suppress the probability of forget targets. However, target suppression alone does not sufficiently constrain the next-token distribution after unlearning. Existing methods provide limited control over how suppressed probability mass is redistributed and insufficiently adapt forgetting strength to target confidence and distributional concentration. Even after target suppression, probability mass may remain concentrated on a few non-target tokens, potentially producing repetitive or uninformative outputs. To address these limitations, we propose Reference-free ADaptive Negative Preference Optimization (RADNPO), which explicitly guides next-token probability redistribution. Specifically, RADNPO contrasts each forget target with alternative tokens favored by the current next-token distribution and adaptively modulates token-level forgetting strength using target confidence and next-token concentration. Experiments on TOFU and MUSE demonstrate that RADNPO achieves a better trade-off between forgetting quality and model utility than current baselines.
title_cn: RADNPO：面向 LLM 遗忘的免参照自适应负偏好优化
abstract_cn: 大语言模型在预训练中会记住敏感、私有或受版权保护的内容，使机器遗忘成为移除目标知识的必要手段。近期基于偏好优化（PO）的遗忘方法通过对齐式目标改善梯度上升法的稳定性，有效抑制遗忘目标的概率。然而仅抑制目标不足以约束遗忘后的下一 token 分布。既有方法对被抑制概率质量如何再分配的控制有限，也未能使遗忘强度自适应于目标置信度与分布集中度。目标被抑制后，概率质量可能仍集中于少数非目标 token，产生重复或无信息输出。为此我们提出免参照自适应负偏好优化（RADNPO），显式引导下一 token 概率再分配：把每个遗忘目标与当前分布偏好的替代 token 对比，并用目标置信度与下一 token 集中度自适应调制 token 级遗忘强度。在 TOFU 与 MUSE 上的实验表明，RADNPO 在遗忘质量与模型效用之间取得优于现有基线的权衡。
summary_cn: 提出免参照负偏好遗忘方法 RADNPO：显式引导概率再分配并按目标置信度自适应调节遗忘强度，在 TOFU/MUSE 上取得优于基线的遗忘-效用权衡。
objective_summary: 提出以替代 token 对比与自适应遗忘强度控制下一 token 分布的遗忘方法，并在标准遗忘基准上与 PO 基线比较权衡。
evidence_note: TOFU 与 MUSE 两个标准遗忘基准、与既有 PO/GA 基线的权衡对比；摘要未给出具体数字，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 在既有 PO 遗忘路线上补充再分配控制与自适应强度，属增量式方法改进。
scope: 结论适用于 token 级目标序列的 LLM 遗忘；对多模态遗忘与概念级删除未覆盖。
limitations: 自适应调制依赖对目标置信度与集中度的估计；未评估再训练攻击下的残余记忆；超参敏感性未详报。

title: Certified Multi-Source Integrity for Structured Agent Actions
abstract: LLM agents increasingly take privileged, often irreversible structured actions, such as paying an invoice. They assemble each action from action-critical fields in documents and tool outputs that an adversary can corrupt, and indirect prompt injection can drive the model itself to extract attacker-chosen values. Current defenses gate on a source's trust label or certify free-text answer quality. None certifies the integrity of a coupled, policy-bound structured action under a corruption budget that accounts for shared upstream sources. We characterize when such an action is safely certifiable and give the maximally live safe certifier. It admits an action only when each field clears the rule its evidence structure supports: a bounded corruption radius over corruption-distinct evidence classes, counted by a minimum hitting set so that re-publishing or laundered copies cannot manufacture a quorum, deterministic reconciliation for complementary fields, and a trusted anchor where the evidence leaves a field single-sourced. We formalize two robustness notions, validate each mechanism by ablation, and measure how often the multi-source precondition holds on sanctions designations (70,966 entities) and software supply-chain provenance (450 packages). Under upper-bound proxies, genuine corroboration is a minority phenomenon in both, and naive attestation counting overstates it, since witnesses that look independent collapse to two corruption-distinct domains once shared origin is counted. Across five current models in a real agent loop, a realistic injection fools every model but one and a naive agent then executes the fraudulent action on most attacks. The certifier admits no unsafe action and recovers the correct value where corroboration permits, while action-gating and provenance baselines are broken in every world of our harness by some attack in its space.
comment: Accepted to the UK AI Conference 2026 (UKAI 2026), to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research. 14 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: this https URL
title_cn: 面向结构化智能体动作的认证多源完整性
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益执行特权且常不可逆的结构化动作，如支付发票。每个动作由文档与工具输出中动作关键字段组装而成，这些来源可被对手破坏，而间接提示注入可驱动模型本身提取攻击者选定的值。现有防御或基于来源信任标签门控、或认证自由文本答案质量，无一能在计入共享上游来源的破坏预算下认证耦合、策略绑定的结构化动作的完整性。我们刻画此类动作何时可安全认证，并给出最大活性的安全认证器。仅当每个字段通过其证据结构支持的规则时才准许动作：对腐败可区分证据类的有界破坏半径（以最小命中集计数，使重发布或洗白的副本无法制造法定人数）、互补字段的确定性调和、以及证据使字段单源化时的可信锚点。我们形式化两种鲁棒性概念、用消融验证各机制，并测量多源前提在制裁名单（70,966 实体）与软件供应链溯源（450 包）上的成立频率。在上界代理下，真正互证在两者中都是少数现象，且朴素证明计数高估它——看似独立的见证计入共享来源后坍缩到两个腐败可区分域。在真实智能体回路的五个当前模型上，现实的注入骗过除一个外的全部模型，朴素智能体随后在多数攻击上执行欺诈动作；认证器不准许任何不安全动作、并在互证允许处恢复正确值，而动作门控与溯源基线在我们测试空间的每个世界中都被某种攻击击破。UKAI 2026 录用。代码与数据公开。
summary_cn: 给出结构化智能体动作的多源完整性认证器：最小命中集计数的破坏半径+可信锚点；五模型真实回路中注入几乎全胜、认证器零不安全准入；制裁名单与供应链数据上真互证为少数。
objective_summary: 形式化策略绑定结构化动作在共享来源破坏预算下的可认证性，给出基于命中集法定人数与可信锚点的最大活性安全认证器并做消融与真实回路评估。
evidence_note: 形式化刻画+消融验证+两个真实数据集（70,966 实体、450 包）的成立率测量+五模型真实智能体回路的对抗测试与基线对照；代码数据公开。
novelty_note: 首次为耦合结构化动作给出计入共享来源的完整性认证，命中集法定人数防洗白为新机制。
scope: 结论适用于字段可由多源证据支撑的结构化动作；对纯单源、无证据结构的动作只能依赖可信锚点。
limitations: 多源前提在真实数据上常不成立，适用面受限；认证器的活性依赖证据结构质量；评估动作域限于发票类场景。

title: Long-Term Operational Planning Using Scenario-Based System Load Forecasting
abstract: The rapid expansion of hyperscale data centers is significantly increasing electricity demand in Northern Virginia. Dominion Energy, the region's primary electric utility, must reinforce its transmission network to support this growth. These projects require planned outages that must be evaluated months in advance to support construction planning and outage coordination while meeting NERC and PJM N-1 reliability requirements. Long-term outage studies are commonly performed day by day using monthly or seasonal peak-load assumptions. Although this approach simplifies analysis, it can be overly conservative because it does not capture granular load variability. Consequently, short-duration outages that may be feasible under realistic loading conditions are often postponed or denied, delaying critical transmission expansion and grid modernization projects. This paper evaluates the operational value of incorporating realistic multigranular load forecasts into long-term, contingency-based outage assessments and compares the results with conventional peak-based methods. Daily, weekly, and monthly forecasts are developed using statistical and machine-learning models, including SARIMA, Prophet, Gradient Boosting, and Random Forest, followed by bottom-up temporal reconciliation to maintain consistency across forecast horizons. Results show that granular load forecasts reduce unnecessary conservatism and improve outage accommodation, particularly for short-duration requests, without changing existing reliability criteria. The proposed approach can strengthen long-term outage coordination and support timely transmission reinforcement and grid modernization.
title_cn: 基于情景式系统负荷预测的长期运行规划
abstract_cn: 超大规模数据中心的快速扩张显著推高北弗吉尼亚的电力需求。Dominion Energy 作为该地区主要电力公司必须加强输电网络以支撑增长。这些工程需要提前数月评估的计划性停电，以支持建设规划与停电协调，同时满足 NERC 与 PJM 的 N-1 可靠性要求。长期停电研究通常按日、以月度或季度峰值负荷假设进行。该做法简化分析但可能过度保守——不捕捉细粒度负荷变化，导致在真实负荷下可行的短时停电被推迟或拒绝，延误关键输电扩建与电网现代化工程。本文评估把现实的多粒度负荷预测纳入长期、基于偶发的停电评估的运行价值，并与传统峰值法比较。使用 SARIMA、Prophet、Gradient Boosting 与 Random Forest 等统计与机器学习模型开发日、周、月预测，随后做自下而上的时间协调以保持跨预测视距一致。结果表明细粒度负荷预测在不改变既有可靠性判据的前提下减少不必要的保守性、改善停电容纳，尤其对短时请求。所提方法可强化长期停电协调，支持及时的输电加强与现代化。
summary_cn: 把 SARIMA/Prophet/GB/RF 多粒度负荷预测引入输电停电评估：相比月度峰值法减少保守性、改善短时停电容纳，且不改变 NERC/PJM N-1 可靠性判据。
objective_summary: 以真实电力公司场景比较基于机器学习多粒度负荷预测与传统峰值假设的长期停电评估效果。
evidence_note: 真实电力公司运行数据、四种预测模型加时间协调、与传统法的运行层面对比；无统计检验，结果以运营案例呈现。
novelty_note: 把成熟负荷预测技术用于停电规划评估，属既有方法的领域应用，方法本身无新机制。
scope: 结论限于北弗吉尼亚电网与该数据中心的负荷结构；对其他市场规则与负荷形态需重校。
limitations: 为单一电力公司案例；预测误差对保守性削减的敏感性未系统量化；未考虑极端天气下的预测失效。

title: Faultless: A Program Equivalence Technique for Validating and Evaluating Neural Decompilers
abstract: Neural decompilers are machine learning models which perform the process of decompilation, lifting code from a lower-level language to a higher one. Neural decompilers offer substantial utility relative to traditional deterministic decompilers because they can probabilistically recover information discarded during lowering, like variable names, types, and control flow structuring. However, they can also make mistakes, producing code that is not equivalent to the original, making it difficult to trust their output. In this work, we introduce Faultless, a program equivalence technique for performing translation validation on neural decompilers. Faultless compares code produced by a deterministic decompiler, which has stronger correctness properties, with that of a neural decompiler. Faultless is also useful for model evaluation, a highly related task, in which the neural decompilers' prediction is compared with a reference solution. Neural decompilation introduces significant challenges to the task of program equivalence which existing techniques are not equipped to handle, including limited extrafunctional context and systematic semantic inconsistencies in decompiled code. Faultless takes a static symbolic execution-based approach with an execution model and memory model designed to handle these challenges.
title_cn: Faultless：用于验证与评估神经反编译器的程序等价技术
abstract_cn: 神经反编译器是执行反编译——把代码从低级语言提升到高级语言——的机器学习模型。相较传统确定性反编译器，神经反编译器能概率性恢复在下译过程中被丢弃的信息，如变量名、类型与控制流结构化；但也可能出错，产生与原始代码不等价的代码，使其输出难以被信任。本工作提出 Faultless，一个对神经反编译器执行翻译验证的程序等价技术。Faultless 把确定性反编译器（具有更强正确性性质）的产出与神经反编译器的产出做比较。Faultless 也适用于高度相关的模型评估任务：把神经反编译器的预测与参照解比对。神经反编译给程序等价带来既有技术无法处理的重要挑战，包括有限的额外函数上下文与反编译代码中的系统性语义不一致。Faultless 采用静态符号执行方法，配备为应对这些挑战而设计的执行模型与内存模型。
summary_cn: 提出针对神经反编译器的翻译验证技术 Faultless：以静态符号执行比较确定性反编译器与神经反编译器输出，执行/内存模型专为有限上下文与语义不一致设计。
objective_summary: 提出用基于符号执行的程序等价检查验证神经反编译器输出的技术，处理有限上下文与系统性语义不一致两类挑战。
evidence_note: 摘要以方法设计为主，未报告定量评估数字或案例规模，属可行性层面的方法描述。
novelty_note: 把翻译验证引入神经反编译器这一新对象，需定制执行/内存模型，属既有技术在新生成物上的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于与确定性反编译器输出可比对的神经反编译场景；对无可信参照输出的场景不适用。
limitations: 摘要未给出评估结果与失效模式分析；符号执行的可扩展性未知；等价判定的完备性依赖参照反编译器质量。

title: LoRo-Mark:Provably Lossless and Robust Agent Watermarking
abstract: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed as commercial services, protecting proprietary orchestration logic and tool-use policies is important. We consider agent repackaging: an adversary integrates a protected agent into its own application via API and presents it under its own identity. It may modify parts of execution to obscure the source. The owner typically has only black-box access to the repackaged service, so black-box ownership verification is essential. Agent watermarking embeds ownership evidence into agent behavior for later verification. An effective watermark should satisfy two requirements: losslessness, preserving original functionality, and robustness, keeping ownership evidence recoverable after partial modification of execution. Existing methods often embed signals into behavior selection or execution trajectories, intervene in normal decisions, and offer limited robustness to behavior modification. We propose LoRo-Mark, a provably lossless and robust agent watermarking mechanism. For losslessness, it isolates watermarking into a cryptographically authenticated forensic branch that remains inactive during normal execution and is activated only by owner-authorized requests. By reducing unauthorized branch activation to standard MAC security, LoRo-Mark formally guarantees performance preservation. For robustness, it redundantly distributes ownership information across forensic behavior sequences, enabling reliable recovery under partial behavior substitution and sequence truncation. Experiments across multiple LLM agents show zero degradation on normal tasks and reliable ownership verification under sequence modifications.
title_cn: LoRo-Mark：可证明无损且鲁棒的智能体水印
abstract_cn: 随着 LLM 智能体日益作为商业服务部署，保护专有编排逻辑与工具使用策略变得重要。我们考虑智能体重打包：对手经 API 把受保护智能体集成进自己的应用并以自己的身份呈现，还可能修改部分执行以混淆来源。所有者通常只有对重打包服务的黑盒访问，因此黑盒所有权验证必不可少。智能体水印把所有权证据嵌入智能体行为以便后续验证。有效水印须满足两个要求：无损——保留原功能；鲁棒——执行被部分修改后所有权证据仍可恢复。既有方法常把信号嵌入行为选择或执行轨迹、干预正常决策，对行为修改的鲁棒性有限。我们提出 LoRo-Mark，一个可证明无损且鲁棒的智能体水印机制。无损方面，它把水印隔离进密码学认证的取证分支：正常执行期间保持不活跃，仅由所有者授权的请求激活。通过把未授权分支激活归约到标准 MAC 安全，LoRo-Mark 形式化保证性能保留。鲁棒方面，它把所有权信息冗余分布于取证行为序列，支持部分行为替换与序列截断下的可靠恢复。跨多个 LLM 智能体的实验显示正常任务零退化，且序列修改下所有权验证可靠。
summary_cn: 可证明无损的智能体水印 LoRo-Mark：所有权证据隔离进 MAC 认证的休眠取证分支（正常任务零退化），冗余分布支撑部分替换/截断下的可靠验证。
objective_summary: 提出把水印隔离进认证休眠分支以形式化保证无损、以冗余取证序列保证鲁棒的智能体水印机制，并跨多个智能体验证。
evidence_note: 跨多 LLM 智能体的零退化实测与修改下恢复实验、MAC 归约完整；摘要未给出具体恢复率数字与基线对比。
novelty_note: 以认证休眠分支把「水印不干预正常行为」从经验性质升级为可证明保证，属机制层面的实质推进。
scope: 结论适用于黑盒访问、可触发取证分支的智能体服务；对完全无 API 钩子的纯推理部署不适用。
limitations: 需所有者能向目标服务发送授权激活请求；对语义级重编排（非行为替换）的鲁棒性未量化；MAC 密钥管理未讨论。

title: PerceptFence: Content-Mediation Architecture and Deterministic Coverage for Screen-Share AI Assistants
abstract: Live screen-share AI assistants observe raw screen and speech streams, but users have little runtime control over what an assistant may observe, retain, or disclose. Prompt-level privacy settings are insufficient because sensitive content enters through the capture stream. We present PerceptFence, a content-layer mediation architecture between capture, memory, and model responses, with a deterministic synthetic-fixture scaffold; the artifact omits live capture, category inference, authenticated re-consent, cross-session state, and an external model adapter. On 9,600 protocol-documented adversarial strings scored by a separately implemented exposure oracle, PerceptFence neutralises 0.828 of digit-PII payloads on the 5 seeds both systems run, versus 0.183 for Microsoft Presidio; outside that family Presidio leads 0.238 to 0.154, so the overall 0.398 to 0.260 comparison is only indicative. We then evaluate the path a deployed assistant uses: 480 synthetic developer-support screens rendered by Chrome, degraded, and read by OCR, with rules frozen before testing and three screen types held out. PerceptFence neutralises 889 of 968 OCR-surviving secrets and PII values (0.918; Wilson 95% 0.899-0.934) against 0.581 for Presidio and 0.179 for gitleaks, and 0.974 on the held-out screen types, at a measured cost of 0.763 task-token retention on those types. The contribution is a documented mediation architecture and an evaluation method with explicit coverage boundaries, not a claim of live deployment, formal privacy, novel redaction primitives, or general model robustness.
comment: 32 pages, 7 tables, 2 figures. Code, frozen protocol, and per-case results: this https URL (release v0.4.0); archived software DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21289219
title_cn: PerceptFence：屏幕共享 AI 助手的内容中介架构与确定性覆盖评估
abstract_cn: 实时屏幕共享 AI 助手观察原始屏幕与语音流，但用户对助手可观察、保留或披露什么几乎没有运行时控制。提示级隐私设置不充分，因为敏感内容经由采集流进入。我们提出 PerceptFence，一个位于采集、记忆与模型响应之间的内容层中介架构，配确定性合成夹具脚手架；工件不含实时采集、类别推断、经认证的再同意、跨会话状态与外部模型适配器。在 9,600 条协议记录的对抗字符串上、由独立实现的暴露神谕评分，PerceptFence 在两系统共同运行的 5 个种子上中和 0.828 的数字 PII 载荷，Microsoft Presidio 为 0.183；该家族之外 Presidio 以 0.238 领先于 0.154，故 0.398 对 0.260 的总体对比仅具指示性。我们随后评估部署助手使用的路径：480 块由 Chrome 渲染、退化处理并被 OCR 读取的合成开发者支持屏幕，规则在测试前冻结、三类屏幕留出。PerceptFence 中和 968 个 OCR 幸存秘密与 PII 值中的 889 个（0.918；Wilson 95% 0.899–0.934），对照 Presidio 0.581 与 gitleaks 0.179；在留出屏幕类型上 0.974，代价为 0.763 的任务 token 保留率。本文贡献是文档化的中介架构与带显式覆盖边界的评估方法，不主张实时部署、形式化隐私、新式脱敏原语或通用模型鲁棒性。32 页、7 表、2 图。代码、冻结协议与逐案结果见 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21289219。
summary_cn: 屏幕共享助手的内容层中介架构 PerceptFence：480 块 OCR 屏幕上中和 0.918 的秘密/PII（Presidio 0.581、gitleaks 0.179），留出类型 0.974，任务 token 保留 0.763。
objective_summary: 提出采集-记忆-响应之间的内容中介架构，并用确定性合成夹具与独立暴露神谕量化其相对 Presidio/gitleaks 的覆盖与代价。
evidence_note: 9,600 条对抗字符串+480 块冻结规则下的 OCR 屏幕、独立实现的神谕、Wilson 区间与留出类型、工件与逐案结果公开；全合成设定，作者明示边界。
novelty_note: 把脱敏从提示策略下沉到采集内容层并给出可复现的覆盖评估方法；脱敏原语本身为组合既有技术。
scope: 结论适用于屏幕内容脱敏的合成基准与文本/数字型秘密；不覆盖实时采集、语音内容与跨会话攻击。
limitations: 全合成屏幕与字符串，真实共享会话分布未验证；数字 PII 家族外覆盖不及 Presidio；未含形式化隐私保证。

title: DeMark: A Query-Free Black-Box Attack for Quality-Preserving Audio Watermark Removal
abstract: Audio watermarking protects digital speech by embedding imperceptible signals for ownership verification and misuse tracing. However, the security of learning-based watermarking remains insufficiently understood under realistic adversarial removal, where attackers cannot access or query the watermark encoder, decoder, or detector. Existing attacks either rely on model feedback, require clean-watermarked pairs, or reconstruct the waveform with generative models, often leading to high query costs, limited generalization, or degraded perceptual quality. In this paper, we propose DeMark, a query-free black-box attack for quality-preserving audio watermark removal. Our key insight is that watermark embedding, while perceptually hidden, can introduce subtle non-speech artifacts in the time-frequency domain that are not fully aligned with natural speech. DeMark removes watermarks by suppressing these artifacts through two stages: Diverse Artifact Learning, which extracts complementary non-stationary and stationary artifact patterns, and Adaptive Artifact Scaling, which adaptively combines and amplifies them under quality-preserving constraints. Across two speech datasets and four state-of-the-art watermarking methods, DeMark achieves average attack success rates of 0.92 and 0.96 while consistently preserving higher perceptual quality than existing adaptive attacks. These results reveal a practical vulnerability of current audio watermarking systems and call for more robust watermark designs against query-free adversarial removal.
title_cn: DeMark：面向保质量音频水印移除的免查询黑盒攻击
abstract_cn: 音频水印通过嵌入不可感知信号保护数字语音，用于所有权验证与滥用追踪。然而学习型水印在现实对抗移除下的安全性仍了解不足——攻击者无法访问或查询水印编码器、解码器或检测器。既有攻击或依赖模型反馈、或需要干净-水印对、或用生成模型重建波形，常带来高查询成本、有限泛化或感知质量退化。我们提出 DeMark，一个保质量的免查询黑盒音频水印移除攻击。关键洞见是水印嵌入虽在感知上隐藏，却会在时频域引入与自然语音不完全对齐的细微非语音伪迹。DeMark 通过两阶段抑制这些伪迹以移除水印：多样伪迹学习提取互补的非平稳与平稳伪迹模式，自适应伪迹缩放 在保质量约束下自适应组合并放大它们。跨两个语音数据集与四种最先进水印方法，DeMark 平均攻击成功率 0.92 与 0.96，同时保持比既有自适应攻击更高的感知质量。这些结果揭示当前音频水印系统的实际脆弱性，呼吁对免查询对抗移除更鲁棒的水印设计。
summary_cn: 免查询黑盒音频水印移除 DeMark：以时频非语音伪迹抑制为目标，两数据集×四水印方法平均 ASR 0.92/0.96 且感知质量优于自适应攻击。
objective_summary: 提出不访问水印模型的免查询移除攻击，通过学习并自适应放大嵌入伪迹移除水印，跨数据集与方法量化成功率与质量。
evidence_note: 两语音数据集×四种水印方法、与自适应攻击的成功率与质量对比；无统计检验，水印方法集合为公开 SOTA。
novelty_note: 首个针对音频水印的免查询黑盒移除，把「嵌入伪迹与自然语音错位」确立为可利用的结构性弱点，机制实质。
scope: 结论适用于学习型后处理音频水印；对生成时嵌入或密码学承诺型方案未覆盖。
limitations: 重建的语音在极端压缩下的鲁棒性未测；评估限于四种水印方法；防御（如伪迹整形）未讨论。

title: GateDrain: Availability Attacks and Admission-Side Defense for Confidence-Gated Edge-Cloud Inference
abstract: Confidence-gated edge--cloud inference accepts confident local predictions and offloads uncertain inputs to a stronger cloud model. We show that this routing decision creates an availability attack surface. We call this attack \emph{GateDrain}: bounded input perturbations lower calibrated confidence and redirect requests that would otherwise be answered locally into a shared cloud queue, without increasing the application request rate. Because escalated requests share a cloud service, an increase in per-request cloud demand can move a near-capacity deployment across a queueing knee, causing disproportionate tail-latency degradation for benign users. We evaluate white-box, transfer, decision-only, universal, and multi-gate attacks on the public EdgeBoost artifact. A fixed-application-volume comparison isolates the effect of confidence manipulation from added client traffic, while perturbation-budget and arrival-process sweeps show that the queueing transition persists across several workload models but its amplification depends on the operating point. Adaptive attacks also defeat the evaluated training-free preprocessing defenses. To contain the resulting cloud demand, we evaluate Bounded Escalation, which combines per-source admission budgets, protected capacity, and non-preemptive trusted-class priority; an optional global bucket adds an identity-independent bound on untrusted admissions. The evaluation makes the resulting policy trade-off explicit: authenticated clients receive latency isolation, whereas tighter aggregate containment can reject legitimate unauthenticated offloads and reduce overall expected accuracy through edge fallback.
title_cn: GateDrain：置信门控边云推理的可用性攻击与准入侧防御
abstract_cn: 置信门控边云推理接受本地高置信预测、把不确定输入卸载到更强云模型。我们证明这一路由决策创造可用性攻击面。我们把该攻击称为 GateDrain：有界输入扰动压低校准置信度，把本可本地应答的请求重定向进共享云队列，而不增加应用请求速率。由于升级请求共享云服务，单请求云需求增加可使接近容量的部署越过排队拐点，造成良性用户尾时延的不成比例恶化。我们在公开 EdgeBoost 工件上评估白盒、迁移、仅决策、通用与多门攻击。固定应用量对比把置信操纵的效果与额外客户端流量分离；扰动预算与到达过程扫描表明排队跃迁在多种负载模型下持续，但放大程度取决于工作点。自适应攻击也击败被评估的免训练预处理防御。为遏制云需求，我们评估结合按来源准入预算、受保护容量与非抢占可信类优先级的 Bounded Escalation；可选全局桶为不可信准入提供身份无关上界。评估把策略权衡显式化：认证客户端获得时延隔离，而更紧的总量遏制可能拒绝合法的未认证卸载并通过边缘回退降低总体期望精度。
summary_cn: GateDrain 可用性攻击：有界扰动压低置信把请求挤入共享云队列、越过排队拐点恶化尾时延；EdgeBoost 上多攻击变体验证，Bounded Escalation 以拒绝部分合法卸载换取遏制。
objective_summary: 揭示置信门控边云推理的可用性攻击面，量化扰动驱动的队列拐点效应与负载敏感性，并评估准入侧防御的权衡。
evidence_note: 公开 EdgeBoost 工件、五种攻击变体、固定流量对照与到达过程扫描、防御权衡量化；排队模型为仿真设定，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次把置信门控路由确立为可用性攻击面并连接排队拐点放大效应，威胁模型与防御均为新机制。
scope: 结论适用于置信门控+共享云容量的推理架构；攻击效果依赖接近容量的工作点；对多租户隔离已完善的系统影响减小。
limitations: 评估基于公开工件与仿真排队，真实云部署验证缺失；防御以未认证卸载的拒绝与精度损失为代价；自适应防御（如再校准）未覆盖。

title: The Privacy Fallacy of Crowdsourced Fine-Tuning: Extracting Proprietary Data via Topic-Based Poisoning
abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely used to adapt large language models to downstream tasks. Crowdsourcing user conversations is an established approach to collecting SFT data at scale while reducing the need for costly manual annotation. However, it also allows untrusted users to contribute data to the fine-tuning pipeline. We investigate an underexplored privacy risk arising from this setting: can a malicious user poison a small fraction of the crowdsourced data to amplify extraction of previously unseen instructions contributed by other users? We show that this is possible using only black-box, output-only access to the deployed model. Experiments across four models and two datasets demonstrate substantial increases in training-data extraction: with only 50 poisoned examples, near-verbatim extraction reaches $3.71\times$ the rate without poisoning for Qwen2.5-14B on OpenMathInstruct and $3.08\times$ for Llama-3.1-8B on AceReason. Data filtering also proves largely ineffective in detecting poisoned samples: even the best-performing method achieves only 0.378 in F-1 score, leaving the majority of poisoned samples undetected. These findings demonstrate that seemingly benign crowdsourced contributions can amplify leakage of other records while remaining difficult to identify through data filtering.
title_cn: 众包微调的隐私谬论：经主题投毒提取专有数据
abstract_cn: 监督微调（SFT）被广泛用于让大语言模型适配下游任务。众包用户对话是在规模上收集 SFT 数据、减少昂贵人工标注的成熟做法，但也让不可信用户得以向微调管线贡献数据。我们研究该设定下一个未被探索的隐私风险：恶意用户能否投毒一小部分众包数据，放大对其他用户先前未见指令的提取？我们证明仅凭对部署模型的黑盒、仅输出访问即可做到。跨四个模型与两个数据集的实验显示训练数据提取大幅增加：仅 50 条投毒样本，Qwen2.5-14B 在 OpenMathInstruct 上的近逐字提取达到无投毒时的 3.71 倍，Llama-3.1-8B 在 AceReason 上为 3.08 倍。数据过滤也基本无法检出投毒样本：表现最好的方法 F-1 仅 0.378，多数投毒样本未被发现。这些发现表明看似良性的众包贡献可以在难以被过滤识别的同时放大其他记录的泄漏。
summary_cn: 众包 SFT 投毒放大他人数据提取：仅 50 条投毒样本使 Qwen2.5-14B 近逐字提取达 3.71 倍（Llama-3.1-8B 3.08 倍），最佳过滤器 F-1 仅 0.378。
objective_summary: 证明恶意众包贡献者可用少量主题投毒样本放大部署模型对其他用户指令的提取，并量化主流数据过滤的失效。
evidence_note: 四模型×两数据集的受控 SFT 实验、提取率倍数量化、过滤基线评估（F-1 0.378）；无统计检验，提取判定依赖近似匹配协议。
novelty_note: 首次把投毒确立为跨用户提取放大器，威胁模型（众包 SFT 供应链中的隐私风险）为新。
scope: 结论适用于开放众包贡献的 SFT 管线与指令式数据；对 RLHF 偏好数据或闭源审核管线未验证。
limitations: 投毒主题需与目标数据分布相关；提取判定的阈值选择影响倍数；防御评估限于过滤，未测差分隐私等训练时防御。

title: TrackFlood: Relocating Latency Attacks from NMS-Free Detectors to Real-Time Trackers
abstract: We consider latency attacks on object detectors, where the attacker's goal is not to corrupt a prediction but to make the system fail to respond in time, targeting real-time applications such as autonomous driving. Modern object detectors eliminate Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) through one-to-one assignment or set prediction, removing the classical detector-side latency bottleneck exploited by prior latency (``sponge'') attacks. We show that NMS-free does not mean latency-robust: this architectural change does not eliminate the attack surface but relocates it downstream to multi-object tracking, whose data-association cost remains content dependent. We present \emph{TrackFlood}, a unified white-box overload attack against NMS-free detect-then-track pipelines spanning both one-to-one detectors (YOLOv10 and YOLO26) and query-based detectors (RT-DETR). TrackFlood recovers differentiable confidence tensors and optimizes perturbations that flood the tracker with spatially distributed phantom detections while leaving detector inference unchanged. Evaluated entirely on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin (TensorRT FP16), detector latency remains essentially constant, whereas tracker latency increases substantially. At a standard imperceptible budget ($L_\infty{=}8/255$), a universal perturbation produces clearly measurable tracker overload but only modest end-to-end slowdown, without deadline misses for the association-dominated trackers; a separate higher-budget stress test drives severe end-to-end slowdowns and sustained deadline misses. We further evaluate a lightweight, architecture-agnostic bounded-admission layer that caps the tracker workload and largely restores end-to-end latency, at a non-trivial cost in admitted clean detections. Our results demonstrate that evaluating NMS-free perception systems requires considering downstream tracking and end-to-end timing, not detector inference alone.
title_cn: TrackFlood：把时延攻击从无 NMS 检测器迁移到实时跟踪器
abstract_cn: 我们研究针对目标检测器的时延攻击：攻击者目标不是破坏预测，而是让系统无法及时响应，瞄准自动驾驶等实时应用。现代检测器通过一对一分配或集合预测消除非极大值抑制（NMS），移除了此前时延（海绵）攻击利用的经典检测端瓶颈。我们证明无 NMS 不等于时延鲁棒：该架构变化并未消除攻击面，而是把它向下游迁移到多目标跟踪——其数据关联成本仍依赖内容。我们提出 TrackFlood，一个针对无 NMS 检测-跟踪管线的统一白盒过载攻击，覆盖一对一检测器（YOLOv10、YOLO26）与查询式检测器（RT-DETR）。TrackFlood 恢复可微置信度张量，优化让跟踪器被空间分布的幻影检测淹没的扰动，同时保持检测器推理不变。全部评估在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin（TensorRT FP16）上进行：检测器时延基本不变，跟踪器时延显著上升。在标准不可感知预算（L∞=8/255）下，通用扰动产生明确可测的跟踪器过载但端到端减速有限，对关联主导的跟踪器无期限失约；单独的高预算压力测试则造成严重端到端减速与持续期限失约。我们进一步评估一个轻量、架构无关的有界准入层，它限制跟踪器负载并大体恢复端到端时延，代价是相当比例的干净检测被拒绝。结果表明评估无 NMS 感知系统必须考虑下游跟踪与端到端时序，而非仅检测器推理。
summary_cn: 证明无 NMS 检测器仍不时延鲁棒：TrackFlood 白盒扰动使 Jetson Orin 上跟踪器（YOLOv10/YOLO26/RT-DETR 管线）过载，检测时延不变；高预算可致持续期限失约，有界准入层可恢复。
objective_summary: 揭示 NMS-Free 检测-跟踪管线的下游关联瓶颈并构造统一白盒过载攻击，在真实边缘硬件上量化检测器/跟踪器/端到端时延与准入防御效果。
evidence_note: 真实 Jetson AGX Orin+TensorRT FP16、三类检测器、预算扫描与防御对照（准入层代价量化）；白盒假设为已声明边界。
novelty_note: 首次把时延攻击面从 NMS 瓶颈重定位到跟踪数据关联，纠正「无 NMS 即时延安全」的误判，攻击与防御均有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于检测-跟踪实时管线与内容依赖的数据关联实现；对纯检测系统或事件相机等新范式不直接适用。
limitations: 标准预算下端到端减速有限、需高预算才致期限失约；白盒梯度访问在实际部署中受限；防御以牺牲干净检测为代价。

title: A2A-ForensicTrace: Offline Verification of Tamper-Evident A2A Runtime Evidence
abstract: Security-relevant Agent2Agent (A2A) executions can cross organizational boundaries, leaving investigators without live access to all participating systems. Offline investigation involves checking preserved records and their cross-record relationships for consistency. This paper presents A2A-ForensicTrace, an offline verification layer that converts runtime observations into typed records, derives protocol-relevant relationships, and commits both under an incident-trace root. An Ed25519-signed receipt binds the root and capture digest to the incident context. Evaluation comprised 240 executions through the official A2A software development kit (SDK), with actions selected by a large language model (LLM). These included 120 condition runs and 120 matched controls. All condition runs returned the expected bounded findings. No control produced an indication, and all roots and receipts verified. Median in-memory latency of the full offline verifier was 1.61 ms for the scenario traces. In the separate scaling experiment, it was 30.85 ms at 1,000 committed leaves. Future work will broaden A2A lifecycle coverage.
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at IEEE IEMCON 2026
title_cn: A2A-ForensicTrace：防篡改 A2A 运行时证据的离线校验
abstract_cn: 涉及安全的智能体到智能体（A2A）执行可能跨越组织边界，调查者无法实时访问全部参与系统。离线调查需要核查保留记录及其跨记录关系的一致性。本文提出 A2A-ForensicTrace，一个离线校验层：把运行时观测转换为类型化记录，推导协议相关关系，并把两者在事件轨迹根下提交。Ed25519 签名收据把根与采集摘要绑定到事件上下文。评估包含 240 次经官方 A2A SDK 的执行，动作由 LLM 选择，含 120 次条件运行与 120 次匹配对照。全部条件运行返回预期的有界发现，没有对照产生指示，所有根与收据均验证通过。离线校验器全流程内存中位延迟 1.61 毫秒；独立扩展实验中 1,000 个已提交叶子时为 30.85 毫秒。未来工作将扩展 A2A 生命周期覆盖。9 页、4 图，IEEE IEMCON 2026 录用。
summary_cn: A2A 运行时证据防篡改离线校验层：240 次 SDK 执行（120 条件+120 对照）全部符合预期，校验中位延迟 1.61ms（1,000 叶 30.85ms）。
objective_summary: 提出把 A2A 运行时观测转为类型化记录并做根提交与签名收据的离线取证校验层，用 SDK 执行与匹配对照验证检出与开销。
evidence_note: 240 次 SDK 执行、条件/对照设计规范、延迟量化；但场景规模小、攻击类型有限，9 页会议论文（IEMCON 2026）。
novelty_note: 把防篡改证据提交引入 A2A 取证为新的场景组合；哈希链+签名提交为成熟技术。
scope: 结论适用于保留运行时观测且证据链完整的 A2A 部署；对记录源头即被篡改的场景无效。
limitations: 动作空间与条件类型有限；1,000 叶的扩展上限较小；与真实多组织调查流程的适配未验证。

title: Training Witnesses: Trusting the Training without Trusting the Trainer
abstract: Progress in machine learning cannot outpace our ability to verify it. With an explosion in papers today, every scientific claim rests initially on trust in the trainer, leading to uneven evaluation, baselines, and forestalling of reliable progress. Traditionally, the burden of verification falls on the reader, who must reproduce expensive training runs. This strategy is impractical due to an explosion in slop contributions, diversity of methods, and the sheer compute required. We put the burden of proof where it belongs, on the trainer, and in the process also cut the overall cost of verification significantly. We introduce Witnesses, a method for certifying training, data usage and evaluation in a neural network training run. Our key insight is that fast behavioral fingerprints with occasional replay challenges are sufficient for auditing neural network training. Our method is applicable at scale with minimal overhead to the trainer, is cheap for the verifier, rejects bad training runs with amplifiable probability, and allows for exact queries of both data inclusion and exclusion. We test our method on language model training runs from 100M to 2B scales, across DDP and FSDP, and demonstrate this minimal overhead. We also introduce a self-regulating leaderboard of "auto-certified" training runs that enables shared baselines and progress. We invite the community to participate in the leaderboard to improve reproducibility in machine learning.
comment: 10 pages, 15 appendix pages, 17 figures
title_cn: 训练见证：不信任训练者也能信任训练
abstract_cn: 机器学习的进展无法超越我们验证它的能力。随着论文爆炸式增长，每个科学主张最初都建立在对训练者的信任上，导致评估不均、基线失衡并阻碍可靠进展。传统上验证负担落在读者身上——必须复现昂贵的训练运行。鉴于低质投稿激增、方法多样与算力巨大，该策略不切实际。我们把举证责任放回其所属的训练者，并大幅削减验证总成本。我们提出 Witnesses，一种认证神经网络训练运行中训练、数据使用与评估的方法。关键洞见是：快速行为指纹加偶发重放挑战足以审计神经网络训练。该方法以对训练者的最小开销规模化适用、对验证者廉价、以可放大概率拒绝不良训练运行，并允许对数据包含与排除做精确查询。我们在 100M 到 2B 规模的语言模型训练运行上、跨 DDP 与 FSDP 测试该方法并证明最小开销。我们还引入「自动认证」训练运行的自调节排行榜，支持共享基线与进展。我们邀请社区参与排行榜以改善机器学习的可复现性。10 页正文、15 页附录、17 图。
summary_cn: 提出训练运行认证原语 Witnesses：行为指纹+偶发重放挑战即可审计训练与数据使用，100M–2B 语言模型、DDP/FSDP 上开销极小，支持包含/排除精确查询。
objective_summary: 提出以行为指纹与重放挑战认证训练运行与数据使用的方法，在大规模语言模型训练上验证开销与检测概率，并建立自动认证排行榜。
evidence_note: 100M–2B 规模、DDP/FSDP 双并行、开销实测、拒绝概率可放大；对手模型（训练者作弊方式）覆盖有限，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把「训练声明」变为可认证对象并支持包含/排除精确查询，是训练诚信基础设施的实质新原语。
scope: 结论适用于神经网络训练运行的行为级审计；对权重窃取、数据值篡改等行为不可见作弊需补充机制。
limitations: 指纹与重放覆盖的训练性质有限；排行榜的采纳依赖社区激励；对抗自适应训练者的博弈未充分分析。

title: A2A-CaseVerify: Merkle-Linked Case-Evidence Verification for Cross-Organization A2A Workflows
abstract: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication enables large language model (LLM) agents to exchange tasks, messages, and artifacts across organizations. A valid message alone does not establish that a final workflow claim is supported by a complete, ordered, and case-consistent evidence path. We present A2A-CaseVerify, a deterministic offline verifier that maps preserved A2A runtime objects, business events, and typed support edges to a directed case evidence graph. It commits A2A envelopes, event projections, and support edges, then combines event and edge leaves into a deterministic case Merkle root. The verifier returns SUPPORTED with status OK only when protection and profile-specific reconstruction checks pass. We evaluate one canonical supported healthcare-profile bundle and 13 controlled mutations. We separately test a valid bundle generated with the official Python A2A software development kit (SDK). In these tests, the canonical and SDK-generated bundles are accepted. All 13 mutations are rejected, and each returned reason-code set contains its targeted diagnostic code. A2A-CaseVerify adds offline case-level evidence-support verification to A2A interoperability.
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at IEEE IEMCON 2026
title_cn: A2A-CaseVerify：跨组织 A2A 工作流的 Merkle 链接案例证据校验
abstract_cn: 智能体到智能体（A2A）通信使 LLM 智能体跨组织交换任务、消息与工件。有效消息本身并不能确立最终工作流主张由完整、有序且案例一致的证据路径支撑。我们提出 A2A-CaseVerify，一个确定性离线校验器：把保留的 A2A 运行时对象、业务事件与类型化支撑边映射为有向案例证据图；提交 A2A 封套、事件投影与支撑边，再把事件与边叶子组合成确定性的案例 Merkle 根。仅当保护与档案特定的重建检查全部通过时，校验器才返回 SUPPORTED 与状态 OK。我们在一个规范的受支持医疗档案包与 13 个受控变异上评估；另用官方 Python A2A SDK 单独测试一个有效包。测试中规范包与 SDK 生成包均被接受，全部 13 个变异被拒绝，且返回的原因码集合都含其针对性诊断码。A2A-CaseVerify 为 A2A 互操作补充了离线的案例级证据支撑校验。9 页、4 图，IEEE IEMCON 2026 录用。
summary_cn: A2A 案例级证据校验器：把运行时对象映射为证据图并提交案例 Merkle 根，13 个受控变异全部被拒、规范与 SDK 生成包均通过。
objective_summary: 提出把 A2A 运行时证据映射为案例证据图并做 Merkle 根提交的离线校验器，用受控变异与官方 SDK 包验证其接受/拒绝行为。
evidence_note: 1 个规范包+13 个变异+1 个 SDK 包的接受/拒绝测试，评估规模很小；9 页会议论文（IEMCON 2026）；无对抗性实验。
novelty_note: 把案例级证据支撑语义引入 A2A 工作流校验为新的场景组合；Merkle 提交与确定性重放为成熟技术。
scope: 结论适用于保留完整运行时对象且遵循所设档案的 A2A 部署；对部分证据丢失或恶意合谋节点未覆盖。
limitations: 评估规模极小（15 个包）；对证据图构造错误的鲁棒性未测；与真实跨组织工作流的集成未验证。

title: Near-Duplicate Families Break Exact-Record Membership Inference
abstract: Membership inference (MI) asks whether a specific record appeared in a model's training set and is increasingly used as evidence for data provenance and copyright auditing. These applications require determining whether the exact queried record was used for training, rather than merely whether the model was exposed to similar content. Making this distinction is challenging because web-scale datasets naturally contain near-duplicates, including syndicated articles, mirrored pages, and lightly modified images. We show that this creates a fundamental confound for standard MI. A clean-reference audit typically calibrates membership against a null in which neither the queried record nor its near-duplicate family is present. In deployment, however, the queried record may be absent while a non-identical family member was used for training. We introduce a four-world audit that independently varies exact-record inclusion and family presence to separate these cases. Natural near-duplicate families cause severe false attribution. On CC-News, a clean-reference LiRA auditor labels 99.70% of family-present exact non-members as members at 1.00% false-positive rate. This failure persists across alternative scores, model architectures, and executed deduplication and retraining. Controlled interventions further reveal that the effect depends on the learning objective. In classification, faithful families largely substitute for the exact record, reducing exact-given-family inference to near chance. In autoregressive language modeling, the exact sequence retains a detectable residual, while family presence still confounds clean-reference decisions. These results show that positive model-only membership evidence may establish family-level exposure without establishing exact-record provenance.
title_cn: 近重复家族破坏精确记录级成员推断
abstract_cn: 成员推断（MI）询问特定记录是否出现在模型训练集中，日益被用作数据溯源与版权审计证据。这些应用要求判定被查询的精确记录是否用于训练，而非模型是否接触过相似内容。做出该区分很困难，因为网络规模数据集天然包含近重复：联合转载文章、镜像页面、轻度修改图像。我们证明这给标准 MI 制造根本性混淆。干净参照审计通常把成员资格校准在「被查记录及其近重复家族都不在」的原假设上；部署中被查记录可能缺席而非同的家族成员被用于训练。我们引入独立变化精确记录包含与家族存在的四世界审计来分离这些情况。自然近重复家族造成严重错误归因：在 CC-News 上，干净参照 LiRA 审计在 1.00% 假阳性率下把 99.70% 的「家族在场但精确记录缺席」非成员标为成员。该失效跨备选分数、模型架构与实际执行的去重重训持续存在。受控干预进一步揭示效果依赖学习目标：分类任务中忠实的家族基本替代精确记录，把「家族条件下精确推断」压至接近随机；自回归语言建模中精确序列保留可检测残差，但家族在场仍混淆干净参照决策。结果表明仅凭模型的正成员证据可确立家族级暴露，却不能确立精确记录溯源。
summary_cn: 揭示 MI 用于溯源/版权审计的根本混淆：CC-News 上 LiRA 在 1% FPR 下把 99.70%「家族在场、精确记录缺席」非成员误判为成员，提出四世界审计分离。
objective_summary: 证明近重复家族对精确记录级成员推断造成系统性错误归因，提出独立变化记录包含与家族存在的四世界审计并跨分数、架构与目标量化。
evidence_note: CC-News 大规模实验、四世界受控干预、跨备选分数/架构/去重重训的稳健性检查、分类与 AR-LM 目标对照；量化清晰。
novelty_note: 首次把「家族级暴露≠记录级溯源」确立为 MI 作审计证据的根本混淆，四世界审计为方法学实质贡献。
scope: 结论适用于含自然近重复的网络规模语料与干净参照型 MI；对人工构造的强去重管线残余风险给出部分覆盖。
limitations: 审计需家族成员知识，部署条件难以满足；其他审计器（非 LiRA）未穷尽；版权法律意义上的「使用」未被讨论。

title: Can Prompt Anonymity Protect Your Identity From LLM Providers?
abstract: User conversations with large language models (LLMs) often contain highly sensitive personal information that can be exploited by LLM providers to create detailed user dossiers, enable targeted advertising, and train more powerful models. To protect user privacy, anonymizing LLM proxies have emerged as a practical solution that separates user identity from their prompts, yet this approach still leaves the prompt content visible to LLM providers. We study the impact of this gap by conducting the first empirical investigation into the risk of prompt authorship re-identification. Towards this end, we create PromptAnonBench, a novel benchmark for evaluating prompt anonymity, consisting of over 175,000 cleaned, authentic multi-turn user prompts from various real-world datasets (SWE-Chat and WildChat). Using the embeddings of historical user conversations, an attacker can correctly detect and re-identify at least one anonymized conversation for 50--75% of SWE-Chat users and up to 10% of WildChat users at a 10% false acceptance rate for out-of-set users, even with text-based defenses applied. Our findings unveil the risk of relying only on anonymity for private LLM inference and the gap in existing text privacy defenses.
title_cn: 提示匿名能保护你的身份免受 LLM 服务商识别吗？
abstract_cn: 用户与大语言模型的对话常包含高度敏感的个人信息，可被 LLM 服务商用于建立详细用户档案、定向广告与训练更强模型。为保护隐私，匿名化 LLM 代理成为把用户身份与提示分离的实用方案，但提示内容对服务商仍可见。我们通过首个提示作者身份重识别风险实证研究考察这一缺口的影响。为此我们构建 PromptAnonBench，一个评估提示匿名性的新基准，含来自真实数据集（SWE-Chat 与 WildChat）逾 175,000 条清洗后的真实多轮用户提示。利用历史用户对话的嵌入，攻击者可在 10% 的非集合用户错误接受率下，对 50–75% 的 SWE-Chat 用户正确检测并重识别至少一条匿名化对话，WildChat 用户至多 10%——即使施加基于文本的防御。这些发现揭示仅依赖匿名性做私有 LLM 推理的风险，以及现有文本隐私防御的缺口。
summary_cn: 首个提示作者重识别实证研究 PromptAnonBench（17.5 万条真实多轮提示）：10% FAR 下 SWE-Chat 用户 50–75% 可被重识别，文本防御无效。
objective_summary: 构建大规模真实提示基准，量化基于对话嵌入的作者重识别攻击对匿名化 LLM 代理的有效性并评估文本防御。
evidence_note: 逾 175,000 条真实多轮提示、FAR 条件化的检出率量化（50–75% / ≤10%）、防御对照实验；两数据集代表性受限为已声明。
novelty_note: 首次系统量化「匿名化代理仍可被作者重识别」的风险，攻击面（对话嵌入指纹）为新的隐私威胁。
scope: 结论适用于长历史多轮对话可得的匿名化代理场景；对强语义改写与差分隐私防御的效果未充分评估。
limitations: 重识别依赖用户历史对话积累；两数据集的编码实践与真实代理产品可能有差距；防御评估限于文本级方案。

title: No Free Efficiency: Revisiting the Trade-off Between Training Efficiency and Model Vulnerability
abstract: Training efficiency has become the central driver of recent progress in foundation models. To overcome the massive computational and data requirements of large-scale training, researchers increasingly adopt strategies such as selective data sampling, efficient pre-training, and simplified reinforcement learning pipelines. While these strategies drastically reduce overhead, they prompt a critical, yet neglected question: Is efficiency achieved at the expense of model robustness and security? To our knowledge, we present the first systematic cross-domain investigation of the efficiency-vulnerability trade-off. Across vision and language models, we show that efficiency-oriented training increases susceptibility to adversarial and privacy attacks. We characterize this vulnerability by analyzing the models' internal geometry and functional representations, demonstrating that the evaluated efficient variants consistently exhibit sharper loss geometry together with systematic changes in representational structure. We further extend our analysis to "zero RL training", finding that models trained using simplified RL recipes exhibit substantially greater susceptibility to catastrophic forgetting and more pronounced overconfidence than those trained through conventional alignment pipelines. Our findings suggest that training efficiency is rarely a "free lunch"; rather, the mechanisms that minimize computation can inadvertently compromise safety. We conclude by calling for a paradigm shift toward multi-objective training that jointly optimizes for performance, cost, and security.
title_cn: 效率没有免费午餐：重审训练效率与模型脆弱性的权衡
abstract_cn: 训练效率已成为基础模型近期进展的核心驱动力。为克服大规模训练的巨大算力与数据需求，研究者日益采用选择性数据采样、高效预训练与简化强化学习管线等策略。这些策略大幅降低开销的同时，引出一个关键却被忽视的问题：效率是否以模型鲁棒性与安全为代价？据我们所知，我们给出效率-脆弱性权衡的首个系统跨域研究。跨视觉与语言模型，我们表明面向效率的训练增加对对抗与隐私攻击的易感性。我们通过分析模型内部几何与函数表示刻画这种脆弱性，证明被评估的高效变体一致呈现更尖锐的损失几何与表示结构的系统性变化。我们进一步扩展到「零 RL 训练」，发现用简化 RL 配方训练的模型比常规对齐管线训练的模型表现出显著更强的灾难性遗忘与更明显的过度自信。结果表明训练效率很少是免费午餐；最小化计算的机制可能无意中损害安全。我们最后呼吁转向联合优化性能、成本与安全的多目标训练范式。
summary_cn: 首个跨域系统研究训练效率-脆弱性权衡：高效训练变体损失几何更尖锐、对对抗与隐私攻击更易感；零 RL 训练加剧灾难性遗忘与过度自信。
objective_summary: 跨视觉与语言模型系统测量选择性采样、高效预训练与简化 RL 等效率策略对对抗/隐私攻击易感性与内部几何的影响。
evidence_note: 跨视觉与语言的多模型对比、内部几何与表示分析、RL 配方对照；效率策略覆盖面与攻击集合有限，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次把「效率训练→更脆弱」作为跨域系统性命题检验并给出几何解释，具诊断价值；单项关联此前有零散报告。
scope: 结论适用于所测效率策略与模型族；对具体效率技术的因果分解不完整；不适用于所有蒸馏/剪枝变体。
limitations: 效率策略与攻击集合的覆盖有限；几何—脆弱性联系为相关性证据；未给出兼顾效率与安全的具体训练配方。

title: The Cost of Stability: Deanonymizing Onion Services Long-Lived Introduction Circuits
abstract: Tor is a widely used anonymity network that provides network privacy by routing client communications through a sequence of relays to their destinations. An adversary observing a single Tor relay cannot readily link clients to their destinations, as doing so requires identifying the other relays along the client circuit. Identifying these relays from traffic observed at the monitored relay alone is challenging: each relay carries traffic for many circuits simultaneously, and client circuits typically last only about 10 min, limiting observations of a given circuit. In contrast, Tor onion services use introduction circuits that remain fixed for 18 to 24 h. We develop an intersection attack that exploits this design, allowing an adaptive adversary observing one Tor relay at a time to identify the network location of an onion service. We evaluate the attack on the live Tor network against a self-operated onion service carrying genuine third-party traffic. Across nine end-to-end experiments, the attack reconstructs the complete Tor circuit in every run, with an estimated median time of 2.2 h. To mitigate this attack, we propose a mechanism that periodically rebuilds internal introduction circuits to limit evidence accumulation without changing publicly advertised information.
title_cn: 稳定的代价：对洋葱服务长命引入电路的去匿名化
abstract_cn: Tor 是广泛使用的匿名网络，通过把客户端通信经一系列中继路由到目的地提供网络隐私。观察单个 Tor 中继的对手难以把客户端关联到目的地，因为这需要识别客户端电路上的其他中继。仅凭受监控中继观测识别这些中继极具挑战：每条中继同时承载大量电路流量，而客户端电路通常仅持续约 10 分钟，限制对给定电路的观测。相比之下，Tor 洋葱服务的引入电路保持固定 18–24 小时。我们利用该设计开发交集攻击，让每次观察一条 Tor 中继的自适应对手定位洋葱服务的网络位置。我们在真实 Tor 网络上、针对承载真实第三方流量的自运营洋葱服务评估该攻击。九次端到端实验中，攻击在每次运行都重建出完整 Tor 电路，估计中位时间 2.2 小时。作为缓解，我们提出周期性重建内部引入电路的机制，在不改变公开广告信息的前提下限制证据积累。
summary_cn: 利用洋葱服务引入电路 18–24h 固定的交集攻击：真实 Tor 网络九次端到端实验全部完整重建电路（中位 2.2h），并提出周期性重建引入电路的缓解。
objective_summary: 提出利用长命引入电路的单中继交集攻击，在真实 Tor 网络对自运营洋葱服务验证电路重建，并给出周期性重建的缓解机制。
evidence_note: 真实 Tor 网络端到端实验、真实第三方流量背景、九次全成功与中位时间量化、缓解机制实现；对象为自运营服务，规模单一。
novelty_note: 首次把洋葱服务引入电路的长命性转单中继观测为可行去匿名化，威胁模型与实网验证均有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于当前洋葱服务引入电路设计与单中继自适应对手；多中继协同观察或更短电路下代价不同。
limitations: 实验基于自运营 onion 服务，真实流行服务的验证受伦理与法律限制；攻击时间受流量条件影响；缓解的可用性代价未量化。

title: RAISE: Reinforcing Access Control Policy Synthesis in LLMs via Symbolic Evaluation
abstract: Translating natural-language access-control requirements into policies requires careful reasoning about permissions, constraints, and exceptions, and even frontier LLMs often produce policies that violate the intended authorization semantics. We construct CedarInstruct, to our knowledge the first dataset that supports both training and semantic evaluation for formally verifiable Cedar policy synthesis. It contains 5,800 scenarios across 44 domains and 1,408 representing a single synthetic organization, each with a verified target policy and an executable verification plan. On this data we introduce RAISE, which trains policy synthesizers from formal verification in two stages, verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by a reinforcement learning (RL) stage that learns from verifier signal. We find that SFT succeeds largely by letting models express authorization logic they already have, since untrained models rarely write valid Cedar but often reason correctly when they do. After SFT, how the verifier's information is used matters more than how much of it is used. Of six RL instantiations that consume progressively richer verifier signal, only RAISE-OC improves meaningfully on SFT; it turns failed checks and symbolic counterexamples into guided exploration and learns from the result with off-context GRPO. With about 5.4K verified scenarios and LoRA fine-tuning, RAISE-OC trains Qwen3.5-9B to surpass zero-shot GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 by 13.33 and 16.26 percentage points in semantic success on held-out scenarios, and training transfers to the independently constructed CedarBench.
comment: 34 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code: this https URL
title_cn: RAISE：以符号化评估强化 LLM 的访问控制策略合成
abstract_cn: 把自然语言访问控制需求翻译成策略需要对权限、约束与例外仔细推理，即使前沿 LLM 也常产出违反预期授权语义的策略。我们构建 CedarInstruct——据我们所知首个同时支持可形式化验证的 Cedar 策略合成训练与语义评估的数据集。它含 44 个领域共 5,800 个场景（其中 1,408 个来自单一合成组织），每个都带经验证的目标策略与可执行验证计划。在该数据上我们提出 RAISE，一个从形式化验证中训练策略合成器的两阶段方法：先经验证的监督微调（SFT），再从验证器信号学习的强化学习（RL）阶段。我们发现 SFT 的成功主要在于让模型表达其已有的授权逻辑——未训练模型很少写出合法 Cedar，但一旦写出常推理正确。SFT 之后，验证器信息的「如何使用」比「用了多少」更重要：六个消费渐富验证器信号的 RL 实例化中，只有 RAISE-OC 在 SFT 之上有实质改进；它把失败检查与符号反例转化为引导探索，并用 off-context GRPO 学习。以约 5.4K 个经验证场景与 LoRA 微调，RAISE-OC 训练的 Qwen3.5-9B 在留出场景的语义成功率上超过零样本 GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5 达 13.33 与 16.26 个百分点，且训练可迁移到独立构造的 CedarBench。代码公开。
summary_cn: 首个 Cedar 策略合成数据集 CedarInstruct（5,800 场景）+验证器信号 RL（RAISE-OC）：Qwen3.5-9B 语义成功率超零样本 GPT-6 Astra/Claude Opus 5 达 13.33/16.26 点，可迁移 CedarBench。
objective_summary: 构建带验证策略的 Cedar 合成数据集并提出验证 SFT+反例引导 RL 的训练方法，量化其相对前沿模型的语义成功率与迁移性。
evidence_note: 5,800 个带验证目标策略的场景、六种 RL 实例化的消融、与两个前沿模型量化对比（13.33/16.26 点）、跨数据集迁移；代码公开。
novelty_note: 首个可验证 Cedar 策略训练/评测数据集，反例引导的 off-context GRPO 为实质新训练机制，「怎么用验证器比用多少重要」为新发现。
scope: 结论适用于 Cedar 语言与所设场景分布；对其他策略语言（Polar、RegO 等）需重建验证回路。
limitations: 场景以合成组织为主，真实组织策略分布未覆盖；语义成功率的度量依赖验证器实现；RL 训练成本未详报。

title: Tokens Change, Structure Endures: Spectral Watermarking for Generated Speech
abstract: Watermarking is a promising tool for establishing the provenance of AI-generated speech. While many neural audio watermarking methods rely on a separately trained watermark generator, token-level watermarking is a training-free alternative that operates directly during generation. Its main weakness is retokenization: decoding generated speech to a waveform and encoding it again can change token identities and erode the watermark. To make the watermark robust to these changes, we propose Redwing, REtokenization-Durable Watermarking IN Generation. It builds a graph from the token substitutions observed under retokenization, whose Laplacian yields a basis that assigns similar values to tokens likely to substitute for one another. Over this basis, embedding and detection functions are jointly optimized to preserve watermark signal through retokenization while limiting embedding distortion and detector variability on unwatermarked speech. On the Moshi full-duplex system, after eight consecutive passes of Mimi resynthesis, Redwing achieves 80.7% TPR at a calibrated 1% FPR, compared with 8.3% for KGW and at most 7.3% for WMAR. It also has the highest TPR after eight passes through three other neural codecs (77.5-93.0%), and the gains generalize to TTS models at a speech-quality cost close to that of KGW. These results show that retokenization is not merely a source of noise: its transition structure can be exploited as a design principle for robust token-level watermarking.
title_cn: token 会变，结构长存：生成语音的谱水印
abstract_cn: 水印是为 AI 生成语音建立溯源的有前景工具。许多神经音频水印方法依赖单独训练的水印生成器，而 token 级水印是直接在生成期运行的免训练替代。其主要弱点是重分词：把生成语音解码为波形再重新编码会改变 token 身份、侵蚀水印。为使水印对此鲁棒，我们提出 Redwing（生成中抗重分词的持久水印）。它从重分词下观测到的 token 替换构建图，其拉普拉斯算子给出一组基，使可能互相替换的 token 被赋予相似取值。在该基上联合优化嵌入与检测函数，在限制嵌入失真与未加水印语音上的检测器波动的同时，使水印信号穿越重分词保留。在 Moshi 全双工系统上，经八次连续 Mimi 重合成后，Redwing 在校准 1% FPR 下达到 80.7% TPR，而 KGW 为 8.3%、WMAR 至多 7.3%；经三种其他神经编解码器各八次处理后 TPR 也最高（77.5–93.0%），且增益以接近 KGW 的语音质量代价泛化到 TTS 模型。这些表明重分词不只是噪声来源：其转移结构可作为鲁棒 token 级水印的设计原则。
summary_cn: 利用重分词替换结构设计谱水印 Redwing：Moshi 八次重合成后 1% FPR 下 TPR 80.7%（KGW 8.3%、WMAR≤7.3%），跨四种编解码器 77.5–93.0% 并泛化到 TTS。
objective_summary: 提出以重分词转移图拉普拉斯基构造的 token 级语音水印，联合优化嵌入与检测并在四种编解码器与 TTS 上量化鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 与 KGW/WMAR 的 TPR@1%FPR 量化对比、四种编解码器×八次处理、TTS 泛化与语音质量代价报告；评测系统、指标明确。
novelty_note: 把重分词的转移结构本身用作水印设计原则属实质新机制，显著改进 token 级水印的已知薄弱环节。
scope: 结论适用于 token 级生成水印与所测编解码器/语音系统；对强对抗去除攻击（非重分词）的鲁棒性未评估。
limitations: 主要在语音全双工与 TTS 设定验证；对政治级对抗攻击（故意破坏）未测；嵌入失真的感知代价需按应用评估。

title: SecProbe: Adaptive Evaluation of Coding Agents on Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
abstract: Assessing cybersecurity vulnerability awareness in coding agents requires evaluations that reveal capability gaps and remain informative as models evolve. Static benchmarks offer fixed coverage and difficulty, while scarce vulnerable repositories and costly expert authoring limit their renewal at scale. We introduce SecProbe, a framework for adaptive evaluation that combines Item Response Theory (IRT) with on-demand synthesis of repository-scale vulnerability-repair tasks. From observed performance, \textsc{SecProbe} estimates agent ability and identifies where additional evidence is most informative, selecting existing tasks or synthesizing new ones accordingly. As one use case, we construct 353 tasks spanning six programming languages and 151 CWE types and evaluate nine frontier models with two agent harnesses. Success rates peak at 28.33\%, highlighting substantial gaps in vulnerability recognition and repair. Compared with random and one-shot baselines, \textsc{SecProbe} achieves comparable agent ability estimates while requiring agents to solve up to 29.5\% fewer tasks. These results support adaptive evaluation as an efficient and discriminative approach to assessing cybersecurity vulnerability awareness.
title_cn: SecProbe：编码智能体网络安全漏洞能力的自适应评估
abstract_cn: 评估编码智能体的网络安全漏洞意识需要既能揭示能力缺口、又随模型演进保持信息量的评估。静态基准覆盖与难度固定，而漏洞仓库稀缺与专家出题成本高，限制了大规模更新。我们提出 SecProbe，一个结合项目反应理论（IRT）与按需合成仓库级漏洞修复任务的自适应评估框架。从观测性能出发，SecProbe 估计智能体能力并识别何处补充证据最有信息量，据此选择既有任务或合成新任务。作为一个用例，我们构建了跨六种语言、151 种 CWE 的 353 个任务，评估九个前沿模型与两种智能体脚手架。成功率峰值 28.33%，凸显漏洞识别与修复的显著缺口。与随机及单次基线相比，SecProbe 在取得可比能力估计的同时，最多可让智能体少解 29.5% 的任务。结果支持自适应评估作为评估网络安全漏洞意识的高效且有区分度的方法。
summary_cn: IRT+按需任务合成的自适应安全评估框架 SecProbe：353 任务×9 前沿模型×2 脚手架，成功率峰值 28.33%，可比能力估计下少解最多 29.5% 任务。
objective_summary: 提出以 IRT 驱动的自适应任务选择与合成的安全能力评估框架，并在九个前沿模型上量化能力分布与评测效率。
evidence_note: 353 任务、九模型两脚手架、与随机/单次选择基线的效率对比（最多省 29.5%）；合成任务的质量依赖生成管线，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把 IRT 自适应测验引入智能体安全能力评测为有效的新组合；任务合成为已知技术。
scope: 结论适用于仓库级漏洞修复能力评估；对 exploitation、补丁绕过等其他安全能力未覆盖。
limitations: 合成任务的正确性与难度标定依赖自动管线；IRT 参数随模型迭代需重估；28.33% 的绝对水平受脚手架影响。

title: MAD-Guard: Controlled Study of Autoregressive Generation versus Direct Decision Interfaces for Closed Multimodal Forensic Tasks
abstract: When should multimodal foundation models generate tokens, and when should they directly output a decision? We present MAD-Guard, a controlled study of output-decision interfaces for closed multimodal forensic tasks. Once a multimodal representation is computed, is autoregressive generation necessary for closed forensic decisions with high input complexity but low output entropy? Under a matched Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, 2,400 FakeClue training samples, and LoRA budget ($r=16, \alpha=32$) on Huawei Ascend 910C NPUs, we evaluate a progression of decision interfaces (AR-SFT [generate] $\to$ Logit Slice $\to$ Binary Direct Head $\to$ +choice $\to$ +act $\to$ CLM-Head) and decompose latency into backbone representation (53.12 ms), 151,643-way vocabulary projection (+85.04 ms $\to$ 138.16 ms), and decoding (+248.26 ms $\to$ 386.42 ms). Under 1-to-1 binary supervision ($\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BCE}}$), a Binary Direct Head cuts latency by $2.60\times$-$7.27\times$ (53.12 ms) and lowers calibration error by $1.88\times$ (ECE = 0.0450 vs. 0.0845), with a -1.80% accuracy trade-off (93.10% vs. 94.90%; 0.9795 vs. 0.9871 ROC-AUC) from forfeiting token priors. Gains above AR-SFT arise either from multi-task attribution and uncertainty gating (+choice+act: 96.44% accuracy, 0.9940 ROC-AUC, 0.0187 ECE at 53.71 ms) or from a disaggregated contrastive head (CLM-Head: 96.55% binary and 96.44% multi-task accuracy, 0.0166 ECE, 98.79% 7-class attribution at 54.42 ms) retaining semantic priors without token decoding. Across 5,000 out-of-sample images from five benchmarks, our framework excels on synthetic, camouflage, and document forgeries (96.44% GenImage, 97.73% Chameleon, 91.84% Doc) while showing a clear boundary on compressed face manipulation (FF++ ROC-AUC = 0.5913).

title_cn: MAD-Guard：封闭多模态取证任务中自回归生成与直接决策接口的受控研究
abstract_cn: 多模态基础模型何时应生成 token、何时应直接输出决策？我们提出 MAD-Guard，一个针对高输入复杂度、低输出熵的封闭多模态取证任务的输出-决策接口受控研究。在多模态表示计算完成后，自回归生成对这类封闭取证决策是否必要？在匹配的 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干、2,400 FakeClue 训练样本与 LoRA 预算（r=16, α=32）、华为昇腾 910C NPU 下，我们评估一系列决策接口（AR-SFT[生成]→Logit Slice→二值直接头→+choice→+act→CLM-Head），并把时延分解为骨干表示（53.12ms）、151,643 路词表投影（+85.04ms→138.16ms）与解码（+248.26ms→386.42ms）。在 1 对 1 二值监督下，二值直接头把时延削减 2.60–7.27 倍（53.12ms）、校准误差降低 1.88 倍（ECE 0.0450 vs 0.0845），代价为 −1.80% 精度（93.10% vs 94.90%；ROC-AUC 0.9795 vs 0.9871）。超出 AR-SFT 的收益或来自多任务归因与不确定性门控（+choice+act：96.44% 精度、0.9940 ROC-AUC、ECE 0.0187、53.71ms），或来自解耦对比头（CLM-Head：96.55% 二值与 96.44% 多任务精度、ECE 0.0166、7 类归因 98.79%、54.42ms），后者保留语义先验而无需 token 解码。跨五个基准的 5,000 张样本外图像上，框架在合成、伪装与文档伪造上表现出色（GenImage 96.44%、Chameleon 97.73%、Doc 91.84%），而在压缩人脸伪造上有明确边界（FF++ ROC-AUC 0.5913）。7 页、3 图、7 表。
summary_cn: 匹配骨干的接口对照研究：二值直接头时延降 2.60–7.27 倍、ECE 降 1.88 倍（精度 −1.80%），CLM-Head 兼得 96.55% 精度与 54.42ms；FF++ 为明确能力边界。
objective_summary: 在匹配骨干与训练预算下系统比较生成式与直接决策接口在封闭取证任务上的精度、校准与时延，并跨五个基准定位能力边界。
evidence_note: 受控变量（同骨干、同数据、同 LoRA）、时延三段分解、五基准外推与明确失效案例（FF++ 0.5913）；单一训练集、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 对「生成 vs 直判」接口的系统化受控比较与解耦对比头设计，属有价值的实证修正加工程组合。
scope: 结论适用于封闭集合、低输出熵的取证分类任务；对开放描述生成任务不适用；压缩人脸伪造为明确边界。

title: COGNIT-Guard: Calibrated Standalone Direct-Decision Guardrails with Heterogeneous CPU-NPU Confidence Cascading under Explicit Latency and False-Positive Constraints
abstract: When must a foundation-model safety gateway generate tokens, and when should it directly output a calibrated decision? We study calibrated standalone direct-decision foundation models for real-time pre-ingestion safety guardrails, jointly addressing probability calibration, dual-use false-positive control, and heterogeneous CPU-NPU routing under explicit latency SLOs. Pre-ingestion guardrails must screen prompts prior to target-LLM prefill with low false alarms on benign compliance inquiries; however, shallow classifiers are brittle to phrasing shifts, hidden-state probes require coupling to a target LLM, and generative guards incur high decoding latency and dual-use false positives. We present COGNIT-Guard, coupling a validation-calibrated CPU fast gatekeeper with confidence-gated escalation to an NPU-resident 322M bidirectional direct-decision model (Laya-322M) under an asymmetric false-positive penalty. On the clean unseen DUCS-Bench test split ($N=607$), COGNIT-Guard achieves 98.85% accuracy (McNemar $p = 1.19 \times 10^{-4}$ vs. ML), reduces benign FPR to 0.42% ($1/238$; Fisher's exact $p = 8.23 \times 10^{-4}$ vs. ML), and attains 1.12% ECE and 0.0104 Brier score. On Huawei Ascend 910C NPUs, pure NPU inference runs in 21.77 ms mean latency (45.90 QPS), while the live serial CPU-NPU cascade ($\theta^*_{\mathrm{deploy}}=0.70$) achieves 41.63 ms mean latency (P50: 39.47 ms, 99.23% accuracy, 0.00% FPR). Evaluation on SafetyBench-ZH ($N=2,100$) and comparison against a bi-encoder direct-decision baseline (CLM-8B) disentangle in-domain gains, OOD alignment tax (60.33% $\to$ 56.81% on Laya; 55.10% on domain CLM-8B), and experience replay recovery, restoring OOD accuracy to 64.10%-65.05% and reaching 99.67%-99.84% in-domain accuracy with 0.00%-0.42% FPR.

title_cn: COGNIT-Guard：显式时延与误报约束下异构 CPU-NPU 置信级联的校准独立直判护栏
abstract_cn: 基础模型安全网关何时应生成 token，何时应直接输出校准后的决策？我们研究面向实时预摄入安全护栏的校准独立直判基础模型，联合处理概率校准、双用途误报控制与显式时延 SLO 下的异构 CPU-NPU 路由。预摄入护栏须在目标 LLM 预填充前筛查提示，且对良性合规询问低误报；但浅层分类器对措辞变化脆弱、隐藏态探针需耦合目标 LLM、生成式护栏解码时延高且双用途误报多。我们提出 COGNIT-Guard：把校准的 CPU 快速门卫与置信门控升级到 NPU 驻留的 322M 双向直判模型（Laya-322M）级联，使用非对称误报惩罚。在干净的未见 DUCS-Bench 测试切分（N=607）上，COGNIT-Guard 达到 98.85% 准确率（McNemar p=1.19×10⁻⁴）、把良性 FPR 降至 0.42%（1/238；Fisher 精确 p=8.23×10⁻⁴）、ECE 1.12%、Brier 0.0104。在华为昇腾 910C NPU 上，纯 NPU 推理平均时延 21.77ms（45.90 QPS），串行 CPU-NPU 级联（θ*=0.70）平均 41.63ms（P50 39.47ms，99.23% 准确率，0.00% FPR）。在 SafetyBench-ZH（N=2,100）上的评估与双编码器直判基线（CLM-8B）对比分解了域内收益、OOD 对齐税（Laya 60.33%→56.81%；域内 CLM-8B 55.10%）与经验回放恢复——OOD 准确率恢复到 64.10%–65.05%，域内达 99.67%–99.84%、FPR 0.00%–0.42%。7 页、2 图、5 表，IEEE 双栏。
summary_cn: CPU 快门卫+NPU 322M 直判模型级联护栏：DUCS-Bench 98.85% 准确率、良性 FPR 0.42%（有显著性检验），昇腾 910C 串行级联 41.63ms、FPR 0.00%。
objective_summary: 提出校准 CPU 门卫与 NPU 直判模型的置信级联护栏，在显式时延与误报约束下量化精度、校准与硬件时延。
evidence_note: 含统计检验（McNemar、Fisher）、两个基准、真实 NPU 硬件时延实测、OOD 恢复实验；主基准 N=607 偏小、7 页短文。
novelty_note: 把直判模型、置信级联与 NPU 部署组合进预摄入护栏的工程化新组合；单项组件均为已有技术。
scope: 结论适用于预摄入提示筛查与所选硬件（昇腾 910C）；对多轮对话上下文与多语种泛化仅部分覆盖（中文基准）。
limitations: 主基准规模小且为自建；OOD 对齐税仍存（约 4 个点）；双用途误报评估限于所设攻击族。

title: Climbing the Hill: Prompt Injection Red-Teaming Against Frontier Models with Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Prompt injection is a leading security risk for LLMs and LLM-based applications such as agents. State-of-the-art red-teaming methods for prompt injection leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to train an attacker LLM to generate effective injected prompts. However, when targeting frontier LLMs such as GPT-6-Luna, a major challenge is the cold-start problem: every attack attempt by the attacker LLM fails and thus receives zero reward, providing no signal for learning. In this work, we propose a curriculum learning-based method to address the cold-start problem. In particular, we propose to train the attacker LLM against a sequence of increasingly robust target LLMs, with each stage warm-starting from the attacker LLM obtained in the previous one. However, simply training against a weak target (e.g., GPT-4o-mini) may not sufficiently prepare the attacker LLM to obtain useful learning signals against a frontier LLM (e.g., GPT-5.6-Terra). Instead, we find that the design of the curriculum is critical: after each stage, the attacker LLM needs to partially succeed against the next target LLM such that it can learn from successful attempts to attack the new target. Our extensive evaluation shows that our method can effectively red-team frontier LLMs, achieving an attack success rate (ASR@10) of 93.8\% and 45.0\% against GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-5.6-Terra on AgentDyn, whereas state-of-the-art RL methods such as RL-Hammer and PISmith achieve 0\% ASR under the same setting. Moreover, we find that the attacker LLM transfers across targets, e.g., an attacker LLM trained to defeat one strong LLM (GPT-5.6-Terra) also succeeds against six other frontier LLMs (e.g., GPT-6-Luna) it was never trained on. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/albert-y1n/PIForge}{here}.
