title_cn: 面向后量子安全协议的吞吐导向解析模型
abstract_cn: 对量子威胁影响经典密码学的认识日益增强，直接转化为对能估计量子安全密码集成到现有系统中之影响的精确网络仿真工具的需求。特别是，后量子密码（PQC）的采用直接影响网络端点性能与传输开销，也影响 TLS、SSH 等广泛采用的安全协议的可扩展性。本文提出一个面向吞吐的分析模型，给出 TLS 与 SSH 中后量子安全连接建立最大可持续速率的紧上界。该模型同时考虑端点与网络容量约束，把握手过程分解为主导密码操作时间与网络传输时间。识别瓶颈即可用每秒握手数推导可达吞吐量。提供的实验结果显示模型与实验测试台数据（使用 FIPS 203、204、205 中的 NIST 标准原语，包括 ML-KEM 与 ML-DSA）的精度。最后我们把模型集成进网络环境，展示其如何用于在多端点间高效分配资源，优化多单播场景下的 PQC 流量。
summary_cn: 提出 PQC 安全连接建立的吞吐解析模型（端点+网络约束、握手分解、瓶颈识别），在 FIPS 203/204/205 测试台上验证精度并用于多端点资源分配。
objective_summary: 构建估计 TLS/SSH 后量子握手最大可持续吞吐的分析模型，用标准 PQC 原语测试台验证，并演示多端点资源分配应用。
evidence_note: 标准原语测试台验证模型精度、覆盖 TLS 与 SSH 两协议；摘要未给误差量化，测试台环境多样性有限。
novelty_note: TLS 握手性能解析建模是成熟方法，向 PQC 原语与 SSH 的适配属增量工程。
scope: 适用于所测 PQC 原语集与端点/网络配置；对异构端点与真实互联网路径的泛化有限。
limitations: 模型假设主导操作可分离、网络为静态容量；实测验证环境单一；未覆盖 0-RTT 等模式。

title: Neural Fingerprints for Malware Analysis: An Image-Based Metric Learning Approach with Application to Cross-Domain Classification
abstract: Identifying the family of a newly observed malware sample is a core task in threat intelligence, yet conventional classifiers must be retrained whenever a new family appears. This chapter develops an image-based metric learning approach that instead learns to extract discriminative neural fingerprints--fixed-length embeddings--from malware-as-image representations, so that family membership can be determined by nearest-neighbor search in the embedding space. The central advantage of this formulation is zero-shot capability: because the learned embedding induces a similarity metric rather than a fixed set of class boundaries, families that were never seen during training can be recognized by comparison against a gallery, with no retraining. We demonstrate this directly by training an encoder on MalNet-Images-Tiny and MalImg combined (453 families, 96,769 images) and evaluate it zero-shot on a held-out 17-family grayscale dataset with no family overlap. Using a lightweight CNN with multi-proxy anchor loss, this model attains 73.1% retrieval@1 and 90.5% open-set AUROC on families the encoder has never seen. We benchmark our embedding approach against two conventional paradigms in a same-domain setting, where all three are competitive at classifying malware into families. We further show that the learned embeddings transfer across datasets. Unlike classifiers, our embedding approach also yields interpretable similarity scores and scales to large galleries via Facebook AI Similarity Search (FAISS). Finally, we provide a comprehensive evaluation of the learned embedding space using retrieval@k, cluster purity, silhouette score, separation ratio, few-shot accuracy, and open-set detection metrics, along with robustness analysis under image perturbations.
comment: To appear as a chapter in the book "Artificial Intelligence for Cyber Defense in Emerging Threats", to be published by Springer by early 2027
title_cn: 面向恶意软件分析的神经指纹：基于图像的度量学习方法及跨域分类应用
abstract_cn: 识别新观察恶意软件样本的家族是威胁情报的核心任务，但传统分类器每次出现新家族都需重新训练。本章发展一种基于图像的度量学习方法，学习从恶意软件图像表示中提取判别性神经指纹——固定长度嵌入——使家族成员资格可通过嵌入空间中的最近邻搜索确定。该表述的核心优势是零样本能力：由于学习的嵌入诱导相似性度量而非固定类边界，训练中从未见过的家族可通过与库比较识别，无需重训练。我们直接演示这一点：在 MalNet-Images-Tiny 与 MalImg 合并（453 家族、96769 图像）上训练编码器，并在无家族重叠的保留 17 家族灰度数据集上做零样本评估。使用带多代理锚损失的轻量 CNN，模型在从未见过的家族上达到 73.1% retrieval@1 与 90.5% 开集 AUROC。我们在同域设定（三者均可竞争性地把恶意软件分类到家族）下将嵌入方法与两种传统范式基准对比。我们进一步表明学习的嵌入可跨数据集迁移。与分类器不同，嵌入方法还产生可解释的相似度分数，并经 Facebook AI 相似性搜索（FAISS）扩展到大型库。最后我们用 retrieval@k、簇纯度、轮廓分数、分离比、少样本准确率与开集检测指标对嵌入空间做全面评估，并附图像扰动下的鲁棒性分析。
summary_cn: 恶意软件图像度量学习指纹：453 家族 9.7 万图训练，对 17 个未见家族零样本 retrieval@1 73.1%、开集 AUROC 90.5%，支持 FAISS 检索与跨数据集迁移。
objective_summary: 提出以度量学习嵌入做恶意软件家族识别的零样本范式，在 453 家族上训练并在无重叠 17 家族上评估，与分类范式系统对比并给出全面空间分析。
evidence_note: 453 家族 96769 图训练、严格无重叠零样本评估、多指标体系（retrieval/聚类/开集/少样本/扰动）与两种范式同域对比；为 Springer 图书章节、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 度量学习用于恶意软件图像已有探索；零样本家族识别的系统化评估与跨域迁移是实质推进。
scope: 适用于恶意软件图像表示与所测家族分布；对加壳/混淆导致的图像失真仅有扰动级鲁棒性分析。
limitations: 零样本精度 73.1% 距实用仍有差距；图库质量与代表性依赖数据集；未见真实新家族出现的纵向验证。

title: Image-Based Techniques and Ensemble Soft Voting for Malware Classification
abstract: In this chapter, we investigate image-based malware family classification using an ensemble learning framework and a soft voting strategy. We consider malware binaries that have been converted into images using eight distinct conversion strategies. Three complementary feature extraction tracks are applied to these images: handcrafted descriptors combining Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) and Haralick texture features along with 38 statistical features; dense embeddings obtained from three pretrained neural networks (VGG16, ResNet50, and ViT-B/16), where each pretrained model is used as a frozen feature extractor with its classification head removed; and 512-dimensional embeddings derived from a custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained directly on the malware images. Each of the three feature extraction techniques is evaluated with machine learning classifiers across all eight image conversion types. The best individual results are 77.8% accuracy for the handcrafted features, 73.8% for the pretrained neural network track, and 74.8% for the custom CNN track. Then we consider various soft voting ensemble strategies, and we find that the best-performing soft voting pool--consisting of fifteen voters selected on a dedicated validation split--achieves 80.2% accuracy across the 17 malware families under consideration, a statistically significant improvement of 2.4 percentage points over the best individual model. A quantitative diversity analysis confirms that the different feature representations are complementary, with the handcrafted descriptors being the strongest contributors.
comment: To appear as a chapter in the book "Artificial Intelligence for Cyber Defense in Emerging Threats", to be published by Springer by early 2027
title_cn: 基于图像技术与集成软投票的恶意软件分类
abstract_cn: 在本章中，我们研究使用集成学习框架与软投票策略的基于图像的恶意软件家族分类。我们考虑已用八种不同转换策略转换为图像的恶意软件二进制。对这些图像应用三条互补的特征提取轨道：结合方向梯度直方图（HOG）与 Haralick 纹理特征及 38 个统计特征的手工描述子；从三个预训练神经网络（VGG16、ResNet50 与 ViT-B/16）获得的稠密嵌入，每个预训练模型作为去除分类头的冻结特征提取器；以及由直接在恶意软件图像上训练的自定义卷积神经网络（CNN）导出的 512 维嵌入。三种特征提取技术均与机器学习分类器在全部八种图像转换类型上评估。最佳单项结果为：手工特征 77.8% 准确率、预训练神经网络轨道 73.8%、自定义 CNN 轨道 74.8%。随后我们考虑多种软投票集成策略，发现由在专用验证集上选出的十五个投票器构成的最佳软投票池，在 17 个恶意软件家族上达到 80.2% 准确率，比最佳单项模型高 2.4 个百分点且具统计显著性。定量多样性分析确认不同特征表示互补，手工描述子是最强贡献者。
summary_cn: 八种二进制转图×三条特征轨道做恶意软件家族分类，15 投票器软投票在 17 家族上达 80.2%，比最佳单项高 2.4 个百分点且统计显著。
objective_summary: 系统比较八种图像转换与三条特征提取轨道在 17 个恶意软件家族上的分类表现，并评估软投票集成的增益与特征互补性。
evidence_note: 八转换×三轨道的完整网格、验证集选择投票器、2.4 个百分点的显著性声称；数据集与基线范围未详。
novelty_note: 恶意软件图像化与集成学习均为成熟技术，贡献为系统化的组合与评估。
scope: 结论适用于 17 家族数据集与所测八种转换；对跨家族泛化、加壳与对抗样本未覆盖。
limitations: 数据集偏小且未与 SOTA 深度方法对比；图像转换的预处理成本未计入；无跨数据集验证。

title: CRT-Decomposed $Σ$-Protocols for CSIDH
abstract: We construct a zero-knowledge proof of knowledge for the CSIDH group action that exploits the Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT) structure of the ideal class group, available whenever the group structure is known exactly, as for CSIDH-512. We prove perfect completeness, perfect special honest-verifier zero-knowledge, and 2-special soundness, in which the secret is recovered from two accepting transcripts by one subtraction and one modular inversion per CRT component; no rewinding loop, lattice reduction, or heuristic sampling appears in the extractor. Because each round admits exactly two responses, Unruh's transform yields a non-interactive proof with straight-line extraction in the quantum random oracle model (QROM), removing the multiplicative forking-lemma loss. We instantiate the scheme on the CSIDH-512 class group, verify the algebraic layer by machine over the exact 258-bit modulus ($10^4$ random instances, all passing), and report protocol-level simulations in the exponent model: Monte Carlo soundness rates matching the proven $2^{-t}$ bound within 95\% confidence at every tested $t$, serialized signature sizes within 1.6\% of the formulas, instrumented action counts, and a scaled meet-in-the-middle attack whose measured cost follows the predicted $\sqrt{q}$ law. We further prove two delimiting results: CRT decomposition cannot enlarge the per-round challenge space, and publishing the CRT hop curves lowers classical key-recovery cost from about $2^{128.6}$ to about $2^{67.3}$ group action evaluations. The construction is therefore correct and structurally complete today, but quantitatively secure only on future parameters whose class number has large prime factors. We compare against CSI-FiSh, CSI-Otter, and Tanuki; a tightly secure blind signature from this proof of knowledge is left to future work.
title_cn: CSIDH 的 CRT 分解 Σ-协议
abstract_cn: 我们为 CSIDH 群作用构造零知识知识证明，利用理想类群的中国剩余定理（CRT）结构——只要群结构精确已知即可用，如 CSIDH-512。我们证明完美完备性、完美特殊诚实验证者零知识与 2-特殊可靠性，其中秘密可从两个接受转录中恢复，每个 CRT 分量只需一次减法与一次模逆；提取器不含回绕循环、格约化或启发式采样。因为每轮恰有两个响应，Unruh 变换给出 QROM 中带直线提取的非交互证明，消除分叉引理的乘法损失。我们在 CSIDH-512 类群上实例化方案，在精确 258 比特模数上用机器验证代数层（10^4 个随机实例全部通过），并报告指数模型下的协议级仿真：各测试 t 的蒙特卡洛可靠性率与被证 2^-t 界在 95% 置信内相符，序列化签名尺寸与公式差 1.6% 以内，仪表化动作计数，以及测量成本遵循预测 √q 律的规模化中间相遇攻击。我们进一步证明两个界定性结果：CRT 分解不能扩大每轮挑战空间；发布 CRT 跳曲线把经典密钥恢复成本从约 2^128.6 降到约 2^67.3 次群作用。该构造今天即正确且结构完整，但仅在类数具大素因子的未来参数上数量安全。我们与 CSI-FiSh、CSI-Otter 与 Tanuki 比较；紧致安全的盲签名留作未来工作。
summary_cn: 利用 CSIDH 类群 CRT 结构构造 2-特殊可靠 Σ-协议，经 Unruh 变换得 QROM 直线提取非交互证明；机器验证+仿真校验，并证明发布跳曲线把密钥恢复降至 2^67.3 等边界。
objective_summary: 为 CSIDH 群作用设计基于 CRT 分解的 Σ-协议并证明其安全性质与非交互化，机器验证代数层、仿真验证协议层，并给出挑战空间与参数安全的界定性结果。
evidence_note: 完整证明加 10^4 实例机器验证、协议级蒙特卡洛仿真与攻击成本实测校验；参数局限被作者明示。
novelty_note: CSIDH 零知识证明已有 CSI-FiSh/CSI-Otter/Tanuki 谱系；CRT 分解利用与两条界定性负面结果是实质性新点但属谱系内推进。
scope: 适用于类结构精确已知的 CSIDH 型群作用；当前公开参数下数量安全不足，需未来参数。
limitations: 每轮仅两响应致挑战空间受限；发布跳曲线的密钥恢复代价下降是硬约束；盲签名等应用未完成。

title: eBPF Security in the Wild: Structural Concentration, Failure Mechanisms, and Discovery Gaps
abstract: Extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) is a security-critical in-kernel execution framework, yet its vulnerability landscape remains fragmented across components, semantic gaps, and testing techniques. We present an empirical study of observed eBPF vulnerabilities. We construct a multi-source dataset from Linux kernel fixing commits, syzbot reports, and public CVE/NVD records, and analyze it through a unified framework covering structural concentration, mechanism-level failure modes, architectural distribution, and discovery gaps in representative techniques. Our results show that the observed eBPF vulnerability landscape is structurally concentrated rather than broadly dispersed across many unrelated weakness types. The dominant portion is associated with a limited set of recurring system-level failures, especially in runtime execution, concurrency, object lifecycle management, and semantic inconsistencies across trusted stages. These failures are unevenly distributed across the eBPF pipeline: Runtime is the dominant exposure surface, whereas the Verifier and JIT are lowerfrequency but structurally distinct security boundaries. A rubric-based comparison of representative techniques and a version-aligned Syzkaller case study on Linux v5.10 show that, despite visible raw coverage of Runtime, Verifier, and JIT, effective exploration is semantically narrow, and observed discoveries concentrate in a small subset of Runtime failures. Overall, raw coverage alone provides an incomplete view of discovery effectiveness.
title_cn: 野生环境中的 eBPF 安全：结构集中度、失效机制与发现缺口
abstract_cn: 扩展伯克利包过滤器（eBPF）是内核中安全关键的执行框架，但其漏洞图景散落于组件、语义缝隙与测试技术之间。我们对已观察到的 eBPF 漏洞开展实证研究。我们从 Linux 内核修复提交、syzbot 报告与公开 CVE/NVD 记录构建多源数据集，并通过统一框架分析，覆盖结构集中度、机制级失效模式、架构分布与代表性技术的发现缺口。结果显示：已观察到的 eBPF 漏洞图景在结构上是集中的，而非分散于大量不相关弱点类型；主导部分与一组有限的复现性系统级失效相关，尤其是运行时执行、并发、对象生命周期管理及可信阶段间语义不一致。这些失效在 eBPF 管线中分布不均：运行时是主导暴露面，验证器与 JIT 频率较低但为结构上不同的安全边界。对代表性技术的基于量规的比较与对 Linux v5.10 的版本对齐 Syzkaller 案例研究表明，尽管对运行时、验证器与 JIT 有可见的原始覆盖，有效探索在语义上是窄的，已观察发现集中在运行时失效的小子集。总体上，仅靠原始覆盖无法完整反映发现有效性。
summary_cn: 多源数据集实证 eBPF 漏洞图景：结构性集中于运行时/并发/生命周期等少数系统级失效，验证器与 JIT 为低频独立边界，原始覆盖不等于发现有效性。
objective_summary: 从内核修复提交、syzbot 与 CVE/NVD 构建统一数据集，按结构集中度、失效机制、架构分布与发现缺口实证刻画 eBPF 漏洞图景。
evidence_note: 多源交叉数据集（修复提交/syzbot/CVE-NVD）、统一分析框架、版本对齐 Syzkaller 案例研究、量规化技术比较。
novelty_note: 首个对 eBPF 漏洞图景的系统化实证刻画；单个组件的漏洞研究有先例。
scope: 适用于 Linux 内核 eBPF 子系统与所观测时间窗内的已披露漏洞；对未披露漏洞与其他内核版本的外推有限。
limitations: 依赖公开披露（存在漏报）；机制归类含主观判断；发现缺口分析受限于所代表的测试技术。

title: Towards Effective Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Deep Code Models via Structural and Identifier Perturbations
abstract: Deep code models (DCMs) are increasingly embedded in code intelligence tasks. However, their robustness under adversarial attacks remains insufficiently understood. Prior black-box attacks mainly rely on identifier- only substitutions or structural edits transferred from reference samples, yielding perturbation spaces defined largely independently of the attacked input. We introduce Strike, an input-conditioned black-box adversarial robustness-testing framework that constructs and searches a hierarchical perturbation space for each input. Strike first partitions code into blocks and uses an LLM to generate context-specific structural candidates, filtered for syntactic validity, ranked by similarity, and adaptively combined. It then refines the best structural variant through similarity-guided identifier substitutions drawn from dynamically constructed candidate pools. Evaluations across representative code intelligence tasks, including clone detection, vulnerability detection, and code summarization, demonstrate that Strike achieves higher attack success rates with competitive target- model query overhead. Strategy-specific static checks across all three tasks and execution-based validation on the executable Juliet vulnerability-detection subset provide complementary, task-bounded evidence regarding the validity of the generated variants. Representation similarity and human evaluation further indicate that the variants remain highly similar to the original code and contextually natural. Fine-tuning with Strike- generated samples improves cross-attack performance on fixed perturbed evaluation sets while preserving clean performance.
title_cn: 经结构与标识符扰动的深度代码模型黑盒对抗攻击
abstract_cn: 深度代码模型（DCM）日益嵌入代码智能任务，但其在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性仍了解不足。既有黑盒攻击主要依赖仅标识符替换或从参考样本迁移的结构编辑，扰动空间很大程度上独立于被攻击输入而定义。我们提出 Strike，一个输入条件化的黑盒对抗鲁棒性测试框架，为每个输入构造并搜索层次化扰动空间。Strike 先把代码分块并用 LLM 生成上下文相关的结构候选，经句法有效性过滤、按相似度排序并自适应组合；再以从动态构建候选池抽取的相似度引导标识符替换精修最佳结构变体。在包括克隆检测、漏洞检测与代码摘要的代表性代码智能任务上的评估表明，Strike 以有竞争力的目标模型查询开销取得更高攻击成功率。跨三个任务的策略级静态检查与在可执行 Juliet 漏洞检测子集上的执行验证为生成变体的有效性提供任务限定的补充证据。表示相似性与人工评估进一步表明变体与原代码高度相似且上下文自然。用 Strike 生成样本微调可在固定扰动评测集上改进跨攻击表现并保持干净性能。
summary_cn: Strike 以 LLM 生成分块结构候选+相似度引导标识符替换做输入条件化黑盒攻击：克隆检测/漏洞检测/代码摘要上攻击成功率更高，微调后跨攻击鲁棒性提升。
objective_summary: 构建按输入构造层次化扰动空间的黑盒鲁棒性测试框架，用 LLM 结构候选与标识符替换两阶段搜索，跨三个代码任务评估攻击效果与变体自然性。
evidence_note: 三任务系统评估、静态检查加 Juliet 子集执行验证、表示相似性与人工评估、微调迁移实验。
novelty_note: 相对既有标识符/结构攻击，输入条件化层次扰动空间是实质性改进；LLM 生成扰动有先例。
scope: 适用于所测三个代码智能任务与受测深度代码模型；对防御加固后的模型与更多编程语言场景未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖 LLM 候选质量与查询预算；执行验证限于 Juliet 可执行子集；跨任务迁移未系统评估。

title: Quantum-Ready Secure WAN: A Risk Assessment and Migration Framework
abstract: Enterprise wide-area networks (WANs) use quantum-vulnerable public-key cryptography to authenticate peers and establish keys for Internet Protocol Security (IPsec), Transport Layer Security (TLS), and software-defined WAN services. Harvest-now, decrypt-later collection already threatens data whose protection lifetime may exceed the time needed to migrate, while a future cryptographically relevant quantum computer would also endanger certificates and other authentication dependencies. Post-quantum standards and government directives now define algorithms and transition milestones, but they do not tell an enterprise which WAN services to migrate first or what evidence is sufficient for deployment. This paper proposes a vendor-neutral framework that separates exposure priority, migration readiness, and evidence confidence, and maps those outputs to staged security, operational, and governance gates. It also defines a complete evaluation design for classical and ML-KEM hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2/IPsec. The retained artifact is narrower: it contains author-reported aggregate TLS p50, p95, and p99 latencies at configured loss settings of 0%, 1%, 3%, and 5%, an arithmetic checker, and limited environment and MTU/MSS notes. At those settings, the TLS-H minus TLS-C p95 differences are 0.00, 0.16, 0.38, and 0.63 ms, corresponding to 0.00%, 1.32%, 3.07%, and 5.00% relative to TLS-C. These values are descriptive aggregate observations, not inferential results, because per-trial data, sample counts, original captures, and timestamped logs were not retained. Protocol-size and MTU/MSS calculations are reported separately from measured behavior, and unsupported IKE, resource, throughput, retransmission, and downgrade outcomes are excluded.
comment: post-quantum cryptography; quantum risk; enterprise WAN; cryptographic migration; cryptographic agility; ML-KEM; IPsec; TLS 1.3
title_cn: 量子就绪安全广域网：风险评估与迁移框架
abstract_cn: 企业广域网（WAN）用量子脆弱的公钥密码认证对端并为 IPsec、传输层安全（TLS）与软件定义 WAN 服务建立密钥。「先收集、后解密」已在威胁保护生命周期可能超过迁移所需时间的数据，而未来的密码相关量子计算机还将危及证书等认证依赖。后量子标准与政府指令已定义算法与过渡里程碑，但并未告诉企业应先迁移哪些 WAN 服务、部署需要什么证据。本文提出一个厂商中立框架，把暴露优先级、迁移就绪度与证据置信度分离，并把它们的输出映射到分阶段的安全、运营与治理门。它还为 TLS 1.3 与 IKEv2/IPsec 中的经典与 ML-KEM 混合密钥建立定义了完整的评估设计。保留的工件更窄：仅含作者报告的聚合 TLS p50、p95、p99 时延（在 0%、1%、3%、5% 配置丢包下）、一个算术检查器以及有限的环境与 MTU/MSS 说明。在这些设置下，TLS-H 减 TLS-C 的 p95 差异为 0.00、0.16、0.38、0.63 毫秒，相对 TLS-C 为 0.00%、1.32%、3.07%、5.00%。这些值是描述性聚合观察而非推断结果，因为逐次试验数据、样本数、原始抓包与时间戳日志均未保留。协议尺寸与 MTU/MSS 计算与实测行为分开报告，且不支持的 IKE、资源、吞吐、重传与降级结论被排除。
summary_cn: 面向企业 WAN 的 PQC 迁移框架：分离暴露优先级、就绪度与证据置信度并映射到阶段门；保留工件仅含 TLS 混合密钥的聚合时延（p95 差 0–0.63ms），无推断统计。
objective_summary: 提出企业 WAN 后量子迁移的风险评估与阶段门框架，定义 ML-KEM 混合密钥建立评估设计，并报告有限的描述性 TLS 时延对比。
evidence_note: 框架未经案例验证，保留的测量为描述性聚合、无样本量与推断统计，作者自陈工件受限。
novelty_note: PQC 迁移指南与框架已有多个（标准机构与厂商），企业 WAN 视角的阶段门组织属增量。
scope: 适用于企业 WAN 服务组合的迁移规划抽象；实测结论仅限所测 TLS 部署与丢包设置。
limitations: 逐次试验数据未保留致无法推断；框架未在真实企业验证；仅覆盖 TLS，IKE 等结论被排除。

title: Who Assures the Verifier? An Executable Assurance-Locus Audit of the European Digital Identity Wallet
abstract: The European Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI Wallet) architecture places material duties on relying parties: they register services and intended uses, authenticate to Wallet Units, validate presentations and trust anchors, and make risk-based status decisions. Wallet certification and the emerging Functional Conformance Assessment Framework provide increasingly structured wallet-side evidence. A different question remains: what independently rerunnable evidence shows that the concrete relying-party verifier version used in a transaction enforced the applicable request, presentation and reliance-decision controls? We conduct an assurance-locus audit of current law, Architecture and Reference Framework (ARF) 3.0.0, ETSI metadata, FCAF scope and three pinned open-source verifier codebases. We then design a 17-rule research profile, a machine-readable evidence receipt and 36 frozen synthetic transactions. Three heterogeneous study-authored implementations (Python, JavaScript and jq) execute 108 cases with zero oracle mismatches and zero cross-path disagreements. The experiment establishes determinism and implementability of the proposed decision model, not product conformance or certification. Source inspection finds substantial protocol-verification mechanisms in all three public codebases but no single audited evidence object joining RP registration and purpose, exact verifier/policy version, transaction verdict and downstream attribute use. We therefore propose an RP-as-system-under-test evidence unit that complements, rather than displaces, wallet certification, registration and supervision. A preregistered census of 26 appointed experts is prepared to test content validity and governance feasibility; recruitment awaits the applicable ethics/data-protection determination.
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Technical pre-results version. Includes an ancillary reproducibility bundle with a 17-rule profile, 36 frozen vectors and 108 executions. The preregistered expert census has not opened and no human-participant response is reported
title_cn: 谁来保证验证者？欧洲数字身份钱包的可执行保证定位审计
abstract_cn: 欧洲数字身份钱包（EUDI Wallet）架构对依赖方（RP）施加实质义务：注册服务与预期用途、向钱包单元认证、验证出示与信任锚、并做基于风险的状态决策。钱包认证与新兴的功能符合性评估框架（FCAF）提供日益结构化的钱包侧证据。另一个问题仍然存在：什么可独立重跑的证据能表明交易中实际使用的依赖方验证器版本执行了适用的请求、出示与依赖决策控制？我们对现行法律、架构与参考框架（ARF）3.0.0、ETSI 元数据、FCAF 范围与三个钉定版本的开源验证器代码库开展保证定位审计。随后设计 17 条规则的研究配置、机器可读的证据回执与 36 个冻结合成交易。三个异构的研究者实现（Python、JavaScript 与 jq）执行 108 个用例，零 oracle 失配、零跨路径分歧。该实验确立的是所提决策模型的决定论与可实现性，而非产品符合性或认证。源码检视在三个公开代码库中发现大量协议验证机制，但没有单一被审计证据对象同时关联 RP 注册与用途、精确验证器/策略版本、交易判定与下游属性使用。因此我们提出「依赖方作为被测系统」的证据单元，作为对钱包认证、注册与监管的补充而非替代。一项预登记的 26 名指定专家普查已准备就绪以检验内容效度与治理可行性；招募等待适用的伦理/数据保护决定。
summary_cn: 审计 EUDI 钱包依赖方验证器证据缺口：17 规则×36 冻结交易×3 实现 108 例零分歧，证明决策模型可实现，但生态缺关联注册、版本与判定的单一证据对象。
objective_summary: 对 EUDI 依赖方验证器的法律与代码现状做保证定位审计，设计可执行规则配置与证据回执并跨三种实现验证决定论，提出 RP 作为被测系统的证据单元。
evidence_note: 108 个冻结执行用例、三种异构实现零分歧的可复算设计，附可复现包；但为预结果版本、专家普查未开展、无真实产品评估。
novelty_note: 把审计焦点从钱包侧转向依赖方验证器侧的证据缺口，属新问题界定与可执行方法。
scope: 适用于 ARF 3.0.0 与所审三个开源验证器；不建立产品符合性，治理可行性待专家普查。
limitations: 合成交易非真实流量；专家效度研究未完成；代码库样本仅三个。

title: Dynamic Deep Prompt Optimization for Defending Against Jailbreak Attacks on LLMs
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities across many applications but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, which elicit harmful or unintended content. While model fine-tuning is an option for safety alignment, it is costly and prone to catastrophic forgetting. Prompt optimization has emerged as a promising alternative, yet existing prompt-based defenses typically rely on static modifications (e.g., fixed prefixes or suffixes) that cannot adapt to diverse and evolving attacks. We propose Dynamic Deep Prompt Optimization (DDPO), the first jailbreak defense based on deep prompt optimization. DDPO uses the target LLM's own intermediate layers as feature extractors to dynamically generate defensive embeddings via a lightweight multilayer perceptron. These tailored embeddings are then injected into a subsequent intermediate layer, enabling an input-dependent defense without modifying the LLM's weights. This design ensures high adaptability with minimal computational overhead. Experiments on a diverse set of models and attacks demonstrate that DDPO significantly outperforms static prompt optimization methods, particularly on weakly aligned models and when handling semantically ambiguous benign prompts, successfully distinguishing them from genuinely harmful requests.
title_cn: 面向 LLM 越狱攻击防御的动态深度提示优化
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）在众多应用中展现出色能力，但仍易受越狱攻击，即诱导有害或意外内容。虽然模型微调是安全对齐的一种选择，但代价高且易灾难性遗忘。提示优化已成为有前景的替代，但现有基于提示的防御通常依赖静态修改（如固定前缀或后缀），无法适应多样且不断演化的攻击。我们提出动态深度提示优化（DDPO），首个基于深度提示优化的越狱防御。DDPO 用目标 LLM 自身的中间层作为特征提取器，经轻量多层感知机动态生成防御嵌入。这些定制嵌入随后被注入后续中间层，实现不修改 LLM 权重的输入自适应防御。该设计以最小计算开销确保高适应性。在多样模型与攻击集上的实验表明，DDPO 显著优于静态提示优化方法，尤其在弱对齐模型与处理语义模糊的良性提示时，能成功将其与真正有害请求区分。
summary_cn: DDPO 用目标模型中间层特征经 MLP 生成防御嵌入并注入后续层，实现不改权重的输入自适应越狱防御，优于静态提示防御，弱对齐模型与语义模糊提示上优势最大。
objective_summary: 提出基于深度提示优化的动态越狱防御，用目标模型中间层特征生成并注入防御嵌入，在多模型多攻击下与静态提示方法对比。
evidence_note: 多模型多攻击评估并报告相对静态方法的显著优势；但摘要未给出具体数字、基线范围与统计检验。
novelty_note: 把深度提示优化引入越狱防御为首创框架；机制与激活转向/表示工程相近。
scope: 适用于可访问中间层的开源模型设定；对闭源 API 模型与自适应多轮攻击未评估。
limitations: 需为每个目标模型训练 MLP 注入器；对分布外攻击类型的泛化未验证；可能被自适应攻击者绕过。

title: Silent Sabotage: Internal State Triggered Backdoor Attacks on LLM-Powered Robotic Systems
abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into robotic control systems is enabling a new generation of autonomous agents capable of complex reasoning and planning. While this paradigm shift accelerates progress, it also introduces novel security risks that remain largely unexplored. Current research into LLM backdoors has focused on attacks triggered by external stimuli, such as specific words, visual objects, or environmental states. These attacks, while potent, overlook a more insidious class of vulnerability where the trigger is internal to the agent's own operational logic. This paper presents the first comprehensive study of history-based backdoor attacks on LLM-powered robotic systems. We demonstrate that an attacker can embed a stealthy backdoor into an LLM-based robot controller by manipulating its instructions. This backdoor is triggered not by an external cue, but by a specific, rare sequence of the robot's own past actions. It remains dormant during normal operation, preserving the robot's utility, but can be activated to induce a malicious behavior, such as a complete stop or a collision. Our experiments, conducted in a simulated environment with a variety of robots and LLMs, show that this history-based attack is highly effective, achieving a near-perfect attack success rate while remaining exceptionally difficult to detect. These findings reveal a critical and previously unaddressed vulnerability in autonomous systems and underscore the urgent need for security measures that account for an agent's internal state.
title_cn: 无声破坏：LLM 驱动机器人系统中内部状态触发的后门攻击
abstract_cn: 把大语言模型（LLM）集成进机器人控制系统正在催生能复杂推理与规划的新一代自主智能体。这一范式转变在加速进步的同时，也引入了基本未被探索的新安全风险。当前对 LLM 后门的研究集中于外部刺激触发的攻击，如特定词语、视觉物体或环境状态。这些攻击虽然强大，却忽略了更隐蔽的一类漏洞：触发器内在于智能体自身操作逻辑。本文对 LLM 驱动机器人系统中基于历史的后门攻击开展首个综合研究。我们证明攻击者可以通过操纵其指令，在基于 LLM 的机器人控制器中植入隐蔽后门。该后门不由外部线索触发，而由机器人自身过去动作的特定罕见序列触发。它在正常运行中休眠、保持机器人效用，但可被激活以诱导恶意行为，如完全停止或碰撞。我们在仿真环境中跨多种机器人与 LLM 的实验表明，这种基于历史的攻击高度有效，达到接近完美的攻击成功率，同时极难检测。这些发现揭示了自主系统中一个关键且此前未被解决的漏洞，强调迫切需要考虑智能体内部状态的安全措施。
summary_cn: 对 LLM 机器人控制器历史触发后门的首个系统研究：以自身罕见动作序列为触发，休眠保效用，仿真中跨多机器人/LLM 达近完美攻击成功率且难检测。
objective_summary: 通过操纵系统指令植入以机器人自身历史动作序列为触发的后门，在仿真环境中跨多种机器人与 LLM 量化攻击成功率与隐蔽性。
evidence_note: 多机器人与多 LLM 的仿真实验、报告攻击成功率与检测难度；无真实硬件与在线评估。
novelty_note: 序列触发在 LLM 智能体后门中已有先例，本工作把它系统化到机器人控制场景并做综合研究。
scope: 适用于接收动作历史作为输入的 LLM 机器人控制器；结论来自仿真环境，对物理噪声与真实时延下的表现未验证。
limitations: 仿真与现实的差距；触发序列需可预测产生；未提出或评估针对性防御。

title: Unread or Unenforced? Separating Representation from Enforcement Failure in Content Guards
abstract: When an encoded attack passes a content guard, the guard either never represented the payload's harmful content or represented it and failed to act. End-to-end attack success rate reports one number for both, yet the two have opposite remedies: one is a representational limit that more safety training cannot reach, the other is a decision rule that it can. We separate them by reading a guard's own residual stream, using a content probe fitted on plaintext and transferred without refitting to the encoded condition, alongside the verdict logits from the same pass. Licensing that read honestly is most of the problem and is our main contribution. A conventional permutation test admits the decode measurement on most of a 19-condition encoding ladder for each of two open guards. A length-matched null and a floor calibrated on conditions the guard's base model provably cannot decode reduce it to four conditions each; holding out the items the probe was fitted on removes one more. A third screen constrains the block axis, which the decode screens leave untouched, by running plaintext content inside each condition's own wrapper. It removes the largest cell that survived them. What remains is a policy failure that survives an item-level holdout on two of the four surviving conditions, at 8 and 7 per 100 prompts, against 17 and 23 when the probe is allowed to have seen the prompt it is scoring. It is also confined to one family of surface encodings: where an encoding leaves content linearly recoverable we can separate the two failures, and on genuine ciphers we report the cells as unmeasured rather than as evidence that nothing was decoded. Across every guard and condition pair, blocked without decoding is near zero, so we find little evidence for a pure encoding-format detector under the conditions we test. That cell is the one read we do not repeat under the holdout, and we report it as such.
comment: 14 pages (8 main paper including references, 6 supplementary material), 5 tables
title_cn: 未读到还是未执行：分离内容守卫中的表示失败与执行失败
abstract_cn: 当编码攻击通过内容守卫时，守卫要么从未表示载荷的有害内容，要么表示了却未采取行动。端到端攻击成功率对两者报告同一个数字，而补救方向相反：一是更多安全训练也达不到的表示极限，二是它能改变的决策规则。我们把两者分离：读取守卫自己的残差流——在明文上拟合、不经重拟合迁移到编码条件的内容探针——连同其判定 logits，代价是一次前向传播且无需评审模型。诚实地做到这一点本身就是主要贡献。置换检验为 19 个条件中 17 个（一个开放守卫）与 12 个（另一个）授权解码测量；长度匹配零假设与在守卫基模型可证明无法解码的条件上校准的对照下限把两者都降到 4。被丢弃的格并非边缘情形：我们第一项分析中最大的结果——某守卫以 AUROC 0.72 表示某密码却无一阻止——是在其基模型解码率为零的编码上的伪象。在一个守卫上，两个不共享输入的筛查在哪些条件应被拒绝上完全一致。幸存的是一个真实但比未受控分析所声称更窄的策略失效：在守卫重点阻止的条件上，每 100 条提示有 7 到 23 条被表示而未阻止，在一个守卫几乎不阻止的条件上为 56/100。「未解码即阻止」全程接近零，因此两个守卫都不是对编码外观而是对内容作出反应。对真实密码两个守卫几乎什么都不阻止，我们把这些格报告为未测量而非解码失败证据。
summary_cn: 用残差流探针+置换检验+校准对照分离内容守卫的「未表示」与「未执行」：严格筛查后策略失效真实但更窄（重点条件 7–23/100），此前最大结果被证伪为伪象。
objective_summary: 提出以迁移内容探针与判定 logits 分离守卫表示失败与执行失败的方法学，配置换检验、长度匹配零假设与校准对照做诚实测量，并重估两个开放守卫的失效规模。
evidence_note: 置换检验授权加多重对照（长度匹配零假设、基模型解码率校准下限）、两守卫 19 条件系统测量，方法学严谨性为核心贡献。
novelty_note: 对既有「守卫失效」叙事的诊断性修正与可复用测量协议；探针迁移方法有先例。
scope: 结论适用于两个开放权重守卫与所测 19 个条件（真实密码格未测量）；对闭源守卫与多模态输入不适用。
limitations: 真实密码条件下无法测量（基模型不解码）；探针质量影响表示测量的可信度；守卫版本演进会使结论时效有限。

title: Refusing Everything Looks Safe: Restoring the Benign Arm to Encoded-Prompt Evaluation
abstract: Encoded-prompt attacks are evaluated almost entirely on their harmful arm: a benchmark sends obfuscated harmful requests and reports how often the model complied. A high refusal rate there is reported as safety, and it is equally consistent with a model that has stopped telling the request apart from anything else in the same format. We run the benign arm through the same transformation, and the two cases are far apart. Across four 7-8B models spanning three base families and four post-training recipes, refusal of harmful homoglyph-encoded prompts spans 0.08 while the same four span 0.57 on the identical requests in plaintext. What the encoding destroys is not refusal but the harm gap: on one model the gap between harmful and benign refusal falls from +0.82 in plaintext to exactly 0.00 under the encoding, and a benchmark reading only the harmful arm scores that model and one retaining a +0.61 gap identically. Running the cell such benchmarks leave out (plaintext content wearing the attack template, with nothing obfuscated) shows that on two of the four models the loss is caused by the protocol rather than by the character transformation, and on a third by the characters. Across a full SFT -> DPO -> RLVR pipeline the harm gap rises by +0.26 with a paired interval excluding zero while the standard harmful-arm metric registers no resolved change at all. We report twelve instrument defects, each with the control that caught it, including a binary jailbreak judge that fires on 0.61-0.70 of responses to plaintext benign prompts; six of the twelve inflate apparent safety, which is the direction a broken safety evaluation fails in by default.
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables; supplementary material included as an appendix
title_cn: 有拒绝无辨别：编码提示对安全训练模型做了什么
abstract_cn: 编码提示攻击几乎只在有害臂上被评估：基准发送混淆的有害请求并报告模型服从的频率。我们表明这一臂几乎不携带关于被测模型的信息。在四个独立后训练的 7–8B 模型上，有害同形字编码提示的拒绝跨度 0.08——在 n=100 时仅抽样噪声就能产生的 0.10 上限之内——而同样的四个模型对相同请求的明文形式拒绝跨度 0.57。编码破坏的不是拒绝而是辨别：在一个模型上，有害与良性拒绝差距从明文的 +0.82 降到编码下的恰好 0.00，良性与有害请求以相同的 0.99 被拒绝。只读有害臂的基准会给该模型与一个保持 +0.61 差距的模型打出相同分数。我们接着问后训练能否修复这一点，用已发表配方在相同基座权重上实验：不能。跨完整 SFT→DPO→RLVR 管线，明文有害辨别从 +0.55 升到 +0.80，而编码诱导的损失保持在 0.34–0.50 不变，且在每个被测编码上，标准有害臂指标与辨别向相反方向移动。没有该领域不常做的对照，这些全都不可见。我们报告八个仪器缺陷，每个附上捕获它的对照；它们在行为轴上共享一个方向：每个缺陷都夸大了表观安全性。
summary_cn: 同形字编码提示摧毁的是拒绝的「辨别力」而非拒绝本身：4 个 7–8B 模型有害臂跨度仅 0.08（噪声内）vs 明文 0.57，SFT→DPO→RLVR 不能修复，标准指标方向性错误。
objective_summary: 用有害/良性双臂对照揭示编码提示攻击评估中标准有害臂指标的信息缺失，量化后训练管线对辨别力损失的影响并报告八项仪器缺陷。
evidence_note: 四模型双臂对照、已发表后训练配方的受控复现（相同基座权重）、八项仪器缺陷均附捕获它的对照。
novelty_note: 系统证明该领域标准评估指标在编码攻击下方向性错误，属有诊断价值的实证修正并引入辨别度量。
scope: 结论适用于独立后训练的 7–8B 模型与所测同形字等编码；对更大模型与自适应编码的覆盖有限。
limitations: 模型规模与编码种类有限；辨别度量的阈值选择影响数值；未提出修正后的标准评估协议。

title: The Uncontrolled Variable: Vision-Language Refusal Is Conditioned on the Image-Attachment Interface, and Not Robust to Irrelevant Image Properties
abstract: We show that aligned vision-language models also condition refusal on a property of a request's form: whether an image is attached, holding everything the request asks fixed. Attaching a blank canvas, an image that cannot be read, cannot relate to the request, and is byte-identical across every prompt in its condition, shifts benign refusal by tens of points. The shift is not blanket caution but a threshold shift: genuinely neutral instructions are almost unaffected (<=2 percentage points on three of four hosted models) while borderline-benign prompts move +23 to +51 points, so the cost falls on sensitivity-adjacent traffic, meaning benign questions about privacy, self-harm, violence and illegal activity. There is a benign reading of such a threshold, namely that attachment correlates with risk in real traffic, and we take it seriously; a black-box study cannot measure that correlation and we do not claim to. What it can test is whether the response to attachment is robust to variation carrying no information about the request, and on four independent measurements it is not. It varies with canvas colour and pixel count. Its sign inverts across checkpoints. It survives an explicit instruction to disregard the image. And on one model it fires on a bare assertion that an attachment exists, with nothing attached and the modality word contributing none of it. Finally we price it. On a matched harmful set the same canvas does lower attack success, so the cue buys something. But the charge is decoupled from the purchase: the checkpoint with the least harmful headroom we measure, completing only 2% of plain harmful requests, still pays the benign cost in full, and across our models the harmful-side denominator falls as alignment improves while the benign cost does not track it down. Image presence is not a conservative default that a deployer chose and priced. It is an uncontrolled variable.

title_cn: 未受控变量：视觉语言模型拒绝行为随图像存在而变化，且无法用风险解释
abstract_cn: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的安全性本应取决于请求所求的内容。我们表明安全对齐的 VLM 还把拒绝锚定在请求形式的一个属性上：是否附带图像，而把请求所求的一切保持不变。附带一张空白画布——不可读、与请求无关、跨提示完全相同——会使拒绝率移动数十个百分点，且无任何防御介入。这一偏移并非一刀切的谨慎：中性指令几乎不受影响，而临界良性提示剧烈移动，代价落在敏感性相邻流量上——关于隐私、自残与暴力的良性问题。仅附带即充分，而图像属性决定代价：同尺寸的黑画布比白画布代价高得多，且在一个开放权重检查点上承载轴是像素数。该偏移也不受指令控制：告诉模型图像是可忽略的占位符只消除其中一小部分，且在一个模型上，断言存在附件即在无附件时大幅移动拒绝。部署中附带图像可能与风险相关；模型对它的处理并不追踪风险。这不是服务栈问题——同一权重经两种途径到达行为一致；也不是 VLM 的普遍性质——若干开放权重检查点毫无此现象。它属于特定对齐检查点，其中之一开放。它还与所得脱钩：画布确实阻止了匹配有害集上的部分攻击成功，但远低于其代价，且符号不固定——在一个开放模型上同一画布使模型明显更易被攻击。图像存在不是部署者选择或定价的默认值，而是随权重继承的未控变量。
summary_cn: 安全对齐 VLM 的拒绝受「是否附带图像」驱动：空白画布即移动拒绝数十百分点、指令无法消除，且与风险脱钩——一个开放模型上画布反而更易被攻击。
objective_summary: 用空白画布等受控对照隔离「图像存在」这一请求形式变量，跨多个 VLM 量化其对拒绝率、良性流量与攻击成功率的系统影响并溯源。
evidence_note: 严格受控对照（空白画布、同权重双途径、多开放检查点）、匹配有害集攻击验证、开放与闭源模型并测。
novelty_note: 首次系统揭示图像存在作为未控变量驱动拒绝且与风险脱钩，含符号反转的攻击面发现。
scope: 结论适用于特定安全对齐 VLM 检查点与单轮图文请求设定；部分开放权重模型无此现象，不能推广到全部 VLM。
limitations: 权重内部的触发机理未做解释；检查点集合有限；只测单轮请求，多轮对话未覆盖。

title: Zeta-Transform Evaluation for Higher-Order Vanishing Key Recovery
abstract: Hemmert's key-recovery algorithm for Classic McEliece is based on higher-order vanishing. It computes a basis of $\ker(\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)})$, where $A=H'''$ is the shortened parity-check matrix used in the attack. For Classic McEliece parameters, this kernel computation is the dominant cost of the attack. We show that the sums defining $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$ can be evaluated, column by column, as weighted upper zeta transforms on the Boolean lattice. Since only selected levels of these transforms are required by $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$, restricting their evaluation to the band between level $p$ and the lowest required level yields exact evaluations of both $\widetilde\varphi_A^{(p)}$ and its transpose. Using the resulting truncated zeta-transform evaluation in the Wiedemann-based kernel computation reduces the cost of the repeated matrix--vector products without changing the overall key-recovery algorithm. The exact cost depends on the weight distribution of the non-pivot columns of $H'''$. We therefore consider two models: an all-one model, in which every relevant binary coordinate is active, and a Bernoulli$(1/2)$ model, in which the coordinates are independently active with probability $1/2$. For the five Classic McEliece parameter sets, our method reduces the estimated key-recovery cost by $14.09$--$41.19$ bits in the all-one model and by $7.25$--$22.48$ bits in the Bernoulli$(1/2)$ model.

title_cn: 面向高阶消失密钥恢复的 zeta 变换求值
abstract_cn: Hemmert 针对 Classic McEliece 的密钥恢复算法基于高阶消失。它计算 ker(φ̃_A^(p)) 的基，其中 A = H''' 是攻击中使用的缩短校验矩阵。对 Classic McEliece 参数，该核计算是攻击的主要成本。我们证明定义 φ̃_A^(p) 的求和可以逐列地作为布尔格上的加权上 zeta 变换来求值。由于 φ̃_A^(p) 只需要这些变换的选定层，把求值限制在层 p 与最低所需层之间的带内即可得到 φ̃_A^(p) 及其转置的精确求值。在基于 Wiedemann 的核计算中使用由此得到的截断 zeta 变换求值，可降低重复矩阵–向量乘的代价而不改变整体密钥恢复算法。精确代价取决于 H''' 非主元列的重量分布。因此我们考虑两种模型：全一模型（每个相关二元坐标都激活）与 Bernoulli(1/2) 模型（坐标以概率 1/2 独立激活）。对五个 Classic McEliece 参数集，我们的方法在全一模型下把估计密钥恢复代价降低 14.09–41.19 比特，在 Bernoulli(1/2) 模型下降低 7.25–22.48 比特。
summary_cn: 把 Classic McEliece 高阶消失密钥恢复的核心算子求值改写为截断加权 zeta 变换，五组参数下估计攻击代价降低 7.25–41.19 比特，不改变算法本身。
objective_summary: 证明高阶消失算子可逐列经带限 zeta 变换精确求值，嵌入 Wiedemann 核计算降低矩阵-向量乘成本，并在两种重量分布模型下估计五组参数的代价降幅。
evidence_note: 精确算法改写加两种代价模型下的参数级估计；无完整实现或实测运行时间。
novelty_note: 对已知攻击（Hemmert）核心开销的实质性算法优化，攻击的渐近框架未变。
scope: 适用于 Classic McEliece 参数集与该攻击的核计算阶段；不改变攻击整体渐近复杂度。
limitations: 代价降幅依赖重量分布模型假设（全一或 Bernoulli）；未实现端到端攻击验证估计；对其他码基方案不直接适用。

title: StepTrigger: Contact-State-Triggered Backdoor Attacks on VLM-Powered Legged Robots
abstract: Large language models and vision-language models are increasingly used as high-level planners in robotic systems, using task goals and sensor summaries to select navigation or manipulation actions. This creates a new backdoor surface: a compromised planner can behave normally in most runs, yet change its target selection when a hidden trigger is present. Prior attacks on LLM-powered or embodied agents mainly rely on triggers that appear in language, camera-visible objects, scene semantics, or specific sequences of past actions. This paper presents StepTrigger, a contact-state-triggered backdoor attack for VLM-powered legged robots. The trigger is not a prompt token or a visible marker. It is produced by pressure and foot-ground contact patterns that arise when a Unitree Go1 quadruped walks across a dense terrain patch. Unlike conventional visual or textual triggers, contact signals are inherently noisy and may also arise during benign locomotion. To avoid treating every pressure anomaly as a trigger, StepTrigger learns a selective backdoor policy from multimodal robot state, using incidental pressure events as benign examples and dense-patch contacts as poisoned examples. In a stratified offline evaluation, the trained planner achieved 98.75% clean behavior preservation, 92.50% false-trigger rejection, 76.25% true-trigger activation, and 89.17% overall parsed behavior accuracy. These results reveal a backdoor surface in proprioceptive and contact channels that is not captured by defenses focused only on language, vision, or action history.
title_cn: StepTrigger：VLM 驱动足式机器人上接触状态触发的后门攻击
abstract_cn: 大语言模型与视觉语言模型越来越多地充当机器人系统的高层规划器，用任务目标与传感器摘要选择导航或操作动作。这创造了新的后门攻击面：被攻陷的规划器在多数运行中行为正常，却在隐藏触发器出现时改变目标选择。此前针对 LLM 驱动或具身智能体的攻击主要依赖出现在语言、摄像头可见物体、场景语义或特定历史动作序列中的触发器。本文提出 StepTrigger，一种面向 VLM 驱动足式机器人的接触状态触发后门攻击。触发器不是提示词或可见标记，而是四足机器人 Unitree Go1 走过密集地形块时产生的压力与足-地接触模式。与常规视觉或文本触发器不同，接触信号本质上有噪声且可能在良性运动中出现。为避免把每次压力异常都当触发器，StepTrigger 从多模态机器人状态学习选择性后门策略，用附带压力事件作良性样本、密集块接触作中毒样本。在分层离线评估中，训练后的规划器达到 98.75% 干净行为保持、92.50% 假触发拒绝、76.25% 真触发激活与 89.17% 总体解析行为准确率。这些结果揭示了本体感觉与接触信道中一个未被聚焦语言、视觉或动作历史的防御所覆盖的后门攻击面。
summary_cn: StepTrigger 用足-地接触模式作 VLM 足式机器人后门触发器：离线评估干净行为保持 98.75%、真触发激活 76.25%、假触发拒绝 92.5%，揭示本体感觉信道新攻击面。
objective_summary: 提出以接触状态为触发条件的选择性后门攻击，从多模态机器人状态学习区分良性压力事件与触发模式，并在 Unitree Go1 上离线评估。
evidence_note: 真实平台（Unitree Go1）但为离线分层评估；保持/拒绝/激活/解析四指标体系完整；无在线闭环与真实部署。
novelty_note: 新触发通道：以本体感觉/接触状态而非语言、视觉或动作序列为后门条件，属新威胁面。
scope: 适用于 VLM 高层规划+接触传感的足式机器人设定；结论来自离线评估，对在线控制回路与不同地形的泛化未验证。
limitations: 真触发激活率 76.25% 有缺口；需在路径上布置密集地形块这一物理前提；未评估防御侧检测。

title: A Cross-Dataset based Zero-Day Intrusion Detection System by Integrating Siamese Network and Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Zero-day threats are nascent for the Internet of Things (IoT) network security, which demands cognitive detec-tion mechanisms that can identify emerging malicious behavior. Conventional intrusion detection mechanisms fail to generalize dynamic zero-day exploits within sophisticated IoT environments. This paper proposes a hybrid zero-day intrusion detection system using Siamese network-based anomaly correlation and reinforcement learning-based adaptive defense. Furthermore, the paper uses unsupervised machine learning classifiers over benchmark IoT datasets with the intention of detection of known attack types compared to unknown anomalies using distance-based similarity analysis to detect possible zero-day attacks. To facilitate adaptability, a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) reinforcement learning-based agent dynamically adjusts the defense policy with continuous feedback and optimization. Experimental evaluations demonstrate 99.28% training accuracy, 99.07% accuracy in unknown attack detection, and 93.94% zero-day detection ratio, confirming the convergence and stability of the model on datasets.The system offers a self-learning and extensible defense mechanism of IoT deployments by finding the right balance between precision, latency and false positives. This deep anomaly correlation with adaptive reinforcement learning is a firm base on which the next generation and autonomic cyber security solutions can take the reins as the zero-day threats keep changing their course.
title_cn: 融合孪生网络与强化学习的跨数据集零日入侵检测系统
abstract_cn: 零日威胁对 IoT 网络安全而言是新生的挑战，需要能识别新兴恶意行为的认知式检测机制。传统入侵检测机制难以在复杂 IoT 环境中泛化动态零日利用。本文提出结合孪生网络异常关联与强化学习自适应防御的混合零日入侵检测系统。此外，本文在基准 IoT 数据集上使用无监督机器学习分类器，通过基于距离的相似性分析区分已知攻击类型与未知异常，以发现可能的零日攻击。为增强适应性，近端策略优化（PPO）强化学习智能体以持续反馈与优化动态调整防御策略。实验评估显示 99.28% 训练准确率、99.07% 未知攻击检测准确率与 93.94% 零日检测率，确认模型在数据集上的收敛与稳定性。该系统通过在精度、时延与误报间取得平衡，为 IoT 部署提供自学习、可扩展的防御机制。这种深度异常关联与自适应强化学习的结合，是零日威胁不断演变下下一代自主网络安全方案的坚实基础。
summary_cn: 组合孪生网络异常关联与 PPO 自适应防御的 IoT 零日入侵检测：基准数据集上报告训练准确率 99.28%、未知攻击 99.07%、零日检测率 93.94%，未给基线对比。
objective_summary: 提出孪生网络相似性度量加无监督检测已知/未知差异、PPO 智能体动态调防御策略的混合零日 IDS，并在基准 IoT 数据集上报告指标。
evidence_note: 仅在基准数据集上自报指标，无与既有 IDS 的系统对比、消融或统计检验，「零日检测率」等指标定义不明确。
novelty_note: 孪生网络与 RL 均为成熟组件的常规组合，零日检测问题设定亦是既有方向。
scope: 结论限于所测基准 IoT 数据集与实验室设定；对真实部署的时延与误报代价未验证。
limitations: 缺少基线与消融；零日定义与评估协议不透明；RL 防御策略的实际响应动作与安全性未说明。

title: Beyond Classification Accuracy: Quantifying Fingerprint Complexity in Encrypted Darknet Services
abstract: Existing darknet traffic studies primarily evaluate service fingerprintability through classification performance, providing limited insight into why certain services are easier or harder to identify. This paper introduces the Fingerprint Complexity Score (FCS), a framework for quantifying the intrinsic complexity of darknet service fingerprints using behavioral overlap, uncertainty, disagreement, and persistent confusion. Experiments on 25 services across the Tor, I2P, FreeNet, and ZeroNet anonymity networks reveal substantial variation in fingerprint complexity, with behavioral overlap emerging as the dominant contributor. Validation using Random Forest, Extra Trees, and XGBoost demonstrates a strong inverse relationship between fingerprint complexity and recognition performance (Pearson r = -0.706, Spearman \r{ho} = -0.765, p < 0.001). The findings show that service fingerprintability is fundamentally governed by behavioral complexity, providing a new perspective for analyzing behavioral information leakage in anonymity networks.
title_cn: 超越分类准确率：量化加密暗网服务中的指纹复杂度
abstract_cn: 现有暗网流量研究主要通过分类性能评估服务可指纹性，对为何某些服务更易或更难识别提供的洞见有限。本文提出指纹复杂度分数（FCS），一个用行为重叠、不确定性、分歧与持续混淆量化暗网服务指纹内在复杂度的框架。在 Tor、I2P、FreeNet 与 ZeroNet 四个匿名网络的 25 个服务上的实验显示指纹复杂度差异显著，行为重叠是主导贡献因子。用随机森林、极端随机树与 XGBoost 的验证表明指纹复杂度与识别性能呈强负相关（Pearson r = -0.706，Spearman ρ = -0.765，p < 0.001）。发现表明服务可指纹性根本上由行为复杂度支配，为分析匿名网络中的行为信息泄漏提供了新视角。
summary_cn: 提出指纹复杂度分数 FCS 量化暗网服务可指纹性：四个匿名网络 25 个服务上，复杂度与三种分类器识别性能强负相关（r=-0.706，p<0.001），行为重叠为主导因子。
objective_summary: 定义基于行为重叠、不确定性与混淆的指纹复杂度框架，跨四个匿名网络 25 个服务量化其与分类器识别性能的统计关系。
evidence_note: 四网络 25 服务、三种分类器验证、报告相关系数与显著性；但流量采集规模与时效未详、无外部数据集对照。
novelty_note: 从「分类精度」转向「为何可指纹」的度量视角有诊断价值；FCS 为新提出的复合指标。
scope: 结论适用于所测四网络 25 服务与流量级行为特征；对协议更新后的稳定性未验证。
limitations: 服务集合与采集窗口有限；FCS 各分量权重设定依赖经验选择；未见跨时间重复采集的稳定性检验。

title: From Bilinear to Linear: Differentially Private Federated LoRA via Low-Dimensional Parameterization
abstract: Federated Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) provides an efficient solution for finetuning large language models across distributed and privacy-sensitive data. However, despite avoiding raw data sharing, federated LoRA remains vulnerable to privacy leakage through transmitted model updates. Differential privacy (DP) mitigates such leakage, but integrating DP into federated LoRA introduces two fundamental challenges: aggregation mismatch from independently averaging low-rank factors, and quadratic noise amplification when noise is injected into both factors. To address these challenges, we propose FedHSIP, a differentially private federated LoRA framework based on a unified low-dimensional parameterization. FedHSIP reformulates all LoRA parameters into a shared low-dimensional trainable vector, enabling clients to optimize and communicate only low-dimensional updates. This reformulation transforms federated LoRA from a bilinear factor aggregation problem into a unified linear parameter space, thereby eliminating aggregation mismatch and preventing the quadratic amplification of DP noise. To further handle non-IID data, we introduce a heterogeneity- and sensitivity-aware isometric projection, constructed from warm-up statistics, which groups coordinates with compatible cross-client update patterns while balancing sensitivity, update energy, and heterogeneity across the low-dimensional space. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding and generation benchmarks show that FedHSIP consistently outperforms existing federated LoRA methods under both private and non-private settings, achieving up to 3-4% improvements under differential privacy while reducing communication cost by over 80% and maintaining robustness under heterogeneous data distributions.
title_cn: 从双线性到线性：经低维参数化的差分隐私联邦 LoRA
abstract_cn: 联邦低秩适配（LoRA）为跨分布式、隐私敏感数据微调大语言模型提供高效方案。然而尽管避免共享原始数据，联邦 LoRA 仍易受通过传输模型更新的隐私泄漏影响。差分隐私（DP）可缓解此类泄漏，但把 DP 集成进联邦 LoRA 引入两个根本挑战：独立平均低秩因子导致的聚合失配，以及向两个因子注入噪声时的二次噪声放大。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 FedHSIP，一个基于统一低维参数化的差分隐私联邦 LoRA 框架。FedHSIP 把所有 LoRA 参数重表述为共享低维可训练向量，使客户端只优化与通信低维更新。这一重表述把联邦 LoRA 从双线性因子聚合问题转为统一线性参数空间，消除聚合失配并防止 DP 噪声的二次放大。为进一步处理非独立同分布数据，我们引入由预热统计构造的异质性与敏感性感知等距投影，把具有兼容跨客户端更新模式的坐标分组，同时平衡低维空间中的敏感性、更新能量与异质性。在自然语言理解与生成基准上的大量实验表明，FedHSIP 在隐私与非隐私设定下均持续优于现有联邦 LoRA 方法，在差分隐私下取得至多 3–4% 提升，通信成本降低超过 80%，并在异构数据分布下保持鲁棒。
summary_cn: FedHSIP 把 LoRA 参数重表述为统一低维向量，消除聚合失配与 DP 噪声二次放大：DP 下提升至多 3–4%、通信降 80%+，非 IID 下保持鲁棒。
objective_summary: 提出统一低维参数化的 DP 联邦 LoRA 框架，配合异质性与敏感性感知等距投影处理非 IID，并在 NLU/NLG 基准上与现有方法对比。
evidence_note: NLU/NLG 多基准、隐私与非隐私双设定、与现有联邦 LoRA 方法的系统对比、通信成本量化。
novelty_note: 对 DP 联邦 LoRA 两大失败模式（聚合失配、二次噪声）的针对性重构是实质性机制；低维参数化组件有先例。
scope: 结论适用于参数高效微调场景与所测 NLU/NLG 任务；隐私保证以 DP 定义为准。
limitations: 低维瓶颈可能限制任务适应上限；投影依赖预热统计引入额外阶段；DP 预算与隐私-效用曲线的覆盖有限。

title: Learning to Link: Automatic Re-identification of BLE Devices Under MAC Address Randomisation
abstract: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) employs MAC address randomisation -- via Resolvable Private Address (RPA) -- to mitigate long-term device tracking on public advertising channels. Existing research has shown that advertising packets contain metadata and structural features that allow re-identifying a target device via manually crafted rules. In this work, we investigate the feasibility of automating the process of tracking BLE devices despite MAC randomisation by leveraging machine learning algorithms for the signature creation. Based on the actual Bluetooth traffic from target devices, we characterise the persistence of advertising-layer features across RPA changes and formulate device linkage as a supervised classification problem. Using simple decision tree classifiers as a proof-of-feasibility approach, we evaluate the distinguishability of target and non-target devices under varying address rotation patterns. Our results reinforce prior work demonstrating that advertising-layer metadata can enable device re-identification under MAC randomisation, to the point where such linkage can be automated using standard supervised learning techniques, without any specific knowledge of the technology.
comment: Accepted at WTMC 2026
title_cn: 学会链接：MAC 地址随机化下 BLE 设备的自动重识别
abstract_cn: 低功耗蓝牙（BLE）通过可解析私有地址（RPA）实现 MAC 地址随机化，以缓解公共广播信道上的长期设备追踪。已有研究表明广播包包含允许通过手工构造规则重新识别目标设备的元数据与结构特征。本工作研究在 MAC 随机化下用机器学习算法自动构建签名、从而自动化 BLE 设备追踪的可行性。基于目标设备的真实蓝牙流量，我们刻画广播层特征跨 RPA 更换的持续性，并把设备链接形式化为监督分类问题。以简单决策树分类器作为可行性验证方法，我们评估在不同地址轮换模式下目标与非目标设备的可区分性。结果强化了先前工作：广播层元数据能在 MAC 随机化下支持设备重识别，且这种链接可用标准监督学习技术自动化，无需任何该技术的专门知识。
summary_cn: 用决策树在真实 BLE 流量上自动化 RPA 更换后的设备重识别：广播层特征跨地址轮换持续，验证监督学习可在无协议专门知识时自动链接设备（WTMC 2026）。
objective_summary: 把 BLE 设备链接形式化为监督分类问题，刻画广播层特征跨 RPA 更换的持续性，并用决策树在不同轮换模式下验证自动重识别可行性。
evidence_note: 真实流量数据与多轮换模式评估、WTMC 2026 录用；但以可行性验证为主、分类器简单、设备与场景规模有限。
novelty_note: 核心结论（广播层元数据可重识别）与先前手工规则工作一致，新意在用监督学习自动化并验证可行性。
scope: 结论适用于 BLE 广播信道与所测地址轮换模式；对加密载荷内容与其他无线协议不覆盖。
limitations: 决策树仅作可行性验证，未探索更强模型；目标设备数量与场景有限；未评估对抗性轮换策略。

title: Selection-Invariant Communication Compilers for Privacy-Aware Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
abstract: Structured multi-agent workflows exchange intermediate messages whose content and form can reveal private state even when the final output is safe. We identify selection-channel leakage: after authorization fixes what may be released, a private-state-aware choice among semantically valid realizations creates an additional inference channel. We introduce the selection-invariant communication compiler(SICC), which constrains this post-authorization representation kernel rather than prescribing templates. Any deterministic or independently public-randomized generator satisfying the invariant is valid; requirement-indexed canonical forms are one auditable implementation. We prove a compositional communication-layer guarantee: authorization, public-only form generation, and a dependency-safe utility gate make the emitted transcript reveal no information beyond the complete authorized view. Private-state-aware selection remains vulnerable after surface-disjoint and length-matched controls. Across 132 AgentLeak communication replays and 100 executable LangGraph tasks, deterministic SICC retains complete protocol utility without a positive excess-gain signal; independent public randomization preserves the same result in AgentLeak and 480 controlled cases.
title_cn: 面向隐私感知多智能体 LLM 工作流的选择不变通信编译器
abstract_cn: 结构化多智能体工作流交换的中间消息，即使最终输出安全，其内容与形式也可能泄露私有状态。我们识别出选择信道泄漏：在授权确定可发布内容之后，在语义等价的具体实现间做私有状态感知的选择会创造额外的推断信道。我们提出选择不变通信编译器（SICC），约束这一授权后表示核而非规定模板。任何满足该不变式的确定性或独立公开随机化生成器都有效；带需求索引的规范形式是一种可审计实现。我们证明组合式通信层保证：授权、仅公开形式生成与依赖安全的效用门共同使发出的转录不泄露超出完整授权视图的任何信息。私有状态感知选择在表面不相交与长度匹配对照之后仍然脆弱。在 132 次 AgentLeak 通信重放与 100 个可执行 LangGraph 任务上，确定性 SICC 在无正超额增益信号的情况下保留完整协议效用；独立公开随机化在 AgentLeak 与 480 个受控用例中保持同样结果。
summary_cn: 识别「选择信道泄漏」：授权后的表述选择仍泄露私有状态；SICC 编译器使转录不超出授权视图，132 次 AgentLeak 重放与 100 个 LangGraph 任务上零超额增益。
objective_summary: 识别多智能体工作流中授权后表示选择造成的额外泄漏信道，定义选择不变式并证明组合式不泄露保证，在 AgentLeak 与 LangGraph 任务上验证效用无损。
evidence_note: 形式化定义与组合式证明加 AgentLeak 132 次重放、100 个可执行任务与 480 个受控用例，含长度匹配与表面不相交对照。
novelty_note: 首次识别并形式化「选择信道」这一授权后泄漏面，并给出可实现的编译器抽象与不泄露保证。
scope: 适用于结构化多智能体工作流的授权后消息形式；对模型内生泄露、时序信道与自适应对手未完全覆盖。
limitations: 不变式约束可能损失表达自由度（所测任务上效用未损）；需要授权视图的完整规范；随机化依赖公开随机源。

title: Policy-Backed Selective Regeneration under Tainted Inter-Agent Communication
abstract: Inter-agent communication is essential to multi-agent language-model systems, yet a single message may combine task-critical information with instructions not authorized by the original request. Prompt-based defenses leave enforcement to models exposed to adversarial messages, while indiscriminate message removal discards useful information. We introduce Executable Semantic Commitments with Clean-Room Recovery (ESC-CR), a policy-backed framework for secure inter-agent code generation and recovery. It separates message claims from authorization, constructs executable commitments from trusted tasks, evidence, and policy, and enforces them at an external release boundary. Upon a violation, ESC-CR taints the responsible message and rejected artifact, reconstructs a clean context from evidence-backed task information, and regenerates under the same policy. We evaluate ESC-CR across communication-essential and standard code-generation benchmarks, multiple model families and communication topologies, and adaptive attacks spanning direct, obfuscated, and verifier-aware payloads. Results show that polluted-context retry frequently fails to remove unauthorized influence, while complete message removal can discard information required by communication-essential tasks. ESC-CR preserves evidence-backed claims while suppressing unauthorized releases under matched computational budgets, and the same design transfers to end-to-end agent trajectories.
title_cn: 受污染智能体间通信下的策略支撑选择性再生
abstract_cn: 智能体间通信对多智能体语言模型系统至关重要，但单条消息可能把任务关键信息与未经原始请求授权的指令组合在一起。基于提示的防御把执行留给暴露于对抗消息的模型，而不加区分地删除消息会丢弃有用信息。我们提出带洁净室恢复的可执行语义承诺（ESC-CR），一个面向安全智能体间代码生成与恢复的策略支撑框架。它把消息声称与授权分离，从可信任务、证据与策略构造可执行承诺，并在外部发布边界执行。发生违例时，ESC-CR 污染责任消息与被拒工件，从有证据支撑的任务信息重建洁净上下文，并在同一策略下重新生成。我们在通信必要与标准代码生成基准、多个模型家族与通信拓扑、以及涵盖直接、混淆与验证器感知载荷的自适应攻击上评估 ESC-CR。结果显示：污染上下文重试常无法去除未授权影响，而完全删除消息会丢弃通信必要任务所需的信息。ESC-CR 在匹配计算预算下保留有证据支撑的声称同时抑制未授权发布，同一设计还可迁移到端到端智能体轨迹。
summary_cn: ESC-CR 用可执行语义承诺在外部发布边界拦截越权指令，违例后污染消息并洁净室重生成；在匹配预算下对比污染重试与消息全删基线，保留有用信息并抑制越权发布。
objective_summary: 提出消息声称与授权分离、外部边界执行与违例后洁净重建的多智能体代码生成安全框架，并在多基准、多拓扑与自适应攻击下评估。
evidence_note: 跨基准、模型家族、通信拓扑与三类自适应攻击的系统评估，含与污染重试/消息全删基线的预算匹配对比。
novelty_note: 外部策略执行+污染追踪+洁净室恢复是对多智能体提示注入防御的实质性系统化组合；单组件各有先例。
scope: 适用于代码生成类智能体间通信与可外部化的发布边界；对纯对话任务与模型内生防御未覆盖。
limitations: 承诺构造依赖可信任务与策略规格质量；自适应攻击空间仍有限；端到端轨迹迁移的评估深度未明。

title: Toward Responsible AI-Augmented Cyber Defense: Pattern Recognition, Defense-in-Depth, and the Case for Human-AI Collaboration
abstract: Cybersecurity literature has extensively documented the operational benefits of artificial intelligence (AI) for threat detection, incident response, and prevention, while raising qualitative concerns about over-automation, algorithmic bias, and analyst-skill erosion. What remains largely absent is a formal, falsifiable model connecting three constructs that recur across this literature: Defense-in-Depth Theory, the Artificial Intelligence Theory of Pattern Recognition, and human-AI collaboration in security operations. This paper develops such a model. We formalize layered defense as a Bernoulli detection cascade in which AI augmentation enters multiplicatively across layers; we formalize each layer's pattern-recognition behavior as a Neyman-Pearson/Bayesian detector with a derived closed-form optimal threshold; and we formalize human-AI triage as a capacity-constrained cascade with an explicit, quantifiable trade-off between detection probability and false-alarm ("alert fatigue") rate. A Monte Carlo/analytical simulation evaluated at illustrative but realistic operating points shows that (i) AI augmentation compounds across defense layers, delivering its largest marginal gains exactly where traditional layering saturates, and (ii) full human review of AI-flagged alerts is not optimal: increasing analyst capacity toward 100% coverage cuts false alarms by roughly 20-fold but simultaneously lowers system-level detection probability, because imperfect analyst accuracy is then applied to every alert rather than a filtered subset. These results give the widely repeated qualitative recommendation of "balanced human-AI collaboration" a precise, testable form and suggest an interior-optimum capacity ratio as a concrete design target for security operations centers (SOCs), including those securing IT/OT-converged critical infrastructure.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Original theoretical and modeling contribution. Simulation code: this https URL
title_cn: 迈向负责任的 AI 增强网络防御：模式识别、纵深防御与人机协作
abstract_cn: 网络安全文献广泛记录了 AI 在威胁检测、事件响应与预防中的操作收益，同时对过度自动化、算法偏见与分析师技能退化提出定性担忧。大体缺失的是一个连接三个在该文献中反复出现的构念的可证伪形式模型：纵深防御理论、模式识别的人工智能理论、以及安全运营中的人机协作。本文构建了这样的模型。我们把分层防御形式化为伯努利检测级联，AI 增强以乘法方式进入各层；把每层的模式识别行为形式化为带推导出的闭式最优阈值的 Neyman–Pearson/贝叶斯检测器；把人机分诊形式化为容量受限级联，显式刻画检测概率与误报（「告警疲劳」）率之间可量化的权衡。在示意但现实的操作点上评估的蒙特卡洛/解析仿真表明：(i) AI 增强跨防御层复合，其最大边际增益恰出现在传统分层饱和处；(ii) 对 AI 标记告警的全人工复核并非最优：把分析师容量提高到 100% 覆盖会把误报降低约 20 倍，但同时降低系统级检测概率，因为不完美的分析师准确率此时被施加于每条告警而非过滤后的子集。这些结果把被广泛重复的「平衡人机协作」定性建议变为精确、可检验的形式，并为包括 IT/OT 融合关键基础设施在内的安全运营中心提出内部最优容量比这一具体设计目标。
summary_cn: 把纵深防御、模式识别与人机分诊形式化为可证伪模型：AI 增益跨层复合、100% 人工复核降 20 倍误报却降系统检出率，给出 SOC 容量比的内部最优点。
objective_summary: 构建连接纵深防御级联、Neyman–Pearson 检测与容量受限人机分诊的形式化模型，用蒙特卡洛仿真量化 AI 增强、层级与人工复核覆盖的权衡。
evidence_note: 解析推导加示意操作点上的蒙特卡洛仿真；无真实 SOC 数据或实测系统验证，代码公开。
novelty_note: 把定性共识形式化为可检验模型并给出非单调（内部最优）结论，属有诊断价值的理论综合。
scope: 适用于所设伯努利级联与容量受限分诊假设下的抽象 SOC；层间独立性与分析师错误率设定是边界。
limitations: 参数为示意值非实测；假设各层独立、AI 层错误率外生；未用真实告警数据校准。

title: Hydrozoan: Latency-Adaptive DAG Consensus under Mixed Byzantine and Crash Faults
abstract: DAG-based consensus protocols can achieve great throughput and the optimal three-message-delay limit for n = 3f+1 consensus. While two-delay protocols exist, they pay with reduced resilience (requiring 5f+1-style committees) or rely on fallbacks that sacrifice the DAG's high throughput. This paper introduces Hydrozoan, the first DAG protocol with a dual commit path under a hybrid fault model of f Byzantine and c crashed validators, on n = 3f+c+2p+1 validators. Leaders commit in two message delays whenever at most p validators are faulty, and in three otherwise, with no extra messages, no view changes, and multiple leaders per round. Both paths are evaluated on the same DAG, using a novel graded indirect rule to reconcile them so that every honest validator reaches the same decision. We show that under geo-distributed conditions, which path is faster is a property of geography rather than the protocol, as rounds reaching a remote region cost far more than those that do not. The (f, c, p) knobs place the fast quorum where the deployment requires it, allowing a commit in two message delays. If misconfigured, Hydrozoan can still commit in three message delays: Hydrozoan commits on whichever path fires first. We also present Optimal-Hydrozoan, a variant that tolerates one more fault on the fast path, the first construction to match the known lower bound. The safety and liveness of both protocols are machine-checked in Lean 4. Our geo-distributed evaluation shows that Hydrozoan matches Mysticeti's throughput, commits ~25% faster when the fast quorum fits fast regions, and falls back to three message delays when it does not or past p faults, where existing two-delay protocols stall.
title_cn: Hydrozoan：混合拜占庭与崩溃故障下的时延自适应 DAG 共识
abstract_cn: 基于 DAG 的共识协议能实现很高吞吐，并在 n = 3f+1 下达到最优三消息时延。两时延协议虽存在，但要么以降低韧性为代价（需要 5f+1 式委员会），要么依赖牺牲 DAG 高吞吐的回退。本文提出 Hydrozoan，首个在 f 个拜占庭加 c 个崩溃验证者的混合故障模型下、于 n = 3f+c+2p+1 个验证者上具备双提交路径的 DAG 协议：当至多 p 个验证者故障时领导者以两消息时延提交，否则三消息，无需额外消息、无需视图切换、每轮多领导者。两条路径在同一 DAG 上评估，用新颖的分级间接规则调和，使每个诚实验证者达成相同决策。我们表明在地理分布条件下哪条路径更快是地理性质而非协议性质，因为到达远程区域的轮次成本远高于不到达的轮次。(f, c, p) 旋钮把快速法定人数放在部署需要之处，实现两消息时延提交；若配置失当，Hydrozoan 仍可三消息时延提交：哪条路径先触发就在哪条上提交。我们还给出 Optimal-Hydrozoan 变体，在快速路径上多容忍一个故障，是首个达到已知下界的构造。两协议的安全与活性均在 Lean 4 中机器检验。地理分布评估显示 Hydrozoan 匹配 Mysticeti 的吞吐，在快速法定人数落在快速区域时提交快约 25%，否则或故障超过 p 时回退到三消息时延，而既有两时延协议在此时停滞。
summary_cn: Hydrozoan：混合拜占庭+崩溃故障下首个双提交路径 DAG 共识，n=3f+c+2p+1，两/三消息时延自适应，Lean 4 机器检验，吞吐匹敌 Mysticeti 且快约 25%。
objective_summary: 设计并机器验证支持混合故障模型与自适应双提交路径的 DAG 共识协议，给出达到快速路径容错下界的变体与地理分布评估。
evidence_note: Lean 4 机器检验安全与活性、地理分布实测、与 Mysticeti 同台吞吐对比、快速路径容错下界匹配证明。
novelty_note: 混合故障下双路径 DAG 共识为首创，Optimal-Hydrozoan 首次达到快速路径已知容错下界。
scope: 适用于部分同步与所设混合故障模型；性能结论来自所测地理分布与工作负载设定。
limitations: 双路径调和规则增加证明与实现复杂度；性能优势依赖快速法定人数与地理布局匹配；配置失当时退化为三时延而非两时延。

title: How It's Made: Uncovering Detection Engineering Processes for Network Intrusion Detection Rules
abstract: Many Security Operations Centers rely on signature-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems like Suricata, yet detection rule engineering remains understudied. We investigate this process by introducing SuriCap, a platform for rule engineering exercises, and hosting CTF-style workshops where 60 participants, trained MSc students, and experienced SOC professionals, created rules for four scenarios. Participants produced 3146 valid rules, enabling analysis of their methods, performance, and iteration patterns. Surprisingly, prior experience had limited impact on rule quality, suggesting that less experienced engineers can produce rules comparable to experts. We also observed challenges in generalizing rules beyond available tests, underscoring the need for sufficient labeled data. From our study, we identify three phases and a common pattern in rule engineering, offering SOC managers insights to improve their processes and expectations of engineer expertise.
title_cn: 规则是如何炼成的：揭示网络入侵检测规则的检测工程过程
abstract_cn: 许多安全运营中心依赖 Suricata 等基于签名的网络入侵检测系统，但检测规则工程本身仍未被充分研究。我们通过推出规则工程练习平台 SuriCap 并举办 CTF 风格工作坊来研究这一过程，60 名参与者——受训硕士生与有经验 SOC 专业人员——为四个场景编写规则。参与者产出 3146 条有效规则，使我们能分析其方法、表现与迭代模式。令人意外的是，先前经验对规则质量影响有限，表明经验较少的工程师也能产出与专家相当的规则。我们还观察到把规则泛化到可用测试之外时的困难，凸显充足标注数据的必要。从研究中我们识别出规则工程的三个阶段与一个共同模式，为 SOC 管理者改进流程与设定工程师专长预期提供参考。
summary_cn: SuriCap 工作坊研究 NID 规则工程过程：60 名参与者产出 3146 条 Suricata 规则，经验对质量影响有限，规则泛化受限于测试数据，总结出三阶段过程模式。
objective_summary: 搭建规则工程练习平台并组织 CTF 式工作坊，收集并分析 60 名参与者 3146 条规则的方法、质量与迭代模式。
evidence_note: 真实人员实验、60 名参与者含在职 SOC 专业人员、3146 条规则、四个场景，主客观数据结合。
novelty_note: 首个对 NID 规则工程过程的系统化人员研究，给出过程阶段化刻画；平台为支撑设施。
scope: 结论适用于 Suricata 规则与工作坊式任务设定；对真实事件响应中的规则工程与更大规模 SOC 实践的外推有限。
limitations: 参与者以受训学生为主；四个场景覆盖有限；规则质量以练习评分衡量而非实战检测效果。

title: LoRango: It Takes Two LoRAs to Unlock Hidden Behaviors in Diffusion Models
abstract: Users commonly combine multiple Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters to personalize images with different subjects, styles, and visual attributes. Yet inspecting adapters individually does not establish the safety of their composition. We identify and characterize a pair-conditioned attack in text-to-image diffusion: individually useful and benign-appearing adapters redirect image generation when co-loaded with a specifically matched partner, whose identity serves as the trigger. We introduce LoRango to realize this attack through complementary Signature and Payload adapters. The Signature writes a pair-specific code into intermediate carrier representations, while the Payload uses code-selective responses and opposing signal/reference branches. These branches approximately cancel for standalone adapters and mismatched pairs; matched code-reader alignment breaks cancellation within native GEGLU blocks and releases the programmed action. Both adapters are exported as ordinary static LoRA files compatible with standard loaders, requiring no prompt trigger or base-pipeline modification. LoRango achieves matched-pair attack success rates of 97.9\% on SD v1.5 and 98.7\% on SDXL, compared with 2.8--4.6\% when implanted adapters are loaded individually. Further experiments evaluate pair selectivity, standalone fidelity, robustness to deployment variations, and applicability across denoiser architectures. These findings show that individual-adapter inspection is insufficient to assess the security of multi-LoRA personalization and motivate auditing adapter compositions.
title_cn: LoRango：两个 LoRA 协同解锁扩散模型的隐藏行为
abstract_cn: 用户常组合多个低秩适配（LoRA）来个性化不同主体、风格与视觉属性的图像。然而单独检查适配器并不能确立其组合的安全性。我们在文生图扩散模型中识别并刻画一种以配对为条件的攻击：单独看有用且良性的适配器，在与一个特定匹配伙伴共同加载时会重定向图像生成，伙伴的身份即触发器。我们提出 LoRango 通过互补的签名与载荷适配器实现该攻击。签名适配器向中间载体表示写入配对专用代码，载荷适配器利用代码选择性响应与相对的信号/参考分支。这些分支对独立适配器与不匹配对近似抵消；匹配的代码-读取器对齐在原生 GEGLU 块内打破抵消并释放编程动作。两个适配器都以与标准加载器兼容的普通静态 LoRA 文件导出，无需提示触发器或基础管线修改。LoRango 在 SD v1.5 上取得 97.9%、在 SDXL 上 98.7% 的匹配对攻击成功率，而单独加载被植入适配器时仅 2.8–4.6%。进一步实验评估配对选择性、独立保真度、对部署变化的鲁棒性与跨去噪器架构的适用性。这些发现表明单独检查适配器不足以评估多 LoRA 个性化的安全性，需要审计适配器组合。
summary_cn: LoRango 揭示双 LoRA 配对后门：单独良性、配对触发的签名/载荷适配器在 SD v1.5/SDXL 上攻击成功率 97.9%/98.7%（单独仅 2.8–4.6%），无需提示触发器。
objective_summary: 识别并刻画扩散模型中以适配器配对为触发条件的后门攻击，设计签名-载荷双适配器实现机制，并系统评估配对选择性、保真度与鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 两代模型（SD v1.5/SDXL）上 97.9%/98.7% 对 2.8–4.6% 的配对/单独对照，附配对选择性与部署变化鲁棒性消融。
novelty_note: 新威胁模型：以适配器组合本身为触发器的供应链攻击，绕过单适配器审计，属实质性新机制。
scope: 结论适用于使用标准 LoRA 加载器的文生图扩散生态；对其他适配格式、多于两个适配器的组合与防御侧审计工具未评估。
limitations: 需攻击者控制两个适配器之一的植入并分发匹配伙伴；对组合审计防御的有效性未测试；跨生态（非 SD 架构）覆盖有限。

title: COBRA: A Content-Agnostic Framework for Zero-Day Detection of Suspicious Domains
abstract: The use of malicious domains is central to cyberattacks such as phishing, malware distribution, impersonation, and fraudulent transactions. Because domains are inexpensive to register and easy to deploy at scale, they remain one of the most common and damaging tools used in cybercrime across industries. Proactive detection is essential to reducing this window of vulnerability and preventing harm to users. In this work, we propose COBRA: a content-agnostic, registration-time detection framework for identifying and analyzing suspicious domains from day zero. Our approach does not rely on any content-based features, allowing us to classify a domain even before it is populated with content. We analyze the names of newly registered domains and employ a clustering technique to group them based on lexical and structural similarity. We evaluate our methodology using real-world data consisting of 1.5M newly created domains, demonstrating that COBRA detects suspicious domains with a precision of 98.5%, identifying more than 47K distinct newly registered suspicious domains. Furthermore, our results show that domain-name clustering enables accurate early detection, allowing us to identify 80% of suspicious or malicious domains earlier than one of the most widely used threat-intelligence services, which in some cases may require up to 7 days.
title_cn: COBRA：面向可疑域名零日检测的内容无关框架
abstract_cn: 恶意域名是钓鱼、恶意软件分发、仿冒与欺诈交易等网络攻击的核心。由于域名注册便宜且易于规模化部署，它仍是各行业网络犯罪中最常见、危害最大的工具之一。主动检测对缩短这一脆弱窗口、防止对用户的伤害至关重要。本工作提出 COBRA：一个内容无关、注册时即可识别与分析可疑域名的零日检测框架。我们的方法不依赖任何基于内容的特征，从而能在域名尚未填充内容时对其进行分类。我们分析新注册域名的名称，并用聚类技术按词汇与结构相似性分组。我们用包含 150 万个新建域名的真实数据评估方法学：COBRA 以 98.5% 的精确率识别可疑域名，找出超过 4.7 万个互异的新注册可疑域名。结果还表明域名-名称聚类支持准确的早期检测：比最广泛使用的威胁情报服务之一更早识别 80% 的可疑或恶意域名，后者有时需要多达 7 天。
summary_cn: COBRA 在注册时用名称聚类做内容无关的可疑域名检测：150 万真实新域上精确率 98.5%、发现 4.7 万+可疑域名，80% 早于主流威胁情报最多 7 天。
objective_summary: 构建仅用域名名称、注册时即可运行的聚类式可疑域名检测框架，并在 150 万新注册域名的真实数据上评估精确率与相对威胁情报的提前量。
evidence_note: 150 万真实新注册域名、98.5% 精确率、与在用威胁情报服务的时效对比，规模接近部署语境。
novelty_note: 新注册域名检测已是成熟方向；内容无关+注册时+词汇结构聚类的组合与部署规模是主要新点。
scope: 结论适用于新注册域名与所测时间段；对主动规避命名的攻击者与子域滥用未覆盖。
limitations: 依赖命名相似性，攻击者可用随机化策略调整；可疑不等于恶意，需下游确认；威胁情报对比限于单一服务。

title: On the Construction of Trapdoor Claw-Free Functions with Certifiable Key
abstract: Trapdoor claw-free functions (TCFs) underpin much of classical-quantum cryptographic interaction, yet every TCF-based protocol states its guarantees relative to an honestly generated key. We give a family-agnostic abstraction of key certification for (noisy) TCF constructions, built on two notions: a certifiable key relation, an NP relation capturing a family's honest keys with witnesses recoverable from the trapdoor; and certified key generation, which emits with each key a certificate of membership satisfying completeness, certificate soundness with extractability, and key privacy. We instantiate certifiable key relations for different constructions, each met generically by a zero-knowledge argument of knowledge for the relation. As our main application, a generic compiler turns any TCF-based proof of quantumness into a zero-knowledge one, with each security property following from its counterpart in the certification scheme. Finally, we delimit the primitive's reach: for protocols resting on injective invariance, an accepting certificate is itself a family distinguisher, leaking exactly the bit such protocols must hide.
title_cn: 论带可认证密钥的陷门爪函数构造
abstract_cn: 陷门爪函数（TCF）支撑了大量经典–量子密码交互，但每个基于 TCF 的协议都相对诚实生成的密钥陈述其保证。我们给出（带噪）TCF 构造的密钥认证的家族无关抽象，建立在两个概念上：可认证密钥关系——捕捉一个家族的诚实密钥、且证人可从陷门恢复的 NP 关系；以及认证密钥生成——为每个密钥附带一个满足完备性、带可提取性的证书可靠性与密钥隐私的成员证书。我们为不同构造实例化可认证密钥关系，每个都可由该关系的零知识知识论证一般性地满足。作为主要应用，一个通用编译器把任何基于 TCF 的量子性证明变为零知识的，每个安全性质都继承自认证方案中的对应性质。最后我们划定该原语的边界：对依赖单射不变性的协议，一个被接受的证书本身就是家族区分器，恰好泄露此类协议必须隐藏的比特。
summary_cn: 提出 TCF 密钥认证的家族无关抽象（可认证密钥关系+认证密钥生成），用 ZK 论证一般性实例化，把任意 TCF 量子性证明编译为零知识版，并证明单射不变性协议的天然边界。
objective_summary: 为 TCF 构造定义密钥认证的两个形式概念，给出零知识论证的一般实例化与把量子性证明零知识化的通用编译器，并刻画该原语的适用边界。
evidence_note: 定义、通用编译与安全归约完整，实例化到多个具体构造；无实现或参数级成本评估。
novelty_note: 提出并系统化 TCF 密钥认证这一此前各协议都默认假设的问题，并附单射不变性协议的边界性负面结果。
scope: 适用于带噪 TCF 家族与基于 TCF 的量子性证明类协议；单射不变性类协议被负面结果排除。
limitations: 认证带来的额外通信/计算开销未量化；具体构造的参数选择留给未来；仅覆盖量子性证明一类应用。

title: Adaptive Traffic Camouflage: Causal and Resource-Aware Defense Against IoT Fingerprinting
abstract: Encryption hides IoT payloads, but traffic shape can still reveal device identity through packet sizes, timing, direction, and packetization. We present Adaptive Traffic Camouflage, a causal, leakage-aware controller that characterizes traffic-shape leakage without runtime device labels and selects a budget-feasible transformation for the next traffic window from previous-window context. The controller chooses among padding, packet splitting, timing, and composite transformations, or leaves traffic unchanged when camouflage is unnecessary. We evaluate the design on CIC-IoT-2022, IoT Sentinel, and UNSW using classical and sequence-based fingerprinting models under clean-trained, defense-aware, and incremental-exposure settings, with fixed, random, and mean-bandwidth-matched baselines. Under the Balanced profile, camouflage reduces mean Macro-F1 by 13.2-23.3% relative to clean traffic with 4.88-7.47% average bandwidth overhead and at most 0.64 ms added latency. Under the larger Privacy profile, the reduction increases to 28.0-43.5%. Defense-aware training recovers much of the lost attacker performance on CIC-IoT-2022 and UNSW, while IoT Sentinel retains a substantial privacy gap. A non-causal same-window reference provides only modest additional benefit over previous-window control, and metadata-rich attackers remain effective outside the targeted traffic-shape surface. These results show that causal, resource-aware camouflage can reduce IoT traffic-shape fingerprintability under explicit communication constraints, while the persistence of protection depends on how readily the defended distribution can be learned.
title_cn: 自适应流量伪装：面向 IoT 指纹识别的因果与资源感知防御
abstract_cn: 加密隐藏了 IoT 载荷，但流量形状仍可通过包大小、时序、方向与打包方式泄露设备身份。我们提出自适应流量伪装（Adaptive Traffic Camouflage），一个因果式、泄漏感知的控制器：无需运行时设备标签即可刻画流量形状泄漏，并基于上一窗口上下文为下一流量窗口选择预算可行的变换。控制器在填充、分包、时序与复合变换间选择，或在无需伪装时保持流量不变。我们在 CIC-IoT-2022、IoT Sentinel 与 UNSW 上，用经典与序列型指纹模型，在干净训练、防御感知与增量暴露设定下，对照固定、随机与均值带宽匹配基线进行评估。在均衡配置下，伪装相对干净流量把平均 Macro-F1 降低 13.2–23.3%，平均带宽开销 4.88–7.47%，附加时延至多 0.64 毫秒。在更大的隐私配置下，降幅增至 28.0–43.5%。防御感知训练在 CIC-IoT-2022 与 UNSW 上恢复了攻击者大部分性能，而 IoT Sentinel 仍保持可观的隐私差距。非因果的同窗参考相对上一窗控制只提供边际收益，而元数据丰富的攻击者在目标流量形状面之外仍然有效。这些结果表明，因果、资源感知的伪装能在显式通信约束下降低 IoT 流量形状可指纹性，而保护的持久性取决于被防御分布被学习的难易。
summary_cn: 因果式流量伪装控制器在三种 IoT 数据集上把指纹 Macro-F1 压低 13.2–43.5%，带宽开销 4.88–7.47%、时延≤0.64ms；防御感知训练会侵蚀保护，元数据攻击仍有效。
objective_summary: 提出无需设备标签的因果流量形状泄漏刻画与预算受限变换选择机制，在三个数据集、多类指纹模型与防御感知设定下量化隐私-开销权衡。
evidence_note: 三个公开数据集、经典与序列型指纹模型、防御感知与增量暴露设定、带宽/时延开销量化、多基线对照。
novelty_note: 流量填充/变形防御已有大量工作；无标签因果控制与预算感知变换选择是实质性组合改进。
scope: 结论适用于所测三数据集的流量形状攻击面；元数据丰富攻击者与其他泄漏面未覆盖。
limitations: 防御感知训练大幅恢复攻击者性能；IoT Sentinel 上保护仍存差距；变换在真实设备上的部署开销未测。

title: GuidedRay: Diversity-Guided Direction Discovery for Targeted Hard-Label Black-Box Attacks
abstract: Deep neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Among black-box attacks, targeted decision-based attacks are particularly difficult: the attacker observes only the target model's top-1 label and aims to make it predict a prespecified target class under a bounded perturbation. Before perturbation refinement, the attacker must discover a direction that reaches the prescribed target region. This initialization step can incur substantial query cost. We propose GuidedRay, a targeted decision-based attack based on diversity-guided direction discovery. GuidedRay builds on two observations: target-class reference samples provide useful target-conditioned direction priors, and diverse candidates increase the probability of discovering a targeted adversarial direction. GuidedRay generates varied candidates from one or multiple target-class references and uses a one-query Fast Test to screen their induced sign directions. Once a feasible direction is found, GuidedRay applies Ray Search to reduce its decision-boundary radius. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet demonstrate that GuidedRay consistently outperforms five state-of-the-art decision-based attacks at four evaluated query budgets from 500 to 5,000, with particularly pronounced gains in direction discovery during initialization. Against models protected by adversarial training or TRADES, it likewise achieves the highest attack success rate at all four query budgets.
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, and 11 tables. Code is available at this https URL
title_cn: GuidedRay：面向定向硬标签黑盒攻击的多样性引导方向发现
abstract_cn: 深度神经网络易受对抗攻击。在黑盒攻击中，定向的决策类攻击尤其困难：攻击者只观察目标模型的 top-1 标签，目标是让其在有界扰动下预测预定目标类。在扰动精修之前，攻击者必须发现一个能到达指定目标区域的方向。这一初始化步骤可能产生可观的查询成本。我们提出 GuidedRay，一个基于多样性引导方向发现的定向决策类攻击。GuidedRay 建立在两个观察上：目标类参考样本提供有用的目标条件方向先验；多样化候选提高发现定向对抗方向的概率。GuidedRay 从一个或多个目标类参考生成多样候选，并用单查询快速测试筛选其诱导的符号方向。一旦找到可行方向，GuidedRay 用射线搜索缩小其决策边界半径。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上的实验表明，GuidedRay 在 500 到 5000 的四个评估查询预算下持续优于五个最先进决策类攻击，且在初始化的方向发现阶段增益尤其显著。对经对抗训练或 TRADES 保护的模型，它同样在所有四个查询预算下取得最高攻击成功率。
summary_cn: GuidedRay 以目标类参考与多样候选加速定向硬标签攻击的方向发现，在 500–5000 查询预算上全面超过五个 SOTA，对对抗训练/TRADES 模型同样最优。
objective_summary: 提出多样性引导的定向决策类攻击初始化方法，配合射线搜索精修，在三个数据集、四个查询预算与对抗训练模型上系统对比五个基线。
evidence_note: 三数据集×四查询预算×五基线的系统对比、对抗训练/TRADES 防御模型验证、代码公开。
novelty_note: 决策类定向攻击已有多个工作；以多样性引导初始化降低查询成本属实质性但渐进的机制改进。
scope: 结论适用于硬标签黑盒图像分类场景与所测查询预算；对带检测/净化防御的级联与文本模态未评估。
limitations: 假设目标类参考样本可得；查询预算上限 5000 内的比较，更大预算下的差距未知；未报告对自适应防御的效果。

title: C-to-Rust Fallacy: Automatic Refactoring != Memory Security
abstract: Rust has emerged as the leading system programming language, offering strong memory and type safety guarantees without compromising performance. This positions it as a compelling alternative to traditional languages like C and C++, which are susceptible to memory security bugs. However, manually transforming C to Rust requires in-depth domain knowledge of the Rust language features, which requires significant effort for developers. To address this, tools for automatic C-to-Rust refactoring aim to generate safe Rust code leveraging static analysis and Large Language Models (LLMs). While these tools claim to achieve safety by reducing the unsafe Rust, the correlation with improving security is not clear. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study on the reliability, safety, and correctness of various C-to-Rust refactoring methods. Specifically, we evaluate C2Rust-analyze, CROWN, C2SaferRust, and FLOURINE using a dataset of 116 C programs with memory security bugs from the NIST Juliet Test Suite. Based on 464 Rust programs generated by these tools, our evaluation focuses on three key aspects: the compilation correctness of the refactored programs, the effectiveness in mitigating original C bugs, and the tendency to introduce additional Rust bugs. The results indicate that 342 Rust programs fail to compile, 177 Rust programs inherit memory security bugs from the original C programs, and 77 new Rust bugs are introduced. We examine the rationale behind tool design and analyze the root cause of errors across various refactoring methods. Our findings indicate that current automated refactoring tools deliver memory safety as they define it, but not the broader memory security when adopting them.
title_cn: C 到 Rust 的谬误：自动重构不等于内存安全
abstract_cn: Rust 已成为领先的系统编程语言，在不牺牲性能的情况下提供强内存与类型安全保证，这使其成为 C 与 C++ 等易受内存安全 bug 影响语言的诱人替代。然而，手工把 C 转换为 Rust 需要深入的 Rust 语言特性领域知识，开发者负担沉重。为此，自动 C 到 Rust 重构工具试图利用静态分析与大语言模型生成安全 Rust 代码。虽然这些工具声称通过减少 unsafe Rust 实现安全，但其与提升安全性的关联并不清楚。本文对各类 C-to-Rust 重构方法的可靠性、安全性与正确性开展综合实证研究。具体而言，我们用来自 NIST Juliet 测试套件的 116 个含内存安全 bug 的 C 程序评估 C2Rust-analyze、CROWN、C2SaferRust 与 FLOURINE。基于这些工具生成的 464 个 Rust 程序，评估聚焦三个方面：重构程序的编译正确性、对原始 C bug 的缓解效果、以及引入额外 Rust bug 的倾向。结果显示：342 个 Rust 程序编译失败，177 个继承原始 C 程序的内存安全 bug，77 个引入新 Rust bug。我们检视工具设计原理并分析各重构方法的错误根因。发现表明：现有自动重构工具交付的是它们所定义的内存安全，而非采用它们时更广泛的内存安全。
summary_cn: 116 个 Juliet C 程序实证四款 C-to-Rust 重构工具：464 个输出中 342 个编译失败、177 个继承原 bug、77 个引入新 bug，「减少 unsafe」不等于内存安全。
objective_summary: 以 Juliet 内存安全用例系统评估四款 C-to-Rust 重构工具的编译正确性、bug 缓解与新 bug 引入，并分析各方法的设计原理与错误根因。
evidence_note: 116 程序×4 工具=464 输出的系统评估、三个维度统计明确、根因分析；基于标准测试套件可复算。
novelty_note: 有诊断价值的实证修正：系统证伪「减少 unsafe = 更安全」的假设并给出根因分类。
scope: 结论适用于四款受测工具与 Juliet 类单函数级内存 bug；对大型真实代码库与商用翻译器的代表性有限。
limitations: Juliet 用例偏人工构造；工具版本随时间演进；未评估运行时性能与翻译代码的可维护性。

title: SLED-IFV: Solver-Validated LLM-Guided Decomposition for Scalable Hardware Information-Flow Verification
abstract: Formal hardware information-flow verification (IFV) provides strong guarantees against secret-dependent timing and control behavior, but often scales poorly on realistic RTL. We identify two recurring proof barriers in self-composed IFV: implementation complexity, where proof-hard datapath logic dominates even though the property needs only a compact boundary relation, and relational inductive complexity, where the proof depends on cross-copy public-control facts that the backend prover does not infer efficiently. To address them, we introduce two semantic proof decomposition forms: functional simplification, which replaces a proof-hard RTL region with a validated over-approximate summary, and relational strengthening, which exposes and proves the cross-copy relations needed for induction. We further present SLED-IFV, a solver-validated LLM-guided flow that automates the selection of these forms and their concrete targets. Given a self-composed miter and an oracle-free decision sheet, the LLM proposes a decomposition, then materializes it into proof artifacts under controller checks. The controller compiles the checked artifacts into proof obligations, and the formal verification backend remains the sole authority for acceptance. Across nine nontrivial benchmarks constructed from real RTL, SLED-IFV achieves up to 603x solver-only speedup and converts two 12-hour timeouts into completed proofs. The closed-loop flow produces verifier-accepted decompositions for all cases.
comment: Accepted at the 32nd Asia and South Pacific Design Automation Conference (ASP-DAC 2027). 7 pages, 3 figures, and 5 tables
title_cn: SLED-IFV：求解器验证的 LLM 引导分解，面向可扩展的硬件信息流验证
abstract_cn: 形式化硬件信息流验证（IFV）为防范依赖秘密的时序与控制行为提供强保证，但在真实 RTL 上扩展性常差。我们在自组合 IFV 中识别出两个反复出现的证明障碍：实现复杂度——证明困难的通路逻辑占主导而性质只需一个紧凑的边界关系；关系归纳复杂度——证明依赖跨副本公共控制事实而后端证明器无法高效推断。为此我们引入两种语义证明分解形式：函数简化，用经验证的过近似摘要替换证明困难的 RTL 区域；关系强化，暴露并证明归纳所需的跨副本关系。我们进一步提出 SLED-IFV，一个求解器验证的 LLM 引导流程，自动选择这些形式及其具体目标。给定自组合 miter 与无 oracle 的决策表，LLM 提出分解，然后在控制器检查下将其物化为证明工件。控制器把检查过的工件编译为证明义务，形式化验证后端仍是验收的唯一权威。在由真实 RTL 构建的九个非平凡基准上，SLED-IFV 达到最高 603 倍于纯求解器的加速，并把两个 12 小时超时转为完成的证明。闭环流程对所有用例产出验证器接受的分解。
summary_cn: SLED-IFV：LLM 提议、求解器验证的硬件信息流证明分解流程（函数简化+关系强化），9 个真实 RTL 基准上最高 603 倍加速、2 个 12 小时超时转完成。
objective_summary: 识别自组合 IFV 的两类证明障碍，提出函数简化与关系强化两种分解形式，构建 LLM 提议、控制器检查、求解器最终裁决的自动化证明分解流程并评估。
evidence_note: 九个真实 RTL 基准、603 倍加速与超时转化、后端验证器作为唯一验收权威的闭环设计；ASP-DAC 2027 录用。
novelty_note: LLM 辅助形式化证明已有探索，把语义级分解形式与求解器验证回路用于 IFV 属新场景组合；分解形式本身有实质内容。
scope: 结论适用于自组合 IFV 与所测九个基准的证明形态；对其他性质类或更大设计的泛化未验证。
limitations: LLM 提议的分解依赖决策表覆盖；过近似摘要可能引入不完备需人工判读；基准规模仍有限。

title: Evaluating Coding Agents on Kernel Exploit Generation
abstract: Coding agents now find real vulnerabilities in production software. However, bug discovery results do not measure whether agents can construct exploit primitives.
