We introduce KEX-bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on exploit primitive generation against real operating-system kernels. KEX-bench contains 45 task instances across 40 Linux and Windows CVEs, covering kernel address leak, instruction-pointer control, heap read, heap write, and arbitrary address write. Each task runs in an isolated virtual machine, exposes controlled tools, and uses a deterministic verifier to check primitive-specific success. We evaluate state-of-the-art coding agents paired with frontier and open-weight models under fixed tool-call budgets. Without a reference proof of concept (PoC), the strongest configuration solves 1 of 20 Windows tasks (5.0%) and 14 of 25 Linux tasks (56.0%). With a reference PoC, the strongest configuration solves 31 of 45 tasks (68.9%). This highlights the gap where agents reach kernel crashes but fail to shape kernel state into exploit primitives. We release KEX-bench for reproducible research on AI-assisted exploitation at https://kex-bench.github.io.
title_cn: 评估编码智能体在内核漏洞利用生成上的能力
abstract_cn: 编码智能体已能在生产软件中发现真实漏洞，但漏洞发现结果并不能度量智能体能否构造利用原语。我们提出 KEX-bench，一个评估编码智能体对真实操作系统内核生成利用原语能力的基准。KEX-bench 含跨 40 个 Linux 与 Windows CVE 的 45 个任务实例，覆盖内核地址泄露、指令指针控制、堆读、堆写与任意地址写。每个任务在隔离虚拟机中运行，暴露受控工具集，并用确定性验证器检查原语特定的成功条件。我们在固定工具调用预算下评估搭配前沿与开源权重模型的最先进编码智能体。在没有参考概念验证（PoC）时，最强配置解决 20 个 Windows 任务中的 1 个（5.0%）与 25 个 Linux 任务中的 14 个（56.0%）。有参考 PoC 时，最强配置解决 45 个任务中的 31 个（68.9%）。这凸显了智能体能到达内核崩溃却无法把内核状态塑造成利用原语的差距。我们在 https://kex-bench.github.io 发布 KEX-bench 以支持可复现的 AI 辅助利用研究。
summary_cn: KEX-bench：40 个 CVE 上的 45 个内核利用原语生成任务，隔离 VM + 确定性验证器；最强智能体无 PoC 解 33%、有 PoC 解 68.9%，暴露「崩溃易、塑形难」差距。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖五类利用原语的内核 exploit 生成基准，在隔离虚拟机与固定工具预算下系统评估编码智能体，并量化参考 PoC 对成功率的影响。
evidence_note: 45 任务/40 CVE、隔离 VM、确定性原语验证器、固定预算、公开发布，多模型多智能体对比。
novelty_note: 首个针对操作系统内核利用原语生成的编码智能体基准，把评估从漏洞发现推进到利用构造。
scope: 结论适用于所测 40 个 CVE、智能体框架与工具预算设定；对真实攻击者的自适应行为与防御侧含义未覆盖。
limitations: CVE 覆盖与难度分布可能不具代表性；固定工具预算不反映开放式攻击；验证器只检查原语级成功而非完整提权链。

title: Rethinking Backdoor Repair Evaluation: Distinguishing Aggregate Clean Utility from Benign Performance Preservation
abstract: Backdoor repair aims to suppress malicious behavior in compromised models while preserving benign task performance. Existing studies typically evaluate these objectives using Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Overall Clean Accuracy, but aggregate clean accuracy can obscure substantial degradation concentrated in a small portion of the label space. We revisit benign-performance evaluation from a preservation perspective by distinguishing aggregate clean utility from the preservation of previously available class-wise performance. We define class-wise preservation loss by comparing clean performance before and after repair and show that aggregation can hide localized degradation through localized-loss dilution and cross-class compensation. To complement Overall Clean Accuracy, we characterize localized preservation loss using Worst-Class Preservation Loss and Tail Preservation Loss. We conduct a systematic empirical study across representative backdoor attacks, repair methods, datasets, attack targets, and model architectures, with additional validation under clean-label attacks. Results show that effective attack suppression and favorable aggregate clean performance do not necessarily imply uniform preservation of previously available benign performance across classes. Substantial localized preservation losses can remain, and their severity and class-wise structure vary across repair conditions. These findings motivate preservation-oriented class-wise evaluation alongside ASR and Overall Clean Accuracy.
title_cn: 重思后门修复评估：区分聚合干净效用与良性性能保持
abstract_cn: 后门修复旨在压制被攻陷模型中的恶意行为，同时保留良性任务性能。现有研究通常用攻击成功率（ASR）与总体干净准确率评估这些目标，但聚合的干净准确率可能掩盖集中在标签空间一小部分上的严重退化。我们从保持视角重审良性性能评估，区分聚合干净效用与既有类别级性能的保持。我们通过比较修复前后的干净性能定义类别级保持损失，并证明聚合可通过局部损失稀释与跨类补偿隐藏局部化退化。作为总体干净准确率的补充，我们用最差类别保持损失与尾部保持损失刻画局部化保持损失。我们在代表性的后门攻击、修复方法、数据集、攻击目标与模型架构上开展系统性实证研究，并在干净标签攻击下做额外验证。结果表明，有效的攻击压制与良好的聚合干净性能并不必然意味着既有良性性能在各类间被均匀保持：局部化保持损失可能依然严重，且其严重程度与类别结构随修复条件变化。这些发现促使在 ASR 与总体干净准确率之外加入保持导向的类别级评估。
summary_cn: 重审后门修复评估：聚合干净准确率可经局部损失稀释与跨类补偿掩盖退化，提出最差类别/尾部保持损失并在多攻击×方法×架构上验证局部退化普遍存在。
objective_summary: 定义类别级保持损失并系统实证后门修复中聚合指标对局部化退化的掩盖效应，提出最差类别与尾部保持损失作为补充指标。
evidence_note: 跨攻击、修复方法、数据集、目标与架构的系统矩阵加干净标签攻击附加验证；指标定义明确、可在所报设置下复算。
novelty_note: 评估方法学修正型工作：保持视角与两个新指标是对既有 ASR+总体准确率评估的有诊断价值的修正。
scope: 结论适用于所测后门攻击与修复方法组合及分类任务设定；对检测类防御或生成任务的推广未验证。
limitations: 仅评估未提出修复算法改进；局部损失的「可接受阈值」未给出；计算预算限制下方法/架构覆盖仍有限。

title: FASTAR: FRI Accelerator for Scalable Transparent ARguments of Knowledge
abstract: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) enable a prover to cryptographically convince a verifier of the validity of a statement without revealing any underlying secrets, forming a foundational primitive for verifiable computation. The ZKP landscape is undergoing a fundamental shift from classic zk-SNARKs such as Groth16, which rely on trusted setup and are vulnerable to quantum adversaries, toward transparent, post-quantum constructions such as zk-STARK. These systems achieve post-quantum security by relying solely on collision-resistant hash functions, however, at the cost of substantial computational overhead. In particular, the Fast Reed--Solomon Interactive Oracle Proof of Proximity (FRI) protocol dominates prover complexity, generating massive data volumes, repeated Merkle-tree commitments, and irregular memory access patterns that limit performance and energy efficiency on general-purpose processors. To address these challenges, this work proposes FASTAR, a novel FPGA-based accelerator for the FRI protocol. Unlike accelerators that pursue fixed high-performance kernels on expensive ASIC process nodes, FASTAR adopts a constraint-driven design methodology. Our framework is implemented with High-Level Synthesis (HLS) and composed of fully parameterizable building blocks for the major stages of FRI, including polynomial evaluation, recursive split-and-fold, and Merkle-tree construction. From user-provided board specifications, FASTAR automatically generates hardware implementations tailored to the resource and memory constraints of the target FPGA, enabling deployment across a wide range of platforms without manual redesign.
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; ICCAD 2026
title_cn: FASTAR：可扩展透明知识论证的 FRI 加速器
abstract_cn: 零知识证明（ZKP）使证明者能在不泄露任何底层秘密的情况下让验证者确信语句有效，是可验证计算的基础原语。ZKP 格局正从依赖可信设置、易受量子对手攻击的经典 zk-SNARK（如 Groth16）向透明、后量子构造（如 zk-STARK）根本转变。这些系统仅靠抗碰撞哈希函数即获得后量子安全，代价是可观的计算开销。特别是，快速 Reed–Solomon 交互式 oracle 接近性证明（FRI）协议主导证明者复杂度，产生海量数据、重复的 Merkle 树承诺与不规则的内存访问模式，限制了在通用处理器上的性能与能效。为此，本工作提出 FASTAR，一个面向 FRI 协议的新型 FPGA 加速器。与在昂贵 ASIC 工艺节点上追求固定高性能内核的加速器不同，FASTAR 采用约束驱动的设计方法学。框架用高层次综合（HLS）实现，由覆盖 FRI 主要阶段——多项式求值、递归 split-and-fold 与 Merkle 树构建——的全参数化构建块组成。从用户提供的板卡规格出发，FASTAR 自动生成适配目标 FPGA 资源与内存约束的硬件实现，无需手工重设计即可跨广泛平台部署。
summary_cn: FASTAR：约束驱动、HLS 全参数化的 FRI 协议 FPGA 加速器框架，按板卡资源自动生成多项式求值、split-and-fold 与 Merkle 树硬件（ICCAD 2026）。
objective_summary: 提出 FRI 协议的约束驱动 FPGA 加速框架，以 HLS 参数化构建块覆盖各阶段并按目标板卡资源自动生成实现。
evidence_note: ICCAD 2026 录用、参数化框架与多阶段实现完整；但摘要未给出相对基线的加速比、资源占用或能耗数据。
novelty_note: FRI 的 FPGA/ASIC 加速已有先例；约束驱动自动生成、跨板卡部署的方法学与全参数化框架是主要新点。
scope: 结论适用于 FRI 协议各阶段的 FPGA 实现；性能与能效结论取决于具体板卡与配置。
limitations: 摘要未报告量化加速与对比基线；HLS 相对手写 RTL 的性能差距未讨论；仅覆盖 FRI，不含完整 STARK 证明系统。

title: Dynamic Conformance Testing of WebGPU Through Specification-Driven Mutation
abstract: WebGPU is a low-level graphics and compute API that exposes modern GPU functionality to web applications. While the official WebGPU Conformance Test Suite (CTS) focuses on well-formed usage under the WebGPU specification, it is not designed to stress implementations with semantic edge cases or adversarial inputs. General-purpose fuzzers, in contrast, struggle with WebGPU because of its complex graphics stack and multi-process architecture. We introduce LANTERN, a specification-guided dynamic conformance testing framework that mutates CTS tests using constraints extracted from the WebGPU specification. LANTERN extracts explicit syntactic API rules from WebIDL definitions and recovers semantic constraints, such as command ordering and object lifetimes, from natural-language specification text. Selected rules guide AST-located textual transformations that generate both valid and intentionally invalid CTS variants. We execute the resulting tests at scale on AddressSanitizer-instrumented Chromium to discover bugs. Our evaluation discovers three reproducible bugs, including a heap corruption, in Chromium versions current at the time of study. These results demonstrate that syntactically seeded, semantics-aware mutation of conformance tests provides a way to uncover browser bugs during WebGPU testing.
title_cn: 基于规范驱动变异的 WebGPU 动态一致性测试
abstract_cn: WebGPU 是向 Web 应用暴露现代 GPU 功能的低级图形与计算 API。官方 WebGPU 一致性测试套件（CTS）聚焦规范允许的良构用法，并不旨在用语义边界情形或对抗输入压测实现。通用模糊测试器则因 WebGPU 复杂的图形栈与多进程架构而难以施展。我们提出 LANTERN，一个规范引导的动态一致性测试框架，使用从 WebGPU 规范提取的约束对 CTS 测试做变异。LANTERN 从 WebIDL 定义提取显式句法 API 规则，并从自然语言规范文本恢复语义约束（如命令顺序与对象生命周期）。选定的规则引导 AST 定位的文本变换，生成有效与故意无效的 CTS 变体。我们在 AddressSanitizer 插桩的 Chromium 上大规模执行所得测试以发现 bug。评估发现了三个可复现 bug，包括一个堆损坏，均在研究时的 Chromium 当前版本上。这些结果表明以句法种子、语义感知的方式变异一致性测试，是 WebGPU 测试期间发现浏览器 bug 的可行途径。
summary_cn: LANTERN 用 WebIDL + 规范文本约束变异 WebGPU CTS 测试，在 ASan 插桩 Chromium 上发现 3 个可复现 bug（含一个堆损坏）。
objective_summary: 构建从 WebIDL 与自然语言规范提取约束、对 CTS 测试做 AST 定位变异的一致性测试框架，并在插桩 Chromium 上规模化执行以发现实现 bug。
evidence_note: 在当前版本 Chromium 上发现 3 个可复现 bug（含堆损坏），真实系统真实缺陷，句法/语义约束来源分开验证。
novelty_note: 规范引导变异与 CTS 种子利用为已有组件在 WebGPU 上的新组合；从自然语言规范恢复语义约束的流程有新意。
scope: 结论适用于 Chromium 的 WebGPU 实现；对其他浏览器实现与更深层语义约束的覆盖未评估。
limitations: 变异限于 AST 定位文本变换；语义约束抽取依赖规范文本质量；只报告三个 bug，发现率与成本对比未系统量化。

title: Identifying Suspected Mislabeled Apps in Google Play Application Removal Prediction: An Empirical Comparison of Label Noise Detection Methods
abstract: Models that predict which Google Play apps will be removed are trained on labels that record only whether an app was still in the store at a later observation. A disappeared app is labeled removed and a present one stable, but neither records why. A voluntary withdrawal and a policy takedown both produce removed, and an uncaught spam app keeps stable. This work calls that mismatch label noise. Three detectors from different methodological families are applied to the 870,514 apps of Mohsen, Karastoyanova, and Azzopardi (2022): Isolation Forest, flagging apps unusual in the feature space, Neighborhood Disagreement, flagging apps whose nearest neighbors carry the opposite label, and Prediction Inconsistency, flagging apps a classifier labels differently from the data. The apps flagged by all three, the overlap, number 7,598 at default settings and are the strongest mislabeling candidates. Two questions follow. First, does removing flagged apps improve the model? It does not. No detector, overlap, or union beats the baseline, and the loss grows with the number removed. Second, do flagged apps appear less often than expected among apps whose label VirusTotal and Quark Engine confirm? Among confirmed removals they do, falling to 0.43 times the expected rate as the threshold tightens, while an excess on the stable side disappears once the age of the scanned apps is accounted for. A model trained on only the 3,021 trainable overlap apps reaches a test AUC of 0.2518, far below chance, so the relationship between features and labels there runs opposite to the rest of the data. The flagged apps run wrong in both directions: abandoned apps that resemble spam carry stable, while apps that look healthy carry removed. The value of the detectors lies in characterizing this label noise. They locate a small set of candidates they cannot profitably remove.
comment: Bachelor's project, University of Groningen. 26 pages, 5 figures
title_cn: 识别 Google Play 应用下架预测中的疑似误标应用：标签噪声检测方法的实证比较
abstract_cn: 预测哪些 Google Play 应用将被下架的模型，其训练标签只记录应用在后续观测时是否仍在商店：消失的应用被标为 removed，存在的被标为 stable，但都不记录原因。自愿撤回与政策下架都产生 removed，未被查杀的垃圾应用保持 stable。本工作把这种失配称为标签噪声。来自三个不同方法学家族的检测器被应用于 Mohsen、Karastoyanova 与 Azzopardi（2022）的 870514 个应用：Isolation Forest（标记特征空间中异常的应用）、邻域不一致（标记最近邻带相反标签的应用）与预测不一致（标记分类器给出与数据不同标签的应用）。三个检测器共同标记的交集在默认设置下为 7598 个应用，是最强的误标候选。随之有两个问题。第一，移除被标记应用能改进模型吗？不能。任何检测器、交集或并集都不优于基线，且损失随移除数量增长。第二，在被 VirusTotal 与 Quark Engine 确认标签的应用中，被标记应用出现频率是否低于预期？在被确认的 removed 中确实如此，随阈值收紧降至期望率的 0.43 倍，而 stable 侧的过量在计入被扫描应用年龄后消失。仅在 3021 个可训练交集应用上训练的模型测试 AUC 为 0.2518，远低于随机水平，说明该子集中特征与标签的关系与数据其余部分相反。被标记应用双向出错：像垃圾的弃用应用带 stable 标签，看起来健康的应用带 removed 标签。检测器的价值在于刻画这种标签噪声：它们定位出一小批无法有利移除的候选。
summary_cn: 对 87 万 Google Play 应用的下架预测标签做噪声检测：三检测器交集 7598 个疑似误标，移除不改进模型（交集子集 AUC 仅 0.25），价值在刻画噪声而非清洗。
objective_summary: 用 Isolation Forest、邻域不一致与预测不一致三类检测器系统识别下架预测数据集的疑似误标应用，并用 VirusTotal/Quark 外部确认与消融实验检验其可用性。
evidence_note: 870514 应用全量分析、三类检测器、VirusTotal/Quark 外部确认与年龄归一化；但为学士项目、无统计检验、外部确认覆盖部分样本。
novelty_note: 有诊断价值的实证修正：揭示下架预测标签的系统性双向噪声并证明简单清洗无效。
scope: 结论适用于该 2022 数据集与应用属性特征空间；不直接外推到其他商店或含内容/文本特征的数据集。
limitations: 外部确认覆盖有限；检测器超参为默认值；未探索噪声鲁棒训练等替代方案。

title: ZeroGate: Trust-Preserving Fast Paths for Governed AI Agent Runtimes
abstract: Moving authorization earlier can shorten an agent's dispatch boundary without removing authorization work. It can also admit an action whose payload, authority, or relevant state has changed. ZeroGate separates exact-action approval from durable local admission: an issuer signs a short-lived ActionPass, and a trusted runtime adapter reconstructs the final action before a local gate checks its binding and consumes its nonce. A SQLite transaction couples nonce consumption, applicable quota updates, and an admission receipt. We state a conditional decision-preservation proposition: successful local admission implies that a specified synchronous policy would authorize the same action at the admission point, provided approval is sound, all policy dependencies are represented and current, observations are faithful, and consumption is atomic. The implementation alone establishes neither current-world freshness nor exactly-once remote effects. Evaluation separates authored semantic fixtures, controlled concurrency and crash experiments, and an Azure Blob study comparing synchronous and prepared execution through the same issuer and gate. Both modes mint an exact-action pass; lifecycle latency includes preparation and prepared-batch dwell. Across 4800 cloud attempts, prepared worker-admission-to-dispatch p95 ranges from 9.802 to 11.374 ms, versus 25.018 to 334.000 ms synchronously, across the tested concurrency levels. Prepared mean complete lifecycle is longer at every level: the boundary improvement is not a net speedup. The contribution is an explicit revalidation contract, a durable reference boundary, and an auditable comparison of where authorization cost is paid, not a new cryptographic primitive or a universal performance frontier.
comment: 47 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Full research report with an ancillary archive containing reference code, raw experimental records, and offline verification tools
title_cn: ZeroGate：受治理 AI 智能体运行时的保信任快速通道
abstract_cn: 把授权前移可以缩短智能体的分发边界，但不消除授权工作；它也可能放行载荷、权限或相关状态已发生变化的动作。ZeroGate 把对精确动作的一次性批准与持久本地准入分离：签发者签署短时效的 ActionPass，受信任的运行时适配器在本地门检查绑定并消费 nonce 前重建最终动作。一个 SQLite 事务耦合 nonce 消费、适用的配额更新与准入回执。我们给出条件化的决策保持命题：若批准可靠、所有策略依赖被表示且最新、观测忠实且消费原子，则本地准入成功蕴含指定同步策略会在准入点授权同一动作。仅凭实现既不建立现实世界新鲜度，也不建立恰好一次的远程效应。评估分离了作者撰写的语义夹具、受控并发与崩溃实验，以及经同一签发者与门比较同步与预备执行的 Azure Blob 研究。两种模式都铸造精确动作通行证；生命周期时延包含准备与预备批次驻留。跨 4800 次云端尝试，预备式工作者准入到分发的 p95 在各并发级别为 9.802–11.374 毫秒，同步式为 25.018–334.000 毫秒；预备式完整生命周期均值在每个级别都更长：边界改进并非净加速。其贡献是显式的重验证契约、持久的参考边界，以及授权成本支付位置的可审计比较，而非新密码原语或普适性能前沿。
summary_cn: ZeroGate 把一次性批准与本地持久准入分离，4800 次云实验中准入到分发 p95 从 25–334ms 降到 9.8–11.4ms，但总生命周期更长。
objective_summary: 设计智能体运行时的精确动作通行证与本地门准入机制，陈述条件化决策保持命题，并通过语义夹具、并发/崩溃实验与 Azure Blob 对比量化边界时延。
evidence_note: 4800 次云端尝试、受控并发与崩溃实验、报告 p95 分布与生命周期权衡，附参考代码与原始实验记录。
novelty_note: 分离批准与准入、显式重验证契约是对既有能力/授权模型的实质性重构；决策保持为条件性命题而非新原语。
scope: 结论适用于策略依赖可被表示并保持最新、观测忠实的受控运行时；不解决现实世界新鲜度与恰好一次远程效应。
limitations: 预备式边界时延优势不等于净加速；命题依赖批准可靠与消费原子等前提；评估限于 Azure Blob 等受控场景。

title: Quantum ROP: Using Quantum Algorithms for ROP Chain Selection in Exploit Construction
abstract: The quantum computing threat to cybersecurity is nowadays predominantly framed around Shor's algorithm and its eventual capacity to break asymmetric cryptography. Beyond cryptanalysis, however, quantum computing may also enable other capabilities in offensive security. This work explores one such direction: the application of quantum combinatorial optimization to Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) gadget selection for exploit construction. We formulate gadget selection as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem that captures individual gadget cost and inter-gadget register-clobbering interactions, and solve it using QAOA on real IBM Heron r2 hardware. Applied to a Linux kernel exploitation scenario, the QAOA-selected chain achieves privilege escalation to uid=0 with SMEP and SMAP active. Across eight Linux binaries and 16 benchmark instances, QAOA recovered the lowest-cost valid chain in 11 cases; in the remaining five, it did not recover the optimum, with the failures associated with excessive circuit depth on current limited hardware.
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures
title_cn: 量子 ROP：用量子算法做利用构造中的 ROP 链选择
abstract_cn: 当今量子计算对网络安全的威胁主要围绕 Shor 算法及其最终破坏非对称密码学的能力。除密码分析外，量子计算还可能为攻击性安全带来其他能力。本工作探索其中一个方向：把量子组合优化应用于利用构造中面向返回编程（ROP）的 gadget 选择。我们把 gadget 选择形式化为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，刻画单个 gadget 成本与 gadget 间寄存器覆盖的相互作用，并用 QAOA 在真实 IBM Heron r2 硬件上求解。应用于一个 Linux 内核利用场景，QAOA 选出的链在 SMEP 与 SMAP 启用的情况下实现提权到 uid=0。跨八个 Linux 二进制与 16 个基准实例，QAOA 在 11 例中恢复最低成本的有效链；其余 5 例未恢复最优，失败与当前受限硬件上的电路深度过大相关。
summary_cn: 首次把 ROP gadget 选择形式化为 QUBO 并用 QAOA 在 IBM Heron r2 真机求解：Linux 内核场景 SMEP/SMAP 开启时提权到 uid=0，16 实例中 11 例恢复最优链。
objective_summary: 将 ROP gadget 选择建模为刻画成本与寄存器覆盖交互的 QUBO 问题，在真实量子硬件上用 QAOA 求解并在 Linux 内核利用场景验证提权效果。
evidence_note: 真实量子硬件与真实内核提权验证、8 二进制 16 实例；但规模小、失败归因为定性观察、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 开辟量子组合优化用于攻击性安全的非密码分析路线，为量子辅助利用构造的首个端到端演示。
scope: 结论适用于小规模 gadget 图与当前 NISQ 级硬件；更大二进制上的可扩展性受电路深度限制。
limitations: 硬件深度限制导致 5/16 未达最优；未与经典求解器系统对比成本与时间；仅单一内核利用场景。

title: SSP-Bench: A Hybrid Data Generation Framework for Safety, Security, and Privacy Evaluation
abstract: Evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for safety, security, and privacy (SSP) relies heavily on static benchmarks, which suffer from score saturation, data contamination, and aggregation artifacts, and fail to capture sensitivity to linguistic variation. As a result, models that perform well on fixed test sets often fail under semantically equivalent rephrasings. We introduce SSP-Bench, a dynamic benchmarking framework that generates evaluation instances on demand while preserving domain consistency. The framework ensures label validity through externally grounded sources, enforces scope via service-specific validation, and calibrates difficulty using a multi-model steering panel. Benchmark construction is formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem over difficulty, separability, novelty, and diversity. Across 24 models and four SSP services, SSP-Bench reveals systematic failures of static evaluation, including near-zero correlation in safety rankings due to construct mixing, strong safety--over-refusal coupling, and hidden within-family regressions. These results show that static benchmarks can misrepresent model behavior, motivating dynamic, deployment-relevant evaluation.
title_cn: SSP-Bench：面向安全、安保与隐私评估的混合数据生成框架
abstract_cn: 对大语言模型（LLM）的安全（safety）、安保（security）与隐私（privacy）（SSP）评估严重依赖静态基准，后者存在分数饱和、数据污染与聚合伪影，且无法捕捉对语言变化的敏感性。结果是在固定测试集上表现良好的模型，常在语义等价改写下失败。我们提出 SSP-Bench，一个按需生成评估实例同时保持领域一致性的动态基准框架。该框架通过外部接地的来源保证标签有效性，通过服务专用验证强制范围，并用多模型引导面板校准难度。基准构建被形式化为难度、可分性、新颖性与多样性上的多目标优化问题。跨 24 个模型与四项 SSP 服务，SSP-Bench 揭示了静态评估的系统性失效，包括由构念混合导致的安全排名近零相关、安全与过度拒绝的强耦合，以及隐藏的家族内回归。这些结果表明静态基准可能歪曲模型行为，促使转向动态、与部署相关的评估。
summary_cn: SSP-Bench：按需生成、外部接地、多模型校准难度的动态 SSP 评估框架，24 模型×4 服务上揭示静态基准排名近零相关与过度拒绝耦合等问题。
objective_summary: 构建按需生成实例的多目标优化式动态评估框架，覆盖安全/安保/隐私三域，并用 24 个模型与四项服务对照静态基准的系统性失效。
evidence_note: 24 模型×4 服务的大规模对照、多模型引导面板校准难度、标签外部接地与服务级验证机制明确。
novelty_note: 动态生成式评估已有先例，但把 SSP 三域统一进一个多目标校准框架并系统对照静态基准失效属新组合。
scope: 结论适用于所覆盖的四项 SSP 服务与 24 个受测模型；生成实例分布由引导面板与外部来源决定。
limitations: 标签有效性依赖外部来源与验证规则；难度校准受引导模型偏置影响；未覆盖多轮交互式攻击场景。

title: Making Agents More Consistent: Skills Should Form Habits for Repeat Tasks
abstract: On repeated work, agents are inconsistent. We ran 42 tasks three times each and found that, depending on the model, 38% to 74% returned answers that did not agree. Consistency is what a buyer, an auditor, or a regulator requires, and agents do not have it. They are wasteful too: 95.3% to 97.2% of what an agent generates goes to re-deriving a plan the system already knows. We propose skill habit formation. An agent mines its own execution history for candidate skills, deterministic variants that compete against the incumbent rather than replacing it. A candidate declares the region of input space it claims, so the common case runs as a script and the rest falls through to reasoning. Four gates of ascending cost admit candidates; the central one tests a candidate's execution trace against a retained reference, within a tolerance measured from that reference's own run-to-run variability. On text-to-SQL, three of four reasoning arms reproduced their own output on 11 to 13 of 42 repeated questions and the fourth on 26 of 42, while a habit-formed variant reproduced on all 456 dispatches we repeated and was non-inferior to every arm it replaced (p<0.0001). It also used 14% to 56% fewer tokens, turning net positive after 7 to 53 reuses. We measured what this costs in accuracy. The guard admitted work it should have deferred on 2.6% of natural paraphrases and 26% of inputs near its boundary, and 11 of 13 such failures were invisible to the trace-conformance gate at any threshold. Deterministic errors repeat exactly: a bad habit is as reliable as a good one, and that is the price of the property that makes the system auditable. Separating routing from parameter extraction raised end-to-end accuracy from 0.888 to 0.952 at 43% of the cost.
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures
title_cn: 让智能体更一致：重复任务的技能应当形成习惯
abstract_cn: 在重复性工作上，智能体是不一致的。我们把 42 个任务各运行三次，发现依模型不同，38% 到 74% 返回的答案互不一致。一致性是买方、审计者与监管者所要求的，而智能体不具备。它们也很浪费：智能体生成内容的 95.3% 到 97.2% 花在重新推导系统已知的计划上。我们提出技能习惯化。智能体从自身执行历史中挖掘候选技能——与在任方案竞争而非取代它的确定性变体。候选声明其覆盖的输入空间区域，于是常见情形作为脚本运行，其余回落到推理。四道成本递增的门接纳候选；核心一道把候选的执行轨迹与保留的参考对照，容差取自该参考自身的运行间波动。在文本到 SQL 上，四个推理臂中有三个在 42 个重复问题中的 11–13 个上复现自身输出，第四个为 26 个，而习惯化变体在我们重复的全部 456 次分发上都复现了输出，且对其替换的每个臂都非劣（p<0.0001）。它还少用 14% 到 56% 的 token，在 7 到 53 次复用后转为净收益。我们测量了代价：守卫在 2.6% 的自然改写与 26% 的边界附近输入上接纳了本应延迟的工作，且 13 次此类失败中有 11 次在任何阈值下都对轨迹一致性门不可见。确定性错误精确重复：坏习惯与好习惯一样可靠，而这正是使系统可审计的性质的代价。把路由与参数抽取分离后，端到端准确率从 0.888 升到 0.952，成本为 43%。
summary_cn: 提出技能习惯化：智能体自挖确定性技能变体、四道门准入，文本到 SQL 456 次重复分发全部复现（非劣 p<0.0001），省 14–56% token，代价是坏习惯同样可靠。
objective_summary: 提出从执行历史挖掘确定性技能并以四道递进成本门准入的习惯化机制，用重复运行实验量化其对一致性、token 成本与错误复现的影响。
evidence_note: 42 任务×3 重复、456 次分发复现检验、非劣性检验 p<0.0001、token 成本与失败模式均量化。
novelty_note: 技能库/脚本化路由与竞争式准入为已有组件的新组合；「习惯可审计但坏习惯同样可靠」的权衡刻画有新意。
scope: 结论适用于重复性、可声明输入区域的智能体任务（以文本到 SQL 为主）；对开放域一次性任务不适用。
limitations: 守卫在自然改写上 2.6%、边界输入上 26% 误接纳；轨迹一致性门对多数失败不可见；评估集中于文本到 SQL。

title: Controller-Only False Confirmation in Passive RF UAV Link Detection
abstract: Passive radio frequency (RF) sensing is widely used for counter-unmanned-aerial-vehicle (counter-UAV) detection. Existing studies commonly report high accuracy against background RF or WiFi/Bluetooth interference, but rarely isolate controller-only operation without a linked aircraft. We present a dual-band software-defined radio (SDR) measurement study with ambient, controller-only, and linked states for three commercial UAV platforms (DJI Phantom 3 4K, Hubsan H501S, DJI Mavic Mini). Two USRP B210 receivers simultaneously scan eight 2.4 GHz and twelve 5.8 GHz observation windows across twenty rounds. We first train an energy-based detector using linked and ambient scans only. At four ranked concurrent dwell steps (8 s), it achieves 0.992 linked-versus-ambient balanced accuracy but false-confirms 30 out of 60 controller-only scans (FCRctrl = 0.500). We then include controller-only scans in training and use confirm, reject, and defer outputs under an explicit controller-only false-confirmation-rate (FCR) constraint. For the pooled all-platform analysis, the constraint reduces observed FCRctrl from 0.350 to 0.050, while confirm-linked TPR decreases from 0.900 to 0.400 and 42.1% of scans are deferred. The corresponding compact scan performs substantially better for Hubsan and Mavic than for Phantom. A hardware-in-loop experiment reduces measured wall-clock time from 82.9 s to 28.9 s. These measurements show that linked-versus-background accuracy does not measure controller-only false confirmation and that this error should be reported separately.
title_cn: 被动射频无人机链路检测中的仅遥控器误确认
abstract_cn: 被动射频（RF）感知广泛用于反无人机检测。现有研究通常报告对背景 RF 或 WiFi/蓝牙干扰的高精度，但很少单独考察没有链接飞行器时的仅遥控器工作状态。我们呈现一项双波段软件定义无线电（SDR）测量研究，覆盖三款商用无人机平台（DJI Phantom 3 4K、Hubsan H501S、DJI Mavic Mini）的环境、仅遥控器与已链接三种状态。两台 USRP B210 接收机同时扫描八个 2.4 GHz 与十二个 5.8 GHz 观测窗口，共二十轮。我们先用仅链接与环境扫描训练能量型检测器：在四个排序并发驻留步（8 秒）上，它达到 0.992 的链接对环境平衡准确率，但对 60 次仅遥控器扫描误确认 30 次（FCRctrl = 0.500）。随后把仅遥控器扫描纳入训练，并在显式仅遥控器误确认率（FCR）约束下使用确认、拒绝与延迟三种输出：在全平台合并分析中，该约束把观测 FCRctrl 从 0.350 降到 0.050，确认链接的真阳性率从 0.900 降到 0.400，42.1% 的扫描被延迟。对应的紧凑扫描对 Hubsan 与 Mavic 明显优于 Phantom。一次硬件在环实验把测得墙钟时间从 82.9 秒降到 28.9 秒。这些测量表明链接对背景的准确率并不能度量仅遥控器误确认，且该错误应被单独报告。
summary_cn: 三平台双波段 SDR 测量揭示反无人机检测的仅遥控器误确认：能量检测器 FCR 达 0.500，FCR 约束降至 0.050 但确认 TPR 由 0.900 降为 0.400。
objective_summary: 通过覆盖环境/仅遥控器/已链接三状态的双波段 SDR 测量，量化仅遥控器误确认这一被忽视的错误模式，并评估 FCR 约束下三输出检测器的权衡。
evidence_note: 三款真实平台、20 轮双接收机扫描、硬件在环验证，明确报告 FCR/TPR/延迟比例等量化权衡。
novelty_note: 指出并系统隔离「仅遥控器误确认」这一被既有文献忽略的错误模式，并提出约束式三输出检测设定。
scope: 结论适用于三款商用无人机、2.4/5.8 GHz 遥控频段与所测扫描协议；未覆盖其他平台、频段与对抗性遥控器。
limitations: 平台数量少且部分型号较旧；FCR 约束显著牺牲 TPR；紧凑扫描效果依平台而异；环境场景覆盖有限。

title: Partition-Matched Evaluation of Community Features under Distribution Shift in Android Malware Function-Call Graphs
abstract: Graph-based Android malware classifiers can lose accuracy under malware-type or family shifts. We test whether mesoscopic organization in function-call graphs provides shift-stable information beyond local degree profiles (LDP), global statistics, lightweight metadata, and size-matched random partitions. Using 15,000 MalNet-Tiny, Common, and Distinct graphs, six Leiden descriptors specified before evaluation, and five optimizer seeds, communities raise Tiny macro F1 from 78.7% to 81.3% but yield 29.4-point source-only Common degradation. One size-matched random partition yields 27.8-point degradation. Across five random partitions, mean degradation is 27.9 points; the 95% two-level bootstrap interval for random minus community degradation is [-4.2, 1.2] points. With metadata, the corresponding difference is -0.2 points with interval [-1.1, 0.6]. Removing modularity raises structure-only Common macro F1 from 51.9% to 53.6%. The tested signature adds IID signal but shows no repeatable shift-stability advantage, demonstrating why mesoscopic graph claims need partition-matched controls and repeated null draws.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables
title_cn: 分布偏移下 Android 恶意软件函数调用图社区特征的划分匹配评估
abstract_cn: 基于图的 Android 恶意软件分类器在恶意软件类型或家族偏移下会损失精度。我们检验函数调用图中的介观组织是否在局部度轮廓（LDP）、全局统计、轻量元数据与尺寸匹配随机划分之外，提供偏移下稳定的信息。使用 15000 个 MalNet-Tiny、Common 与 Distinct 图、六个在评估前指定的 Leiden 描述子与五个优化器种子：社区特征把 Tiny 宏 F1 从 78.7% 提升到 81.3%，但在仅用源域的 Common 上造成 29.4 个点的退化。一个尺寸匹配随机划分造成 27.8 个点退化；跨五个随机划分平均退化 27.9 个点，随机减社区退化的 95% 两层自助置信区间为 [-4.2, 1.2] 个点。加入元数据后相应差异为 -0.2 个点、区间 [-1.1, 0.6]。移除模块度使仅结构 Common 宏 F1 从 51.9% 升至 53.6%。所测签名增加了 IID 信号，但未显示可重复的偏移稳定性优势，说明介观图主张需要划分匹配对照与重复零假设抽样。
summary_cn: 15000 图上检验社区特征对 Android 恶意软件检测的偏移稳定性：IID 下 +2.6 点，但偏移下退化与随机划分无差异（自助区间含 0），无重复优势。
objective_summary: 以划分匹配对照与重复零假设抽样评估函数调用图社区特征在分布偏移下的稳定性，量化其相对随机划分的退化差异并给出置信区间。
evidence_note: 15000 图、评估前预指定描述子、五种子重复、两层自助置信区间、跨 MalNet-Tiny/Common/Distinct 三数据集。
novelty_note: 有诊断价值的实证修正：用划分匹配对照揭示介观图特征的偏移脆弱性，方法学对同类主张有普适警示。
scope: 结论适用于 MalNet 系函数调用图、Leiden 社区描述子与所测分类设定；不外推到其他图粒度或特征族。
limitations: 仅测一种介观特征族与三个数据集；偏移为数据集切换式而非连续漂移；未评估更复杂分类器下的表现。

title: Attack Success Rate Is Not a Number: On Measurement Validity in Agentic AI Security Evaluation
abstract: Attack success rate (ASR) is the headline metric in nearly every published evaluation of attacks on, and defenses for, LLM agents. We argue that ASR as currently used is not a single quantity but a family of metrics parameterized by six design choices that papers seldom specify and never hold constant across the literature. We support this with two studies that require no proprietary access. First, a full-text meta-analysis of 259 agentic-security papers posted to arXiv between February 2025 and September 2026 finds that most report neither a variance estimate nor repeated runs for their headline attack metric: 58% (95% CI 44-71) in a hand-coded random sample of 50, 65.3% by automated coding of all 259. Only 30.9% disclose enough about decoding to establish whether their evaluation was even stochastic, and of the 64 papers we confirm use an LLM judge, 29.7% report any agreement check against human labels. Second, an analytical study shows that these omissions are not cosmetic: on a 100-instance benchmark, the minimum difference in ASR detectable at conventional power is 18.2 percentage points, and two defenses whose true ASRs differ by 5 points are ranked in the wrong order by a single-run evaluation roughly 21% of the time. Because several of the six axes shift ASR in a system-dependent way, the resulting incomparability is not a constant offset that cancels in comparison. We conclude that cross-paper ASR comparison is currently unsupported, and propose a ten-item reporting checklist targeted at each failure we measure. Our aim is not to dispute any individual result but to supply the shared measurement contract the field has so far done without.
comment: 7 pages, 2 tables, 2 Figures
title_cn: 攻击成功率不是一个数：论智能体 AI 安全评估中的测量效度
abstract_cn: 攻击成功率（ASR）几乎是所有已发表的 LLM 智能体攻击与防御评估的头条指标。我们论证，目前使用的 ASR 并非单一量，而是由六项论文很少说明、且在整个文献中从未被固定不变的设计选择参数化的一族指标。我们用两项不需要专有访问权限的研究支持这一论点。第一，对 2025 年 2 月至 2026 年 9 月间发布于 arXiv 的 259 篇智能体安全论文的全文元分析发现，多数论文对其头条攻击指标既不报告方差估计也不报告重复运行：在 50 篇手工编码的随机样本中占 58%（95% CI 44–71），对全部 259 篇的自动编码为 65.3%。仅 30.9% 披露了足以判断评估是否为随机的解码信息；在我们确认使用 LLM 评审的 64 篇中，只有 29.7% 报告了与人类标签的一致性检验。第二，一项分析性研究表明这些遗漏并非无关紧要：在 100 实例基准上，常规功效下可检测的最小 ASR 差异为 18.2 个百分点；真实 ASR 相差 5 个点的两个防御，其单次运行评估约有 21% 的概率排序错误。由于六个轴中的数个会以依赖系统的方式移动 ASR，由此产生的不可比性并非能在比较中抵消的常数偏移。我们的结论是：跨论文的 ASR 比较目前不被支持，并针对每个被测量的失效提出一份十项报告清单。我们的目标不是质疑任何单项结果，而是补上该领域至今缺失的共享测量契约。
summary_cn: 对 259 篇智能体安全论文的元分析显示多数 ASR 无方差/重复，100 实例下最小可检差异达 18.2 个百分点、单次运行约 21% 排序错误，提出十项报告清单。
objective_summary: 系统论证 ASR 指标的多义性：以 259 篇论文的全文元分析量化报告缺陷，以分析性功效计算量化其后果，并提出十项报告清单。
evidence_note: 259 篇全文元分析（手工+自动双编码、报告 95% CI）、分析性功效研究、不依赖专有访问，统计口径明确。
novelty_note: 首次系统量化智能体安全领域 ASR 的测量效度缺陷，并给出跨论文不可比性的定量论证。
scope: 结论适用于 2025-02 至 2026-09 的 arXiv 智能体安全文献与 100 实例级评估设定；对其他指标族未覆盖。
limitations: 自动编码可能误分类；分析性研究假设二项方差与固定实例集；未评估清单对报告质量改进的实际效果。

title: Benchmarking Neural Defend ARCAS 1B: A Foundational Multimodal Deepfake Detection Model
abstract: AI-generated imagery evolves faster than benchmark-specific detector evaluations, making a single score an incomplete account of generalization. This paper evaluates Neural Defend ARCAS 1B across benchmark families without benchmark-specific parameter updates. We retain native aggregation and supplement it with record-level measures, coverage accounting, and subgroup diagnostics. Each Results subsection identifies the release and evaluation population, reports the official metric, and describes observed error patterns. A combined analysis synthesizes shared patterns while preserving the distinction between native and pooled quantities. Cross-paper comparisons are restricted to aligned evidence; differences in release, population, preprocessing, training, or benchmark exposure are context rather than rank. The findings characterize performance on evaluated records, not universal reliability, calibration, attribution, or future adaptive attacks. By keeping benchmark-native outcomes distinct from pooled summaries, the study makes test-population, class-balance, and missing-record-coverage differences visible. It supports interpretation of detector results in research, platform-safety, and forensic-review settings, foregrounding traceable protocol conditions over claims or leaderboard comparisons.
title_cn: 基准化评测 Neural Defend ARCAS 1B：一个基础多模态深伪检测模型
abstract_cn: AI 生成图像的演化快于面向特定基准的检测器评估，单一分数不足以说明泛化能力。本文在不做基准专用参数更新的情况下，跨基准家族评估 Neural Defend ARCAS 1B。我们保留原生聚合方式，并补充记录级测量、覆盖核算与子组诊断。每个结果小节标明发布版本与评估总体、报告官方指标，并描述观察到的错误模式。综合分析在保留原生量与合并量之区别的前提下综合共性模式。跨论文比较仅限于证据对齐的情形；发布版本、总体、预处理、训练或基准暴露上的差异是背景条件而非排名依据。研究发现刻画的是在已评估记录上的表现，而非普遍的可靠性、校准、归因能力或对未来自适应攻击的抵抗。通过把基准原生结果与合并摘要区分开来，本研究使测试总体、类别平衡与缺失记录覆盖的差异可见。它支持在研究、平台安全与取证审查场景中解释检测结果，把可追溯的协议条件置于声称或排行榜比较之上。
summary_cn: 跨基准家族评估商用深伪检测模型 ARCAS 1B：不更新参数，保留原生聚合并补充记录级与子组诊断，强调协议条件而非排行榜比较。
objective_summary: 在不做基准适配的情况下，用多基准家族、记录级测量、覆盖核算与子组诊断系统评估 ARCAS 1B 深伪检测模型，并区分原生与合并统计量。
evidence_note: 多基准家族与记录级/子组诊断流程完整；但评估对象为单一商用模型，摘要未给出具体数值结果，协议为作者自建。
novelty_note: 对单一商业模型的评测报告，方法学为既有评测实践（记录级、覆盖核算、子组分析）的系统化应用。
scope: 结论限于所评估的发布版本与记录总体；不外推到可靠性、校准、归因或自适应攻击场景。
limitations: 单一模型、无与竞品的直接对齐比较；各基准的暴露与总体差异难以完全控制；未测自适应攻击。

title: TRACTOR Benchmark for Evaluating C to Rust Translators
abstract: Memory-safety vulnerabilities remain a persistent source of security risk in critical software, much of which is implemented in memory-unsafe languages such as C and C++. Recent advances in programming languages, program analysis, and artificial intelligence have created new opportunities to modernize these legacy systems through automated translation to memory-safe languages such as Rust. The DARPA Translating All C to Rust (TRACTOR) program seeks to develop scalable techniques for translating large C codebases into safe, performant, and maintainable Rust. MIT Lincoln Laboratory serves as the program's independent test and evaluation organization and has developed a standardized benchmark for systematically assessing C-to-Rust translation tools. This report describes the TRACTOR benchmark, including progressively challenging test batteries and larger milestone projects, as well as the supporting evaluation infrastructure and metrics for assessing correctness, safety, idiomaticity, and performance. The benchmark and associated evaluation infrastructure are publicly available to support the broader development and evaluation of C-to-Rust translation technologies.
title_cn: TRACTOR 基准：评估 C 到 Rust 翻译器
abstract_cn: 内存安全漏洞仍是关键软件中持续存在的安全风险来源，而这些软件大量以 C 和 C++ 等内存不安全语言实现。编程语言、程序分析与人工智能的最新进展，为通过自动翻译到 Rust 等内存安全语言来现代化这些遗留系统创造了新机会。DARPA 的 Translating All C to Rust（TRACTOR）项目旨在开发把大型 C 代码库翻译为安全、高性能且可维护 Rust 的可扩展技术。MIT 林肯实验室作为该项目的独立测试与评估机构，开发了一个系统性评估 C 到 Rust 翻译工具的标准化基准。本报告描述 TRACTOR 基准，包括渐进加难的测试电池与更大的里程碑项目，以及配套的评估基础设施和用于评估正确性、安全性、惯用性与性能的指标。该基准与配套评估基础设施已公开，以支持 C 到 Rust 翻译技术的更广泛开发与评估。
summary_cn: MIT 林肯实验室发布 DARPA TRACTOR 计划的 C 到 Rust 翻译工具标准化基准：渐进测试电池 + 里程碑项目，评正确性、安全性、惯用性与性能。
objective_summary: 介绍 DARPA TRACTOR 计划 C-to-Rust 翻译评估基准的构成（测试电池、里程碑项目）、评估基础设施与四类评估指标。
evidence_note: DARPA 独立测试评估机构出品、基准与基础设施公开、指标体系完整；本报告为描述性文档，未附各工具横向实验数据。
novelty_note: C-to-Rust 翻译评估此前缺乏标准化公共基准，该基准是该方向首个系统性评测设施之一。
scope: 适用于 C-to-Rust 翻译工具的正确性/安全性/惯用性/性能评估；报告描述基准本身，未给出工具成绩。
limitations: 测试用例与真实遗留代码库存在差距；惯用性等指标的操作化方式待社区检验；报告本身无实验结论。

title: CPyGraph: A Version-Aware Static Analysis Framework for Native CPython Bytecode
abstract: Static analysis of Python packages must recover both program structure and object flow across first-class functions, dynamic dispatch, implicit protocol calls, exceptions, closures, and module execution. Native CPython bytecode provides the executable lowering of these behaviors, but its instruction, call, stack, and exception representations change across releases. This creates a need for a version-aware analysis foundation whose graph products share the same bytecode identities and semantics. We present CPyGraph, a C++ framework for package-level analysis of native CPython bytecode. Version- specific adapters expose stack, control, call, lexical, protocol, and exception semantics through a shared interface while preserving code-object identities and native bytecode offsets. An operand-stack-aware Andersen points- to analysis and call graph grow together to a fixed point. Their shared state supports exception-aware CFGs, block-level CDGs, and interprocedural DDGs, with optional function-level flow, context, and bounded path sensitivity. The framework also records unresolved dynamic behavior through typed coverage summaries. We evaluate CPyGraph with PYGBench, 201 package-level programs and 1,733 fixed candidates. On CPython 3.10, the default analysis reaches 91.40% candidate precision and 100% recall; complete sensitivity reaches 94.97% precision with the same recall. Across CPython 3.10-3.14, 1,328 of 1,334 version-invariant queries agree, and CPyGraph matches PyCG on its 112-program call-graph benchmark.
title_cn: CPyGraph：面向原生 CPython 字节码的版本感知静态分析框架
abstract_cn: 对 Python 包的静态分析必须跨一阶函数、动态分发、隐式协议调用、异常、闭包与模块执行恢复程序结构与对象流。原生 CPython 字节码提供了这些行为的可执行下沉表示，但其指令、调用、栈与异常表示随版本变化。这要求一个版本感知的分析基础，其图产物共享同一字节码标识与语义。我们提出 CPyGraph，一个对原生 CPython 字节码做包级分析的 C++ 框架。版本专用适配器通过共享接口暴露栈、控制、调用、词法、协议与异常语义，同时保留代码对象标识与原生字节码偏移。操作数栈感知的 Andersen 指向分析与调用图一起增长到不动点。其共享状态支持异常感知 CFG、块级 CDG 与过程间 DDG，并可选函数级流、上下文与有界路径敏感。框架还通过类型化覆盖摘要记录未解析的动态行为。我们用 PYGBench（201 个包级程序与 1733 个固定候选）评估 CPyGraph。在 CPython 3.10 上，默认分析达到 91.40% 候选精确率与 100% 召回率；完整敏感性达到 94.97% 精确率、召回率不变。跨 CPython 3.10–3.14，1334 个版本不变查询中 1328 个一致，且 CPyGraph 在其 112 程序调用图基准上与 PyCG 相当。
summary_cn: CPyGraph：跨 CPython 3.10–3.14 的原生字节码包级静态分析框架，PYGBench 上默认分析 91.40% 精确率/100% 召回，与 PyCG 相当。
objective_summary: 构建版本感知的 CPython 字节码图分析框架，提供指向分析、调用图、异常感知 CFG/CDG/DDG 的共享接口，并以 PYGBench 与跨版本一致性实验评估。
evidence_note: PYGBench 201 程序/1733 候选、跨 5 个 CPython 版本 1334 个查询的一致性检验、与 PyCG 的对齐基准对比。
novelty_note: 版本感知的原生字节码统一分析基础在 Python 生态属新的系统化工作；指向分析等算法本身成熟。
scope: 结论适用于 CPython 3.10–3.14 的包级字节码分析；动态行为以覆盖摘要报告而非求解。
limitations: 高度动态行为（元编程、C 扩展）只能记录不解析；基准为作者构建；调用图对比仅 PyCG 一家。

title: Encrypted Redundancy as a Diagnostic Resource: Relational Diagnosis in Quantum Encrypted Cloning
abstract: Quantum encrypted cloning encodes an unknown state into several encrypted components, each offering an alternative way to recover it later. We show that this redundancy can also serve for one-shot fault diagnosis: instead of inspecting the encrypted state, we measure relational Pauli observables testing consistency conditions imposed by the encoding. The canonical Yamaguchi--Kempf scheme encodes the input into \(n\) signal--key pairs, all carrying the same coherent Bell label, plus a transformed copy of the input qubit. Comparing the labels of two pairs yields a deterministic check that localizes an anomalous pair and identifies its Pauli-error class without revealing the label. Such checks cannot tell whether the signal or the key of that pair is faulty, and no measurement on the pairs can (we prove that they already generate the whole group of deterministic state-blind observables supported there, of rank \(2(n-1)\)). This ambiguity matters: a faulty signal costs one redemption path, a faulty key threatens them all. However, retaining also the transformed input qubit contributes exactly two further independent checks, at any multiplicity, and these suffice to identify any single fault drawn from the single-qubit Pauli set. For three clones this gives six checks in all, and we prove that no smaller set of state-blind observables achieves the same resolution. Across clone multiplicities, parity governs how many components must be measured jointly to reach this resolution, not the resolution itself. These findings are then abstracted into a general framework --- state-blind observables, deterministic healthy references, syndrome-induced fault partitions, redemption-oriented sufficiency --- yielding \textit{relational diagnosability}: a syndrome need not identify every fault, only enough of it to select a safe redemption path.
comment: 33 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Companion to arXiv:2604.10155 and arXiv:2605.27421, whose reduced-state characterizations are used here; those preprints have been revised (v2) to correct a sign in a worked example, and the corrected sign is the one adopted throughout this paper
title_cn: 加密冗余作为诊断资源：量子加密克隆中的关系式诊断
abstract_cn: 量子加密克隆把未知态编码为若干加密组件，每个组件都提供一条日后恢复它的替代途径。我们证明这种冗余还可用于一次性故障诊断：不检查加密态本身，而是测量关系型 Pauli 可观测量，检验编码所强加的一致性条件。标准的 Yamaguchi–Kempf 方案把输入编码为 n 个信号–密钥对（都携带同一相干 Bell 标签）加上输入量子比特的一个变换副本。比较两个对的标签可得到一个确定性检验，能定位异常对并识别其 Pauli 错误类别而不泄露标签。这类检验无法判断该对的信号还是密钥出错，且对上任何测量都不能做到（我们证明它们已生成该处全部确定性态盲可观测量群，秩为 2(n-1)）。这种歧义事关重大：信号出错只损失一条赎回路径，密钥出错则威胁所有路径。而保留的变换输入量子比特在任何克隆数下都恰好再贡献两个独立检验，足以识别来自单量子比特 Pauli 集的任何单一故障。对三个克隆共得六个检验，我们证明不存在更小的态盲可观测量集合达到同样分辨率。跨克隆数看，奇偶性决定需要联合测量多少组件才能达到该分辨率，而非分辨率本身。随后这些发现被抽象为一个一般框架——态盲可观测量、确定性健康参考、症状诱导的故障划分、面向赎回的充分性——得到「关系可诊断性」：症状无需识别每个故障，只需足以选择一条安全的赎回路径。
summary_cn: 证明量子加密克隆的冗余可用于一次性故障诊断：六个态盲检验即可定位并分类任意单一 Pauli 故障，提出「关系可诊断性」框架并证明检验集最小性。
objective_summary: 为 Yamaguchi–Kempf 量子加密克隆方案设计基于关系型 Pauli 可观测量的故障诊断检验，证明其完备性、最小性与信号/密钥歧义的不可避免性，并抽象出一般诊断框架。
evidence_note: 完整证明（生成群刻画、秩 2(n-1)、最小性）并复用伴随前作的约化态表征；无实验实现。
novelty_note: 把加密克隆的冗余开辟为一次性诊断资源并提出「关系可诊断性」新概念，属新问题界定。
scope: 结论适用于 Yamaguchi–Kempf 型加密克隆及其抽象框架；针对单量子比特 Pauli 故障集与确定性检验。
limitations: 只处理单一故障；信号/密钥歧义被证明不可避免；框架到具体协议（赎回路径成本、实际部署）的落地未展开。

title: Not All 4-bit Quantizers Are Equal: Deployment-Time Mitigation of PII Leakage in Fine-Tuned Small Language Models
abstract: Organizations fine-tune small language models on private data and then compress them to 4 bits for resource-efficient deployment. We show that the compression method also affects privacy. What separates the methods is not the bit width but whether they tune their rounding on a small sample of text, the calibration corpus. On our primary model, when each planted record's own opening text is used as the prompt, the two calibration-based methods we test, Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) and Gradient-based Post-Training Quantization (GPTQ), each reproduce none of the planted records, while the calibration-corpus-free GGUF Q4_K_M format reproduces 5.3% of them. Tracked across five open models with 0.5-7 billion parameters, AWQ leaks least at every size and in both families, with little accuracy loss at 3-7 billion. Controlled experiments associate the difference with calibration-induced rounding error in channels involved in rare-token prediction. Choosing the 4-bit method is therefore a deployment-time privacy decision, not only a question of speed and quality.
comment: 10 pages and 5 tables. The source code and per-seed experimental results are publicly available at this https URL. Accepted for publication at SBSeg 2026
title_cn: 并非所有 4 比特量化器都相同：微调小语言模型中 PII 泄漏的部署时缓解
abstract_cn: 组织在私有数据上微调小语言模型，然后将其压缩到 4 比特以实现资源高效的部署。我们表明压缩方法也会影响隐私。区分各方法的不是比特宽度，而是它们是否在一小段文本样本（校准语料库）上调整舍入。在我们的主模型上，当以每条植入记录自身的前导文本作为提示时，我们测试的两种基于校准的方法——激活感知权重量化（AWQ）与基于梯度的训练后量化（GPTQ）——均不能复现任何植入记录，而不使用校准语料库的 GGUF Q4_K_M 格式复现了其中 5.3%。在五个 0.5–70 亿参数的开源模型上追踪，AWQ 在每个规模和两个模型家族中泄漏都最少，且在 30–70 亿参数上几乎无精度损失。受控实验把这一差异与参与罕见词元预测的通道中由校准引起的舍入误差联系起来。因此，选择 4 比特方法是一个部署时的隐私决策，而不仅仅是速度与质量问题。
summary_cn: 微调小模型的 4 比特量化方式影响 PII 泄漏：GGUF Q4_K_M 复现 5.3% 植入记录，AWQ/GPTQ 为零；AWQ 在 0.5–7B 五个模型中泄漏最少。
objective_summary: 在五个开源小模型上系统比较 AWQ、GPTQ 与 GGUF Q4_K_M 三种 4 比特量化方法对植入 PII 记录复现率的影响，并用受控实验把差异归因于校准引起的罕见词元通道舍入误差。
evidence_note: 五个开源模型（0.5–7B）、受控实验归因舍入误差、逐种子结果与源码公开，SBSeg 2026 录用。
novelty_note: 首次把量化校准方式与 PII 泄漏率系统关联并给出机理解释；单点结论（校准与否）之外的技术组件均为已有。
scope: 结论适用于 0.5–7B 开源模型、所测三种量化方法与以记录前导文本为提示的记忆提取场景。
limitations: 主模型单一，跨模型细节有限；只测一种 GGUF 格式与两种校准方法；泄漏以植入记录复现衡量，未覆盖其他提取攻击。

title: Vigil: Accountable Liveness against Selective Silence
abstract: BFT accountability is well understood for safety violations, and recent work attributes global liveness violations; \emph{recipient-selective} silence remains unresolved. A selectively silent adversary withholds messages from some honest nodes while behaving correctly toward others. It can stall consensus yet evade every existing mechanism. We initiate a systematic study of accountability against selective silence. Negatively, a lone attacker silent toward at most $f$ honest nodes is indistinguishable from an honest node, yielding a universal lower bound $K_{\mathrm{SI}} \ge f{+}1$ on the \emph{silence identification threshold}; moreover, any feedback-free repair after a silence-induced violation costs $\Theta(n^3)$. Positively, \textsc{Vigil}, a Tendermint variant, matches these bounds with attack-adaptive forwarding, via bitmap cross-attestation, core-based membership, and challenge--response auditing. It pays $O(n)$ authenticators per node when no selective silence occurs (plus $\Theta(n^2)$ bitmap metadata bits per node), relays in proportion to the attack's width (sub-threshold silence can force up to $n^3/27$ relays per view, a cost we price exactly), and majority-accuses any node silent toward more than a tunable resilience $\tau_A$ of honest peers ($K_{\mathrm{SI}} = \tau_A{+}1$, optimal at $\tau_A = f$). We also price the residual sub-threshold griefing surface exactly and extend identification to $x$-partial synchrony. Real-network experiments on a three-region WAN, together with a simulator held to exact equality with every closed form, confirm each threshold and cost: at $2\%$ loss, an $f{+}1$ accusation bar falsely accuses $91.2\%$ of honest nodes, while our majority bar accuses $0.002\%$.
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures
title_cn: Vigil：针对选择性沉默的可追责活性
abstract_cn: BFT 问责性对安全性违规已有充分理解，近期工作也能归因全局活性违规，而「面向特定接收者的选择性沉默」仍未解决。选择性沉默的对手对部分诚实节点扣发消息，同时对其他节点行为正常。它能使共识停摆，却逃过所有现有机制。我们开启对选择性沉默问责性的系统研究。消极方面，单打独斗、至多对 f 个诚实节点沉默的攻击者与诚实节点不可区分，由此得到沉默识别阈值的普适下界 K_SI ≥ f+1；且沉默违规后任何无反馈修复的代价为 Θ(n³)。积极方面，我们提出 Tendermint 变体 Vigil，通过攻击自适应转发、位图交叉证明、基于核心的成员关系与质询—响应审计匹配这些界。未发生选择性沉默时每节点支付 O(n) 个认证器（外加每节点 Θ(n²) 位图元数据位）；转发量与攻击宽度成比例（亚阈值沉默每个视图至多强制 n³/27 次转发，我们对此精确定价）；并对对多于可调韧性 τ_A 个诚实同伴沉默的节点做多数指控（K_SI = τ_A+1，τ_A = f 时最优）。我们还精确定价剩余的亚阈值骚扰面，并将识别扩展到 x-部分同步。三区域 WAN 上的真实网络实验，加上与每个闭式都严格一致的模拟器，确认了各阈值与代价：2% 丢包下，f+1 指控门槛会错误指控 91.2% 的诚实节点，而我们的多数门槛只指控 0.002%。
summary_cn: 首次系统研究 BFT 选择性沉默问责：证明识别阈值下界 K_SI≥f+1，给出匹配的 Tendermint 变体 Vigil；三区域 WAN 实验 2% 丢包下误指控率 0.002%（f+1 门槛为 91.2%）。
objective_summary: 针对 BFT 中面向特定接收者的选择性沉默开启问责性系统研究，证明沉默识别阈值下界与修复代价下界，并给出匹配下界的 Tendermint 变体 Vigil 及其 WAN 实验验证。
evidence_note: 下界与构造互证（K_SI=f+1 时最优），三区域 WAN 真实网络实验，模拟器与全部闭式严格对齐，误报率量化到 0.002%；结论为确定性阈值，无需统计检验。
novelty_note: 开辟「选择性沉默问责」这一此前未解决的威胁模型，同时给出普适下界与首个匹配下界的机制，属新问题加新路线。
scope: 结论适用于 Tendermint 类投票共识与部分同步模型；对其他共识族或异步网络的适用性未直接验证。
limitations: 机制绑定 Tendermint 结构，迁移到其他 BFT 协议需重设计；亚阈值沉默仍构成可精确定价但未消除的骚扰面；实验为自建 WAN 环境。
